### [1] [Depth-Aware Activation Steering via Attention Residuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21655)
*Shilong Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将Attention Residuals的可学习跨层路径与Jacobian-lens概念读出结合，提出一种轻量、免训练的深度感知激活引导（steering）方法，并在两个小模型上系统验证其有效性与评价协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活引导方法通常在单层注入向量，缺乏深度感知的传播机制与内部验证手段，效果与可靠性受限。

Method: 把persona向量按AttnRes风格的深度权重分配到多层注入；用Jacobian-lens（J-space）概念余弦与秩作为内部对齐读出；在Qwen3-0.6B与Qwen3.5-0.8B上做对照实验（单层注入、反向向量、随机方向、LoRA微调擦除、上游JS检验），并进行逐层几何分解、强度窗口扫描、指标校验（关键词规则 vs LLM-judge），以及以引导目标训练深度权重（200步，主干冻结）。

Result: 深度加权注入比单层注入带来更强内部对齐（更深层概念余弦与秩，p<0.0001）与更强行为改变；方向符号特异（反向向量使六项指标全部反转，随机方向降低对齐，p<0.0001），短LoRA微调可抹除印记；注入仅改变注入点下游注意力（上游JS=0.00000）。几何分解显示注入层余弦提升123%为算术效应，下游5-11层100%为动力学效应；强度在0.3-0.7单调，之后生成崩溃（617→306→25字符）；关键词规则指标与LLM-judge一致性差（kappa≤0.09），两条基于规则的结论被撤回；以引导目标训练深度权重使留出提示上的最终对齐提升10倍；跨persona向量保留96-99%效果，说明特异性可对抗随机方向但不敌语义方向。

Conclusion: 贡献了一个实用、低开销的深度感知引导方法及严谨的评估协议，并公开代码与数据；同时提示该方法对语义相近方向缺乏特异性，且对注入强度与评价指标选择高度敏感。

Abstract: Activation steering is a simple, training-free way to modulate LLM behavior, yet existing methods typically inject vectors at a single layer and lack mechanisms for depth-aware propagation or internal verification. We combine two recent ideas - Attention Residuals (AttnRes) providing learnable cross-layer pathways, and Jacobian-lens (J-space) concept readout - into a lightweight depth-aware steering pipeline. On two small open models (Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3.5-0.8B), distributing a persona vector according to AttnRes-style depth weights yields stronger internal alignment (deeper-layer concept cosine and rank, p<0.0001) and stronger behavioral shifts than single-layer injection. The effect is sign-specific: reverse vectors invert all six metrics, random directions degrade alignment (p<0.0001), and a short LoRA fine-tune erases the imprint. Injection rewires attention strictly downstream of the injection point (upstream JS = 0.00000). Three practical findings follow. First, a layer-wise geometric decomposition of cosine readouts: at the injection layer 123% of the increase is arithmetic, while 5-11 layers downstream 100% is dynamical. Second, an intensity window: effects are monotone over 0.3-0.7, then generation collapses (617 to 306 to 25 chars). Third, metric discipline: keyword-rule metrics fail LLM-judge validation (kappa <= 0.09), and two rule-based conclusions were retracted. Training the depth weights on a steering objective (200 steps, frozen backbone) raises final alignment 10x on held-out prompts. Cross-persona vectors retain 96-99% of the effect: specificity holds against random, not semantic, directions. We contribute a practical, low-overhead depth-aware steering method with a careful evaluation protocol. Code and data are released.

</details>


### [2] [Edge-Adaptive Hiera-Seg Model for Building-Integrated Photovoltaic Power Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21680)
*Na Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出边缘自适应的HieraSeg模型，通过多朝向视觉-辐照度融合实现短期BIPV光伏功率预测，并输出可追溯的预测依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BIPV功率预测受立面朝向、屋顶几何、邻近建筑、植被、云移动、组件温度、逆变器状态与边缘设备可靠性等多因素耦合影响，现有方法难以在边缘端统一建模并解释预测来源。

Method: 将RGB立面图像（可选热成像）、辐照度、组件温度、朝向、屋顶掩码、遮挡标签、天空状况、历史功率与边缘设备状态对齐为同步预测窗口；HieraSeg分层提取立面/屋顶/天空/阴影/背景区域，边缘自适应模块在丢帧、延迟漂移与局部遮挡变化下动态调整特征权重；分割分支识别被遮挡组件区域并为预测头提供证据分离。

Result: 在模拟多建筑BIPV数据集上设计未见建筑与未见朝向的泛化测试；模型输出预测功率、置信区间、主导证据、遮挡贡献、朝向贡献及能量管理复核优先级。

Conclusion: 该框架可在通信延迟与算力受限的边缘控制器本地完成预测，将视觉遮挡、辐照度动态与功率历史关联为可追溯结果，服务于建筑能源管理、微电网调度与BIPV运行规划。

Abstract: Building integrated photovoltaic power forecasting is challenging because facade orientation, rooftop geometry, nearby buildings, vegetation, cloud movement, module temperature, inverter status and edge device reliability jointly affect power generation. This paper proposes an edge-adaptive HieraSeg model for short term BIPV power forecasting with multi-orientation visual-irradiance fusion. RGB facade images, optional thermal cues, irradiance measurements, module temperature, facade orientation, rooftop masks, shading labels, sky condition, historical power and edge device state are aligned into synchronous forecasting windows. HieraSeg extracts hierarchical regions from facade, rooftop, sky, shadow and background images, while the edge-adaptive module changes feature weights under missing frames, latency shifts and local shading changes. The segmentation branch identifies occluded module areas and separates facade, rooftop, sky and background evidence before the forecasting head estimates future BIPV output. Experiments are designed on a simulated multibuilding BIPV dataset with unseen building and unseen orientation tests. The model reports predicted power, confidence interval, dominant evidence, occlusion contribution, orientation contribution and energy-management review priority. This output is intended to show whether the forecast is driven by irradiance change, visible shading, orientation response, stale edge information or recent power history. The framework supports local forecasting at edge controllers with limited communication delay and computing resources, linking visual occlusion, irradiance dynamics and power history to traceable forecasting results for building energy management, microgrid scheduling and BIPV operation planning.

</details>


### [3] [EgoLink: Egocentric Language-Vision Interactive Network Knowledge Challenge Summary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21690)
*Renhe Sun,Yueying Feng,Bohan Yu,Tong Niu,Yunqi Liu,Zitong Wang,Haolin He,Kexin Shi,Hualei Wang,Qiuqiang Kong,Chang Yao,Yuge Huang,Weiqiang Wang,Jingyuan Chen,Jian Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoLink Challenge@ACM MM 2026 提出以第一人称视角、社交推理与工具化交互为核心的基准，包含社交推理问答与交互式服务智能体两条赛道，最优系统分别达 0.9263 准确率与 0.844 联合成功率/0.916 微准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有第一人称多模态基准多聚焦可见物体与活动识别，缺少对情绪与社交线索理解、视觉落地指代消解、以及将用户请求转化为可验证工具化动作的能力评估，也少有在离线问答与状态改变交互两类设定下同时检验感知-推理-决策是否保持耦合的测试。

Method: 设置两条赛道：Track 1 为第一人称视频社交推理，包含多阶段数据流水线（多项选择题生成、思维链生成、自动质量分级、视频贡献度过滤），采用客观答案评分与基于过程/结果的评估；Track 2 为通过对话、工具调用与闭环执行完成服务任务的交互式智能体，采用联合成功率与微准确率等指标，并给出任务设计、评价指标、规则、排行榜与代表性方案。

Result: Track 1 最佳系统准确率 0.9263；Track 2 最佳系统联合成功率 0.844、微准确率 0.916。参赛报告显示，强系统的共性在于将中间证据显式化：候选验证、选项鲁棒推理、场景感知规划、工具规范化、以及回答或行动前的状态感知纠错。

Conclusion: 过程验证与证据落地推理是实现可靠第一人称多模态智能的关键，该基准通过结合最终正确性与执行质量评估，为耦合式感知-推理-决策研究提供了可复现的评测框架。

Abstract: The EgoLink Challenge at ACM Multimedia 2026 benchmarks egocentric multimodal intelligence linking first-person perception, social reasoning, and interactive action. Unlike benchmarks centered on visible objects and activities, EgoLink evaluates whether models can interpret emotional and social cues, resolve visually grounded references, and convert user requests into verified tool-mediated actions. Its two tracks cover social reasoning in egocentric video and interactive agents that complete service tasks through dialogue, tool use, and closed-loop execution. Together, they test whether perception, reasoning, and decision-making remain coupled under both offline question answering and state-changing interaction. We highlight a multi-stage Track 1 data pipeline for multiple-choice question (MCQ) generation, chain-of-thought generation, automatic quality grading, and video-contribution filtering. We summarize the task design, evaluation metrics, rules, leaderboards, and representative solutions. The benchmark combines objective answer scoring with process- and result-based evaluation, enabling analysis of both final correctness and execution quality. The best Track 1 system achieved 0.9263 accuracy, while the best Track 2 system achieved 0.844 joint success and 0.916 micro accuracy. Participant reports reveal a shared principle: strong systems make intermediate evidence explicit through candidate verification, option-robust reasoning, scenario-aware planning, tool canonicalization, and state-aware correction before answering or acting. These findings highlight the importance of process verification and evidence-grounded reasoning for reliable egocentric multimodal intelligence.

</details>


### [4] [Video recordings and play behaviour annotations of group-housed dairy calves on two Dutch farms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21706)
*Haiyu Yang,Heidi Lesscher,Enhong Liu,Miel Hostens*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发布了一个公开的群养犊牛视频数据集，包含651小时视频、104小时人工行为标注及约110万帧带分割轨迹与逐帧玩耍标签的解码图像，用于犊牛健康福利研究与自动行为识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 玩耍行为被用作犊牛正向福利的指标，但公开可获取的、带个体行为标注的群养犊牛视频数据十分稀缺，制约了相关行为学与自动识别研究。

Method: 在荷兰两个农场（一个科研教学农场2024与2025年、一个商业农场2024年）的犊牛群养栏中部署四组摄像头，每组约一周；共1,173个视频文件、651小时。由受训观察员使用Noldus The Observer XT，依据含18项玩耍及其他行为的行为谱，对8个观察日进行连续编码，覆盖104小时，其中90小时栏内每头犊牛均被编码。数据含7段标注会话的110万帧解码图像、基于画面内摄像头时钟OCR的逐帧时间戳、逐犊牛分割轨迹以及逐帧玩耍标签。

Result: 建成并公开多农场、多批次的犊牛群养行为数据集，包含完整人工行为编码、图像帧、时间戳、个体分割轨迹与帧级玩耍标签，可直接用于行为学分析与算法训练评估。

Conclusion: 该数据集可支撑犊牛行为与福利研究，并为自动行为识别的开发与评估提供基准资源。

Abstract: Play is used as an indicator of positive welfare in dairy calves, but openly available video of group-housed calves with individual behaviour annotations is scarce. We describe video from four camera deployments of about one week each in group pens of dairy calves on two farms in the Netherlands: a research and teaching dairy farm (2024 and 2025) and a commercial dairy farm (2024). The recordings comprise 1,173 video files spanning 651 h. For eight observation days, trained observers coded calf behaviour continuously in Noldus The Observer XT with an 18-item ethogram of play and other behaviours, covering 104 h of video, 90 h of which have every calf in the pen coded. The release also contains 1.1 million decoded frames from seven annotated sessions, a per-frame timestamp read by optical character recognition from the camera clock burned into each frame, per-calf segmentation tracks and per-calf frame-level play labels. The data support studies of calf behaviour and welfare and the development and evaluation of automated behaviour recognition.

</details>


### [5] [Every Camera Grows Up: Camera-Height Regression in Interactive Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21782)
*Sheng Lu,Guangpin Tao,Tong Lu,Ying Tai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文揭示交互式视频世界模型存在"相机高度回归"失效：随生成推进，相机被拉向人眼高度（1.1–1.5 m），偏离初始设定的0.15–2.2 m高度；提出EyeHeight基准量化该现象，并追溯其成因至以人类视角为中心的视频先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式视频世界模型被用作具身智能体的模拟器，其输出应忠实保持起始图像所固定的相机高度（如地面机器人0.15 m、顶置相机2.2 m）。若模型在运动生成过程中改变相机高度，则生成视图不再对应智能体真实观测，模拟器的可信度与下游导航策略评估均会失效。作者因此系统检验现有开源权重模型是否具备高度保持能力。

Method: 构建基准EyeHeight：包含6种渲染高度（0.15–2.2 m）与4种标定过的真实世界拍摄装置高度，并配套尺度无关的多视图高度估计方法。评测协议为180°转身行走的rollout，用该估计器推断生成视频中的视角高度并与真值渲染对比。进一步用单应性追踪地面运动、稠密地面视差图、文本高度提示、classifier-free guidance调度等干预实验定位成因，并尝试无引导采样与高度均衡微调。

Result: 六个近期开源权重模型均丧失初始高度：以0.15 m初始化时，仅0–20%的片段结束时高度落在起始高度的1.3倍以内，推断视角收敛至人类高度1.1–1.5 m，而真值渲染误差仅为几个百分点。Matrix-Game模型在旋转期间单应性追踪的地面运动仍与恒定高度一致，但新外绘的房间几何却重建出更高的视点。回归程度随旋转角增大，且在起始帧仍在上下文内时即已开始；SANA-WM中360°转身可大部分逆转该漂移。引导方面，文本高度提示与稠密地面视差图均无法阻止回归，而去噪前半程的CFG反而加剧之；无引导采样结合高度均衡微调可提升保持度，但牺牲5个MUSIQ点，该损失可在同样的早期去噪步骤中修复。

Conclusion: 相机高度回归是当前视频世界模型系统性、可复现的失效模式，根源在于训练数据中缺乏地面视角的人本中心视频先验。即使提供显式高度条件也难以抑制，且视角漂移本身即会改变视觉导航策略预测的路径，说明该问题对具身模拟与策略评估具有实质影响。

Abstract: Interactive video world models serve as simulators for embodied agents: from a starting image and an action trajectory, they generate the views the agent would see. The starting image fixes how high the camera is, for example 0.15 m for a floor robot or 2.2 m for an overhead camera, and a faithful simulator must keep this height as the camera moves. We show that six recent open-weight models fail to do so: as motion replaces the starting view with generated content, they move the camera toward human eye level, a failure we call camera-height regression. Our benchmark, EyeHeight, pairs six rendered elevations (0.15 m to 2.2 m) and four calibrated real-world rig heights with scale-free multi-view height estimation. All six models lose their initial height during a $180^\circ$ turn-and-walk rollout: initialized at 0.15 m, only 0-20% of clips end within $1.3\times$ of the starting height as inferred viewpoints converge to human heights of 1.1 m to 1.5 m, whereas ground-truth renders remain within a few percent. In Matrix-Game models, homography-tracked floor motion stays consistent with constant elevation during rotation even as newly outpainted room geometry yields a higher reconstructed viewpoint. Regression grows with rotation angle, begins while the start frame remains in context, and largely reverses in SANA-WM when a $360^\circ$ turn restores the initial view. We trace this pull to human-centric video priors in which floor-level views are nearly absent: in SANA-WM, textual height cues and dense floor-disparity maps do not prevent it, whereas classifier-free text guidance during the first half of denoising strengthens it. Combining unguided sampling with height-balanced fine-tuning recovers more retention but costs 5 MUSIQ points, a loss fixed during those same early steps. Viewpoint drift alone shifts the paths predicted by visual navigation policies.

</details>


### [6] [Data-Driven Variable-Length Compression of 3D Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21802)
*Yvette Y. Lin,Sai Karthikey Pentapati,Sarvesh Sundaram,Guandao Yang,Sara Fridovich-Keil*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种可学习的变长3D形状压缩方法，在仅用快速前馈推理的前提下，同时利用训练数据集层面的统计结构，并按单个形状的复杂度自适应调整压缩表示长度，在网格与SDF上均提升率失真性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D形状压缩对众多应用的效率至关重要，但现有方法存在两类局限：一是无法利用数据集层面的统计规律，二是对所有形状采用固定压缩率，忽略了不同形状在复杂度上的差异。

Method: 学习式变长压缩：在训练数据集上挖掘跨样本结构先验，作用于通用的潜在表示；压缩表示的长度按单个形状复杂度自适应决定，编码/解码仅需快速前馈推理，无需逐形状迭代优化。

Result: 在网格（mesh）与符号距离场（SDF）两类3D表示上，率失真（rate-distortion）性能均得到改进，同时保持前馈推理的效率。

Conclusion: 数据集级先验与逐形状自适应码长可以兼得，且不牺牲推理速度；方法具有表示无关性，可推广到多种潜在表示的3D形状压缩场景。

Abstract: Compressing 3D shapes is important for the efficiency of many applications, yet existing methods either cannot leverage dataset-level statistics or use a fixed compression ratio for all shapes. We propose a learned variable-length compression method that exploits structure across a training dataset while adapting compressed representation size to individual shape complexity using only fast feed-forward inference. Our method operates on general latent representations and improves rate-distortion for both meshes and signed distance fields. Code is available at https://github.com/voilalab/varlen-3D.

</details>


### [7] [Sketch, Don't Paint: Allocating Test-Time Compute in Generative Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21812)
*Sheng Lu,Guangpin Tao,Tong Lu,Ying Tai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 多模态推理模型"画图思考"的开销主要来自扩散去噪；论文把测试时算力分配到"何时画"与"画多少步"两个轴上，发现直接作答在多数情况更优，而在画图确实有益的场合，8步草图加多数投票即可超过50步完整渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交错式思维链中每个"视觉想法"都要跑完整的扩散采样流程，迭代去噪成为推理成本瓶颈；但现有工作默认"总是画图"，未系统研究视觉想法何时必要、需要多少去噪步数，导致算力浪费甚至精度下降。

Method: 通过仅改变"想法渲染方式"的受控干预实验，刻画视觉想法的三种模式（因果型、装饰型、有害型）；随后在14个模型-基准对上学一个分层选择器（直接作答/纯文本/视觉三档，每对仅10个标注样本）；在画图有益的场合提出 sketch-and-vote：从独立噪声采样8步草图（步数无标签选定），直到某答案获得3票。

Result: 8步草图在准确率上接近50步渲染，其计划一致性相当于两次独立完整渲染的一致率；视频模型中失败主要表现为提前停滞从而弃答。直接作答在14对中9对胜出；分层选择把平均准确率从60.7%（总是画）提升至65.1%。sketch-and-vote 在图像推理器与两个视频推理器上均超过完整渲染且去噪步更少，VSP空间规划提升8.6点，迷宫任务提升9.6与22.1点。

Conclusion: 视觉思考并非总是必要，其价值取决于模型与任务；早期去噪步已足以承载计划信息，因而可用短草图替代完整渲染，并通过投票聚合多个低成本样本；"按需画、少步画、多投几票"是更优的测试时算力分配策略。

Abstract: Multimodal models increasingly reason by synthesizing pixels, sketching maze paths within interleaved chains of thought or rolling out video solutions frame by frame. Each visual thought runs the full diffusion schedule inherited from photorealistic synthesis, so iterative denoising dominates inference cost. We study how to allocate test-time compute along two axes: when to render visual thoughts rather than thinking in text or answering directly, and how many denoising steps each thought requires. Controlled interventions that vary only how the thought is rendered uncover three regimes. Causal thoughts carry the plan and become legible early: an 8-step sketch nearly matches a 50-step render in accuracy, commits to the same plan as often as two independent full renders agree, and in video models mostly fails by stalling short of the goal, so the rollout abstains. Decorative thoughts can be omitted without loss, whereas harmful thoughts lower accuracy. Because the regime depends on both model and task, always drawing is suboptimal. Where drawing pays, we propose sketch-and-vote, which samples 8-step sketches (a step count chosen without labels) from independent noises until one answer reaches three votes. With this one setting, sketch-and-vote beats full rendering with fewer denoising steps on an image reasoner and two video reasoners, by 8.6 points on VSP spatial planning and by 9.6 and 22.1 points on mazes.

</details>


### [8] [Rethinking Perceptual Similarity for Remote Sensing: Multi-Layer Attention Scoring and Human Preference Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21816)
*Eli Underwood,Marc Bosch,Neil Joshi,Jeffrey Wen,Myron Brown*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出面向遥感生成图像的人类对齐感知质量度量 RSPD，基于 RemoteCLIP 分层 AAS 响应构建，并在自建 2AFC 基准与错位基准上验证优于全局嵌入余弦距离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然图像感知相似度度量迁移到遥感图像效果差：严重的地理空间与语义错误在视觉上仍可能显得合理，却对下游任务决定性错误，因此需要专门的人类对齐感知质量度量。

Abstract: Perceptual similarity metrics for natural images transfer poorly to remote sensing (RS), where severe geospatial and semantic failures can remain visually plausible while still being decisively wrong for downstream use. Using the layer-wise Aligned Attention Score (AAS) responses in RemoteCLIP, we find that different RS artifacts are best captured at different depths. Based on these findings, we introduce Remote Sensing Perceptual Distance (RSPD), a pairwise metric that averages seven independently calibrated layer distances without tuning on human-preference labels. To evaluate our metric on realistic RS generation tasks, we construct a blind, reference-conditioned two-alternative forced-choice (2AFC) benchmark with five 300-triplet subsets spanning synthetic artifacts, airborne and spaceborne super-resolution, SAR-to-optical translation, and timeseries controls. </details>

TL;DR: 提出基于V-JEPA 2.1预测残差的深度伪造检测框架，仅训练8.25M参数（占2.47%），在FF++上训练后在Celeb-DFv2上达到90.5 AUC，并通过正/反向一致性边距对比证明边距方向影响跨数据集泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器依赖生成器特定伪影，在同源数据集表现好，但跨数据集时性能显著下降。作者希望利用预测式视频模型捕捉"自然视频先验"，以获得比生成器伪影更可迁移的泛化信号。

Result: 模型仅含8.25M可训练参数（总334M的2.47%）；仅在FF++训练即在Celeb-DFv2取得90.5 AUC，并在多个跨数据集基准上表现良好。反向边距设置平均跨数据集泛化差距更大，说明边距方向影响跨域迁移。消融显示：幅度-方向解耦、降低数据集特异变化、低秩投影均提升跨数据集泛化。

Conclusion: 预测式视频模型的一致性边距可作为跨数据集泛化的有效信号；方向性（正/反向边距）是影响迁移的关键因素，而非仅残差幅度；参数高效适配（LoRA + 轻量头）即可在小训练集上获得强跨域检测性能。

Abstract: Deepfake detectors often perform well on the dataset they are trained on, but their performance drops when tested on videos from different datasets. In this paper, we study whether a predictive video model can provide a signal that generalizes better across datasets. Instead of relying only on generator-specific artifacts, as many existing detectors do, we use a model trained to predict natural video and measure the difference between what it predicts and what it observes in a video. Using V-JEPA 2.1, we keep the encoder frozen and adapt the predictor using rank-16 LoRA. We define the difference between the predictor output and the frozen encoder target as the prediction residual. We hypothesize that manipulated clips produce, on average, larger prediction residuals than authentic clips, and use this as our consistency-margin prior. We process these residuals using a lightweight Latent Consistency Head (LCH), which separates residual magnitude from direction for training and classification. To test whether the direction of the consistency margin affects cross-dataset generalization, we compare standard and reversed margin objectives while keeping the remaining training setup fixed. We match the two settings on FF++ validation performance before evaluating them on unseen data. The reversed-margin setting exhibits a larger cross dataset generalization gap on average, providing evidence that the direction of the consistency margin affects cross-dataset transfer. Our complete model adds only 8.25M trainable parameters, which is 2.47% of the total 334M parameters. Trained only on FF++, it achieves an AUC of 90.5 on Celeb-DFv2 and performs well across several other cross-dataset benchmarks. Our ablations show that separating residual magnitude from direction, reducing dataset-specific variation, and using a low-rank projection improve cross-dataset generalization in our experiments.

</details>


### [10] [AR-WAM: efficient streaming world-action modeling for autonomous driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21851)
*Baiting Luo,Shatadal Mishra,Ahmadreza Moradipari,Nejib Ammar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AR-WAM：一种高效流式世界-动作模型，将自回归时序建模与单次前向的未来条件化结合，用于自动驾驶轨迹生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶既需预测交通演化，又需快速响应新观测。视频基础模型具备前者，但反复编码历史与迭代式视频生成使其在驾驶任务中开销高昂，因此需要兼顾预测能力与推理效率的方案。

Method: 以因果视频骨干实现增量式视觉上下文更新并复用历史计算；提出假设：由近期观测计算出的未来特征可在不迭代生成视频的前提下提升动态交通下的泛化；方法在一次前向传播中获得这些未来特征并以之条件化轨迹生成；随后用强化学习通过直接优化驾驶奖励改进策略。

Result: 单前视相机、NAVSIM-v1 上：监督训练后 91.5 PDMS，强化学习后 94.0 PDMS，优于所对比的强端到端世界-动作模型；在连续驾驶的动态设定中，监督版 AR-WAM 跨决策保留视觉历史，优于强世界-动作基线。

Conclusion: 因果化、单次前向的未来条件化可替代迭代视频生成，在显著降低计算成本的同时保持甚至提升驾驶性能；结合强化学习可进一步增益，并支持长时连续驾驶中的历史复用。

Abstract: Autonomous driving requires anticipating how traffic will evolve while responding quickly to new observations. Video foundation models offer the first ability, but repeated history encoding and iterative video generation make them costly to use for driving. We present AR-WAM, an efficient streaming world-action model that combines autoregressive temporal modeling with single-pass future conditioning. Because its video backbone is causal, AR-WAM updates its visual context incrementally, reusing past computation and conditioning future prediction on observed motion. We further hypothesize that future features computed from recent observations can improve generalization in dynamic traffic without iterative video generation. AR-WAM therefore obtains these features in one forward pass and uses them to condition trajectory generation, and reinforcement learning then improves the policy through direct optimization of driving rewards. With a single front camera, AR-WAM achieves 91.5 PDMS after supervised training and 94.0 after reinforcement learning on NAVSIM-v1, outperforming the compared strong end-to-end world-action models. In a dynamic setting of continuous driving, supervised AR-WAM keeps its visual history across decisions and outperforms strong world-action baselines.

</details>


### [11] [FaceRiff: Data-Efficient Unified Text-to-3D Face Asset Synthesis via Geometric Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21867)
*Elly Akhoundi,Mathieu Lamarre,Thibault Goyallon,Patrick Anderson,Étienne Danvoye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FaceRiff：基于SDXL+任务专用LoRA、以UV法线图作几何条件的统一文本驱动3D人脸资产（网格/反照率/位移）生成框架，仅用2049次扫描、单GPU训练、每任务更新<3%参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率、UV映射一致且含反照率与PBR位移的人脸数据稀缺；现有3D人脸生成方法速度慢、单模态或依赖大规模专用数据集，而图像扩散模型虽含强人脸先验，却不能原生输出光照无关纹理、毛孔级位移与UV对齐几何。

Result: 相比FaceG2E与DreamFace，在保持提示对齐与固定拓扑UV一致性的同时获得更高逐提示多样性；可生成适用于PBR重打光的光照无关反照率及先前基线缺失的毛孔级位移；45位业界专家盲测显示感知真实感显著高于DreamFace，接近真实采集。

Conclusion: 预训练扩散先验可在有限数据条件下适配于统一3D人脸资产合成，验证了数据与参数高效的多任务统一生成范式的可行性。

Abstract: High-resolution facial datasets with consistent UV-mapped geometry, albedo, and physically based displacement are scarce, yet such assets are essential for photorealistic digital-human rendering. Existing 3D face generation methods are often slow, single-modality, or require large specialized datasets. Meanwhile, large image diffusion models encode strong facial priors but do not natively produce lighting-independent textures, pore-scale displacement, or UV-aligned geometry. We present FaceRiff, a unified, data- and parameter-efficient framework for generating complete 3D face assets (mesh, albedo, and displacement) directly from text in a shared UV space. FaceRiff adapts a pretrained SDXL backbone with task-specific LoRA adapters and uses UV normal maps as geometric conditioning: per-instance normals guide albedo and displacement synthesis, while a dataset-mean normal provides a canonical spatial anchor for mesh generation. Using only 2,049 scans from approximately 350 identities and training on a single GPU, FaceRiff updates less than 3% of the backbone parameters per task and produces render-ready 3D face assets without per-instance optimization. Compared with FaceG2E and DreamFace, FaceRiff produces greater per-prompt diversity while preserving prompt alignment and fixed-topology UV consistency, and additionally generates lighting-independent albedo suitable for PBR relighting and pore-scale displacement absent from prior text-driven baselines. A blind study with 45 industry professionals shows that FaceRiff achieves substantially higher perceived realism than DreamFace, approaching that of real captures. Overall, FaceRiff demonstrates that pretrained diffusion priors can be adapted to unified 3D face asset synthesis under limited data.

</details>


### [12] [Domain-Tuned Diffusion Super-Resolution for 4K Facial Asset Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21890)
*Elly Akhoundi,Mathieu Lamarre,Thibault Goyallon,Patrick Anderson,Étienne Danvoye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 面向4K影视级面部资产，提出一种领域适配的扩散上采样器，将1K反照率与置换（位移）图放大4倍至4K。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 影视级写实面部资产需要4K反照率与置换图，但生成式流程通常只输出1K；直接套用照片超分不合适：面部UV图具有领域特定统计特性，且置换图是标量高度场，误差会直接扭曲几何。

Conclusion: 轻量级领域适配即可产出可直接用于渲染的4K面部资产贴图，验证了低成本迁移扩散先验在专业贴图超分上的有效性。

Abstract: Physically based facial assets require 4K albedo and displacement maps for cinematic close-ups, yet generative pipelines commonly produce them at only 1K. Starting from a bilinearly upsampled map, we adapt a frozen SDXL backbone per modality with lightweight LoRA modules, while a Tile ControlNet preserves input structure as the diffusion prior restores pore- and wrinkle-scale detail. On held-out maps, our method produces sharper, more faithful detail than bilinear and off-the-shelf GAN and diffusion super-resolvers, reducing albedo LPIPS from 0.21 to 0.08 while avoiding misplaced or excessive displacement relief. These results show that lightweight domain adaptation can produce render-ready 4K facial asset maps without a custom super-resolution architecture.

</details>


### [13] [Temporal Pseudo-RGB Encoding for Label-Free Detection of VEEV Infection in Human Brain Endothelial Cells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21892)
*Zhengjie Zhu,Stephanie Valdez Trefry,Hao Lu,Abbas Alili,Yongxin Guo,Aarthi Narayanan,Metin Nafi Gurcan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将t−6 h、t−3 h、t三帧相差明场图像堆叠为RGB通道构造"时间伪彩色"编码，使形态变化转化为颜色信号，从而可直接用ImageNet预训练CNN在感染轨迹上训练；在VEEV TC-83感染HBMVEC细胞的无标记检测中，多任务CNN同时预测感染状态与时相，准确率达91.6%，显著优于单帧模型的87.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无标记病毒感染的检测对抗病毒筛选与病原监测至关重要，但多数深度学习方法只分析单帧图像，未建模时间演进过程；同时现有方法往往需要网络结构改造或昂贵的时序模型。

Method: 提出时间伪RGB编码：把三个时间偏移的明场帧（t−6 h、t−3 h、t）分别作为R、G、B通道堆叠成单张图像，将细胞形态变化编码为颜色差异，使标准ImageNet预训练CNN无需结构修改即可利用时间信息。在人脑微血管内皮细胞（HBMVEC）感染委内瑞拉马脑炎病毒TC-83体系上，训练多任务网络，单次前向同时输出感染/模拟对照分类与时相回归。评估采用留一孔行交叉验证（leave-one-row-out），三次实验run、36孔全部折外评分；与单帧模型及其他时序模型（循环网络、3D卷积、ViT-B/16）对比。

Result: 感染分类准确率91.6%，单帧模型为87.4%（配对差+4.2个百分点，95% CI [+2.5, +6.1]；sign-flip p=3×10⁻⁵；孔级推断）。在晚期终点（40–48 h，浮细胞与碎片使常规明场图像难判读）优势扩大至+23.9个百分点（95% CI [+19.2, +28.9]）。固定行划分下时相回归MAE=1.31 h（R²=0.975）。在所测试的时序模型中该编码平均准确率最高，且成本远低于循环与3D卷积方案。

Conclusion: 时间伪RGB编码是一种低成本、无需改网络的时序建模策略，可显著提升无标记病毒感染检测性能，尤其适用于晚期难判读图像；但其相对单帧模型的优势是唯一统计显著的比较，ViT-B/16骨干未获得相应增益，因此结论限于卷积骨干与该病毒-细胞体系。

Abstract: Label-free detection of viral infection is central to antiviral screening and pathogen surveillance. Most deep-learning methods analyze individual frames and do not model temporal progression. We evaluate temporal pseudo-RGB encoding, which stacks three time-offset brightfield frames ($t{-}6$ h, $t{-}3$ h, $t$) as the red, green, and blue channels of a single image so that morphological change becomes color and an ImageNet-pretrained convolutional neural network (CNN) can be trained on infection trajectories without architectural modification. In human brain microvascular endothelial cells (HBMVEC) infected with Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus (VEEV) TC-83, a multi-task network predicts infected-versus-mock status and time post-infection in one forward pass. Across three experimental runs under leave-one-row-out cross-validation, with all 36 wells scored out of fold, the encoding reaches 91.6% accuracy against 87.4% for the single-frame model (paired difference $+4.2$ percentage points, 95% CI $[+2.5, +6.1]$; sign-flip $p = 3\times10^{-5}$; well-level inference, conditional on three runs). At the late-phase endpoint (40-48 h), where floating cells and debris can make conventional brightfield images difficult to interpret, the advantage widens to $+23.9$ points (95% CI $[+19.2, +28.9]$). Time post-infection is recovered on the fixed row split with MAE = 1.31 h ($R^2 = 0.975$). Among the temporal models tested the encoding has the highest mean accuracy, at a fraction of the cost of the recurrent and 3D convolutional alternatives, though only its margin over the single-frame model is resolved; the tested ViT-B/16 backbone showed no corresponding gain, so the finding is limited to convolutional backbones and this virus-cell system.

</details>


### [14] [REEL: Brain-Guided Video Generation and Selection by Reranking Encoder Embeddings with Linear Decoding from fMRI data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21907)
*Fabrizio Spera,Tommaso Boccato,Moein Khajehnejad,Nicola Toschi,Matteo Ferrante*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出REEL框架（线性语义解码器+预训练视频生成器+三条神经编码流+贝叶斯式候选生成-重排序），在CC2017和BMD数据集上将视频50路识别准确率分别由0.2359提升至0.2434、由0.3653提升至0.3920，表明重排序是一种更简洁有效的视频脑解码改进策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态图像视觉脑解码已取得显著进展，但视频重建仍受限于快速变化的视频刺激与BOLD响应慢动力学之间的时间失配；同时，现有流程日趋复杂，作者希望探索更概念简洁的替代路线。

Method: 在CC2017与BOLD Moments Dataset (BMD)上评估贝叶斯启发的"提议—重排序"策略：由线性语义解码器、预训练视频生成器，以及三条神经编码流（ridge读出，其中两条流采用学习式池化）组成REEL（Reranking Encoder Embeddings with Linear decoding）框架。

Result: 相比单一生成候选，重排序使CC2017三名被试的平均Video 50-way准确率从0.2359升至0.2434，BMD十名被试从0.3653升至0.3920。

Conclusion: 重排序为提升视频脑解码性能提供了一种概念更简单、可作为复杂流水线补充方向的替代策略。

Abstract: Visual brain decoding from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data has made remarkable progress in recent years, driven by increasingly powerful artificial intelligence (AI) models and the growing availability of large-scale public datasets. However, despite the impressive advances achieved in static image decoding, the reconstruction of videos from fMRI signals remains challenging due to the temporal mismatch between rapidly changing video stimuli and the slow dynamics of the blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) response. We evaluate a Bayesian-inspired proposal-and-rerank strategy on CC2017 and the BOLD Moments Dataset (BMD), using a linear semantic decoder, a pretrained video generator, and three neural encoding streams with ridge readouts and learned pooling in two streams. We refer to this framework as REEL (Reranking Encoder Embeddings with Linear decoding). Compared with a single generated candidate, reranking increases mean Video 50-way accuracy from 0.2359 to 0.2434 across three CC2017 participants and from 0.3653 to 0.3920 across ten BMD participants. These findings suggest an alternative and conceptually simpler strategy for improving video brain decoding, highlighting the potential of our approach as a complementary direction to increasingly complex pipelines.

</details>


### [15] [Wrong Input, Wrong Threshold: Re-evaluating Adversarial Facial Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21923)
*Tunahan Parlayıcı,Erchan Aptoula,Yücel Saygın*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文指出已有面部隐私（对抗保护）方法宣称的>90%保护率源于评估协议的三处缺陷（输入前端、度量方式、阈值标定），并给出以配对余弦偏移为核心的修正评测框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2022年以来发表的face-privacy方法普遍报告超过90%的黑盒识别防护成功率，但该数字来自存在三重独立缺陷的评测协议：输入为整图或检测框而非部署流程的检测-对齐-裁剪前端；用成功率差值作为度量，会饱和且无法反映底层效应大小；沿用2021年的四个阈值常数未做重标定。作者希望揭示这些缺陷并对评测进行修正。

Abstract: Published face-privacy methods report protection above 90% against black-box recognition models. The input is wrong: methods published since 2022 feed the network the whole photograph, or a detector's box, where deployed systems detect, align to a landmark template and crop. Re-scoring the same files through a realistic front end costs a standard transfer attack 56% of its dodging protection and a budget-allocating attack 7%, with no image regenerated. The measure is wrong: that loss is a difference of success rates, so it saturates, moving by 8.2x over a budget sweep while the effect beneath it moves by 1.34x. We therefore report the paired cosine shift, in which both thresholds cancel algebraically, so the input defect holds without committing to a calibration. Measured that way it is 2.2x and 10.7x larger on three unseen recognizers, and at matched budget it reverses the L-infinity transfer ranking: the one surveyed method that aligns at evaluation gains 0.18 where MI-FGSM loses 0.05. *Jugal Gajjar,Kamalasankari Subramaniakuppusamy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"引用差"（cite gap）这一无需人工标注的干预式指标：遮蔽模型自身推理链所引用的区域，与遮蔽同帧同尺寸的对照区域，比较正确答案翻转比例的配对差值。2–3B 视频语言模型在 CLEVRER 上 cite gap 为 0.089，在 NExT-QA 上仅 0.003；而两者的引用框均能通过常规 grounding 检查，说明"可核验且有相关性"并不等于"答案依赖该区域"。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 grounded reasoning chain 的评估只检验引用是否可定位（cite 一个 frame span 和一个 box），读者能核对"模型看了哪里"，却无法回答"答案是否真的依赖被引用区域"这一问题。常规 grounding 检查对 citation 与答案的因果依赖不敏感，存在评估盲区。

Conclusion: NExT-QA 的链被监督去引用"多数帧可见实体"的两帧，因此低 cite gap 正是该监督信号的预期结果，但常规 grounded chain 检查看不到这一点。引用可以既可核验又相关，而答案并不依赖它；评估 grounded reasoning 时应移除链所"命名"的对象，而不只是它"指向"的位置。

Abstract: A grounded reasoning chain cites a frame span and a box for every step, so a reader can check where the model looked. Whether the answer depends on the cited region is a different question. We test it by intervention: the regions a model cited in its own chain are blacked out, and the share of correct answers that flip is compared with blacking out boxes of the same size elsewhere on the same frames. The paired difference, the cite gap, needs no annotation. We apply it to 2-3B video-language models trained on exact CLEVRER chains and on pseudo-labelled NExT-QA chains. Pooled over models, masking the cited boxes flips 2.2 times as many correct answers as the control on CLEVRER and 1.1 times as many on NExT-QA, also among the answers that depend on the video at all, while the boxes pass a grounding check on both. </details>

Abstract: Making automated vehicles accessible requires consideration of vulnerable road users, including wheelchair users. *Oleg Komogortsev,Mehedi Hasan Raju*

TL;DR: 论文推导出生物特征识别EER与特征数量、测试-重测相关性及持久性离散度之间的解析定律，并用多种模态数据验证。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: A biometric designer controls the number of features and their temporal persistence. The central extension lets persistence vary across comparisons with spread $τ$ on Fisher's scale: $\mathrm{EER}=Φ(-m/(\sqrt{τ^2+v}+\sqrt{v}))$ with $v=1/(N_{\mathrm{eff}}-2)$, which for a normal spread has a floor $Φ(-m/τ)$ that no number of features can lower. With no fitted parameter the simple law reproduces published simulations and the EER-ICC line, and predicts the KCC-EER relation of eye-movement embeddings on GazeBase ($R^2=0.88$), though less well on GazeBaseVR ($0.63$). The 61 eye-movement, keystroke and ECG conditions check consistency on the same scores; the 40 face conditions use held-out subjects, with the same accuracy. </details>

*Alexandra G. Roberts,Tonmoy Hossain,Mark Olchanyi,Stefan Brandstätter,Jonathan Williams Ramirez,Ana Lawry Aguila,Matthew Rosen,Annabel Sorby-Adams,W. Taylor Kimberly,Juan Eugenio Iglesias*

Abstract: Hospital brain imaging archives hold a diverse array of pathology at sample sizes beyond prospective studies, particularly for underrepresented populations and diseases. Our single model exceeds or performs comparably to contrast-specific anomaly detectors trained on real scans and keeps healthy anatomy intact. The same generator trains networks for super-resolution and for registration in the presence of pathology.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) achieves impressive zero-shot image classification performance by comparing image embeddings against class-specific text embeddings. </details>

TL;DR: 本文以MegaLoc为外观基线，在WildCross基准上系统评估时序、语言、结构、几何四类上下文表征对森林VPR的提升能力，发现仅分数空间序列匹配在保持高精度召回上有效，其余上下文表征未带来一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 森林环境中的视觉位置识别受重复植被及光照、季节、视角变化影响，不同地点易被误认为相似、重访地点又显得差异很大；作者希望探究时序、语言、结构、几何上下文能否在纯外观描述子之上带来增益，并厘清各表征失效的边界。

Conclusion: 上下文并非普适增益：分数空间序列匹配是当前最有效的补充手段，语言、结构与几何表征受限于判别力、候选召回与匹配稳健性，未来需针对性改进这些瓶颈而非简单堆叠上下文。

Abstract: Visual place recognition (VPR) in forest environments remains challenging because repetitive vegetation, and changes in illumination, season, and viewpoint can make distinct places appear similar and revisited places appear substantially different. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作（光照估计、人像重打光）都在拍摄之后编辑光照，无法在拍摄前指导灯位。核心开放问题：灯应该放在哪里才能最好地照亮人脸？且实际场景存在不可控的环境光与补光灯的混合，需要将二者解耦。

Method: 1) 用成对人类判断学习 Bradley-Terry 质量模型，给出以偏好定义的光照质量目标；2) 感知头（perception head）以冻结的自监督特征为输入，通过 cross-attention 回归球谐光照；3) 利用球谐系数的线性可加性分离出补光灯的光照分量，并优化其可达位置（placement solver）完成逆向布光。

Result: 在留出环境上取得 oracle 改进的 87.8%；相对忽略环境光的传统求解器提升 28.4%（相对），相对使用常用 DPR 估计器的同流程提升 70.5%（相对）。在未见身份的真实 OLAT 人脸上达到 73.2%；在自采真实数据上将灯方向误差降低 37.7%。

Conclusion: LightMatch 将人像布光从"拍后编辑"转为"拍前指导"，验证了偏好驱动的质量模型与球谐线性分解相结合可用于可控光源的定位，并在合成与真实场景中均优于基线，为摄影布光提供可操作的预测工具。

Abstract: Portraits shape first impressions, and lighting is an important factor. Prior work, such as lighting estimation and portrait relighting, edits lighting after capture but does not guide where to place a light before the shot. This leaves an open question: where should a light go to best light a face? Therefore, we propose LightMatch, a preference-grounded inverse lighting framework that disentangles the controllable light from ambient illumination and optimizes its placement. We first learn a Bradley-Terry quality model from pairwise human judgments. A perception head then regresses spherical-harmonic lighting from frozen self-supervised features via cross-attention. Finally, a placement solver isolates the light via spherical-harmonic linearity and optimizes its reachable position. On held-out environments, LightMatch attains 87.8% of the oracle improvement, outperforming the conventional solver that ignores ambient light by a relative 28.4% and the same pipeline with the widely used DPR estimator by a relative 70.5%. It reaches 73.2% on real OLAT faces of unseen identities and, on our real captures, cuts lamp-direction error by 37.7%.

</details>

*Zhixu Du,Kuo Yang,Jingwei Sun,Hai "Helen" Li,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BATMoS，一种预算感知的时间混合策略，在扩散去噪轨迹上按幅度规则在新鲜CFG与缓存引导间路由，无需额外训练或阈值搜索，即可在固定推理预算下获得更优视频生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散模型推理预算的有效性取决于计算在去噪轨迹上的分配位置：八种等预算配置下VBench总分相差达4.80分，说明显式分配设计至关重要。作者的关键观察是引导（guidance）评估在扩散时间上的价值并不均等。

Abstract: The effectiveness of a video diffusion model's inference budget depends on where computation is spent along the denoising trajectory. Across eight equal-budget inference configurations, VBench total scores span 4.80 points, highlighting the importance of explicit allocation design. Our key insight is that guidance evaluations are not equally valuable across diffusion time: retaining the sampling updates while selectively reusing guidance can preserve generation quality with fewer denoiser evaluations. We introduce BATMoS (Budget Aware Temporal Mixture of Strategies), which routes between fresh classifier-free guidance and cached guidance using a single pretrained denoiser. A magnitude-based temporal rule assigns guidance reuse to low-magnitude blocks and reserves fresh guidance for the remaining blocks, with a single integer controlling the computation budget. The resulting schedule requires no additional router training or per-budget threshold search. Evaluated on CogVideoX-2B with 4,720 videos per configuration across all sixteen official VBench dimensions, BATMoS achieves the highest total score among the eight allocation policies and comes within 0.10 points of full classifier-free guidance using 20\% fewer branch evaluations. BATMoS also composes with feature reuse, reducing computation from 80 to 62 effective branch evaluations with a 0.11-point decrease in total score. These findings make temporal guidance allocation a practical mechanism for extracting more generation quality from a fixed inference budget.

</details>

Abstract: Harmful algal blooms threaten water quality and public health, yet automated segmentation of bloom regions in freshwater imagery is limited by scarce pixel-level annotations.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Distribution planners need installation-level inventories of rooftop photovoltaic (PV) capacity, but interconnection records may be incomplete or spatially aggregated. Conventional image-based estimators segment PV arrays, convert the mask to physical area, and multiply by an estimated power density, coupling capacity prediction to mask-derived area. We propose Direct Head, a segmentation-guided architecture that retains U-Net segmentation and soft-mask pooling while directly regressing nonnegative capacity from PV-region features and area descriptors. We evaluate three independent runs on 7,590 French rooftop installations under the original split and a department-based holdout. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM 需要既能提取细粒度视觉特征、又具语义解耦与判别性的视觉编码器。但对比学习以压制类内变异换取类间区分，生成式重建强调感知保真却缺乏显式比较监督；直接用复合损失聚合二者，会因共享隐空间中的梯度干扰引发优化冲突与不稳定。因此需要一个统一范式的表示学习目标。

Method: 提出统一表示学习范式：把生成式重建重新表述为生成输出流形内的判别性排序问题。保留感知重建作为监督信号，同时通过系统化地对匹配/不匹配重建输出排序来引入排序判别约束，使判别信息嵌入生成过程，缓解损失竞争。具体给出 AUCGR（优化 ROC 曲线下面积，保证匹配对得分高于不匹配对）与 pAUCGR（聚焦可靠特征子空间内的不匹配比较，缓解监督偏差）。目标函数即插即用，无需修改现有生成式重建框架的架构。

Conclusion: 将判别监督以排序形式内嵌于生成式重建，可规避复合损失的目标冲突，是统一判别性与感知保真表示学习的有效且易部署的方案。

Main category: cs.CV

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 色偏通常被认为来自场景或相机，并由修图模型消除。作者发现一个被忽视的失效模式：超轻量修图网络即使在"干净"输入上也会输出偏绿的人脸皮肤，因为（1）它未能充分恢复被退化过程去除的肤色色度，（2）自身引入微小色相偏移。更关键的是，常用的"合成自监督"（对高质量图像加退化再学习复原）这种免配对数据配方会悄然产生该色偏，而整帧PSNR/SSIM几乎不变，使得该问题在常规评估中被掩盖。

Conclusion: 合成自监督这一免配对配方会引入整帧指标无法察觉的肤色绿色色偏，图像级损失无法修复甚至加剧；本文的逐像素皮肤掩膜非对称绿过量损失以零参数代价有效抑制色偏并具跨架构通用性，但其作用仅针对绿-品红符号轴，而非整体肤色保真度，因此会在近中性肤色上造成品红过校正——这说明肤色评估需采用区域化、符号感知的指标而非仅依赖整帧PSNR/SSIM。

Abstract: Color casts are expected to come from the scene or camera, and a retouching model removes them. *Zihao Han,Philippe De Wilde*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应融合虽能修复静态集成中的错误，但同样可能推翻原本正确的决策，缺乏风险控制机制；因此需要一个既能获得自适应增益、又能保证不劣于静态参考的系统。

Abstract: Adaptive fusion can repair a static ensemble's errors, but can also overturn correct decisions. RetiDual-Select combines retinal specialist RETFound with the image encoder of the medical vision-language model MedSigLIP, separating candidate fusion, routing safety and predictive review. Calibrated product-of-experts (PoE) fusion is the static reference, a small gate proposes an alternative for each image, a validation-frozen harm guard decides whether that candidate may replace the reference, and a separate score prioritizes review. Static PoE reached the highest or joint-highest clean accuracy on all three datasets. At a clean 2% accepted-error target the review policy accepted 94.3% of Kermany-4 images at 99.89% selective accuracy, and 92.4% of OCT-C8 at 98.65%. Both branches were correct on 95.0% and 91.8% of clean images; only 4.4% and 6.2% had exactly one correct branch. In post-hoc validation-only analyses, gain was higher when the gate followed the more reliable branch, and a frozen guard cut the worst-condition OCT-C8 loss from 1.39 to 0.36 percentage points. Adaptive routing was useful when image quality created a reliability opportunity and the gate followed it; otherwise the system retained Static PoE or deferred for review. ### [33] [FrameSeg3D: Learned Local Frames for Segmenting Small Parts on High-Resolution 3D Scans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22124)
*Xinwen Zhang,Tongyan Wang,Huawei Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 高分辨率3D扫描中小部件（如指甲、牙齿）分割的精度瓶颈在于“视角”（方向与尺度），而非落在其上的点数；据此提出FrameSeg3D，先在低分辨率全局视图预测每个部件的局部坐标系（中心+朝向），再沿法向以扫描仪原始分辨率近距离分割，实现单一分割网络跨部件类型通用，并在指甲与牙齿任务上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率3D扫描上的小部件分割存在三大难点：①部件仅占扫描极小比例；②边界仅表现为高度与曲率的细微变化；③各部件朝向不同。现有方法分两类且均不足：一类整体处理扫描，点/网格网络需下采样以适应内存，导致小部件仅剩少量点，多视图方法渲染整物体使部件只占几像素且倾斜部件仅被侧视；另一类先定位部件再近距分割，但依赖特定部件先验（如牙弓形状），难以迁移到其他部件类型。作者的关键洞察是：精度受限于“部件被如何观测”（方向与尺度），而非采样点数。

Method: FrameSeg3D为两阶段框架：第一阶段从整体扫描的低分辨率视图预测每个部件的局部坐标系（中心与朝向法向）；第二阶段围绕该法向、以扫描仪原始分辨率生成多视图，使每个部件居中、正对相机并处于固定尺度，再进行分割。由于输入已规范化，同一分割网络可服务不同部件类型，并能从少量标注掩码中学习。

Conclusion: 将“分辨率分配”转化为“观测视角规范化”是解决高分辨率小部件分割的有效途径；局部坐标系预测使分割网络摆脱部件特定先验，具备跨类别通用性与较低的标注需求，同时在全分辨率下实现精确边界。

Abstract: Segmenting small parts on high-resolution 3D scans, such as nails on hand scans and teeth on intraoral scans, poses three challenges: 1) each part covers a tiny fraction of the scan, 2) its boundary is only a subtle change of height and curvature, and 3) it faces its own direction. Existing methods fall into two groups, and both fall short. The first group processes the whole scan at once and sees each part too coarsely. Point and mesh networks must shrink the scan to fit in memory, so a small part keeps only a few of its points. Multi-view methods render images of the whole object, so each part fills only a few pixels and a tilted part is seen from the side. The second group first finds each part and then segments it up close. But these methods find the parts with knowledge about one kind of part, for example the shape of the dental arch for teeth. Such knowledge does not carry over to other kinds of parts. We find that accuracy is limited by how a part is seen, from which direction and at what scale, not by how many points land on it. We therefore present FrameSeg3D. It first predicts a local frame for every part, its center and the direction it faces, from a low-resolution view of the whole scan. It then segments the part in views around its frame normal at the scanner's resolution, so covering the whole scan no longer costs resolution. Because every part arrives centered, facing the camera, and at a fixed scale, one segmentation network can serve different kinds of parts and learn from few labeled masks. </details>

*Yu Quan,Dong Zhang,Ping Gong,Peng Huang,JinHui Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出文本引导模态校正网络TMCNet，将文本语义注入区域特征提取、跨模态对齐与多尺度解码三个环节，在COCO-OVD与LVIS-OVD上取得较强开放词汇检测性能，并可扩展至开放词汇分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OVD方法存在三方面不足：对目标区域的文本引导不充分、跨模态对齐策略有限、跨层级互补特征利用不足，导致难以识别未见类别及不同尺度目标。

Method: 包含三个模块：(1) 文本引导模态编码器，将文本语义注入query以引导区域特征聚合，降低目标表征的语义歧义；(2) 跨模态对齐模块，通过视觉与文本特征交互强化区域表征与类别语义的对应；(3) 渐进式文本校正解码器，以自顶向下通路加横向连接，逐级融合文本引导的深层语义特征与同尺度浅层视觉特征。

Result: 在COCO-OVD和LVIS-OVD两个公开数据集上，仅使用简单文本查询即取得较强的开放词汇检测性能；迁移至开放词汇分割任务亦有性能提升。

Conclusion: 将文本引导贯穿区域特征提取、跨模态对齐与多尺度解码，可有效增强区域—类别语义对应并促进跨层级特征融合，兼具跨任务适用性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) is essential for detecting objects beyond the categories seen during training. Establishing vision-language associations is crucial for recognizing unseen categories, while integrating complementary visual features across levels supports detection at different scales. However, existing methods often provide insufficient textual guidance for object regions, rely on limited cross-modal alignment strategies, and underuse complementary features across levels, limiting their ability to detect unseen categories and objects of varying scales. To address these limitations, we propose a Text-Guided Modality Correction Network (TMCNet) that incorporates textual guidance into region feature extraction, cross-modal alignment, and multi-scale decoding to strengthen region-category semantic correspondence and promote complementary feature fusion across levels. First, a text-guided modality encoder incorporates textual semantics into queries to guide regional feature aggregation, reducing semantic ambiguity in object representations. Second, a cross-modal alignment module strengthens the correspondence between region representations and category semantics through interactions between visual and textual features. Finally, a progressive text correction decoder combines a top-down pathway with lateral connections to progressively fuse text-guided deep semantic features with shallow visual features at the corresponding scales, preserving both semantic information and spatial detail for objects of different sizes. Experiments on two public datasets, COCO-OVD and LVIS-OVD, demonstrate that TMCNet achieves strong performance in open-vocabulary object detection using simple text queries as guidance. Extending TMCNet to open-vocabulary segmentation also yields performance gains, demonstrating its cross-task applicability and extensibility.

</details>

Abstract: Short-video platforms are now a common way for the public to follow unfolding events. Their rapid, visually persuasive format also makes fake news easier to spread. On FakeSV and FakeTT, CEVA achieves the best overall results among the compared methods. Under fixed frame budgets and backbones, DBCR outperforms uniform, random, and similarity-based selection and improves two structurally different detectors. Abstract: In medical imaging, the alignment of multi-modal images plays a critical role in providing comprehensive information for image-guided therapies. INNReg consists of an image-to-image translation network that converts multi-modal images into mono-modal counterparts and a registration network that uses the translated mono-modal images to align the multi-modal images. Specifically, to ensure the preservation of geometric consistency after image translation, we introduce an Invertible Neural Network (INN) that leverages a dynamic depthwise convolution-based local attention mechanism. Additionally, we design a novel barrier loss function based on Normalized Mutual Information to impose constraints on the registration network, which enhances the registration accuracy. *M. Hadi Sepanj,Benyamin Ghojogh,Saed Moradi,Paul Fieguth*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Centroid Spectral Coupling (CSC)，一种单一损失项的自监督目标，将视角对齐、表示多样性与抗坍缩隐式耦合在一起；理论分析给出精确分解与全局最优几何刻画，实验表明其在 CIFAR-10/100 与 Imagenette 上线性评估优于所比较的非对比方法。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非对比自监督方法通常依赖多个加权损失项（对齐项、多样性项、正则项等）来同时实现增强视角对齐、保持表示多样性并防止坍缩，导致超参数耦合、调参复杂、各项之间权衡不透明。作者希望在单一目标的框架内隐式实现上述三重目标，避免分别加权。

Conclusion: 统一谱目标可在不显式使用对比负样本、也不分别加权对齐与多样性惩罚项的情况下，获得有竞争力的视觉表示，说明将对齐与多样性统一到单一谱形式是可行且有效的。

Abstract: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) aims to align augmented views while preserving representation diversity and preventing collapse. Existing non-contrastive methods often address these goals using multiple weighted loss terms. We introduce Centroid Spectral Coupling (CSC), a single-term SSL objective that implicitly couples view alignment, representation diversity, and collapse resistance. CSC constructs centroids from independently normalized augmented-view pairs and applies a ridge-based spectral objective to their uncentered second-moment matrix. Preserving centroid magnitudes encodes view agreement while encouraging balanced representation energy across spectral directions. We establish an exact decomposition into nonnegative alignment and spectral-imbalance components, characterize the geometry of global optima, and derive finite-loss guarantees for alignment and diversity. We also show that complete constant-output collapse is a strict saddle in normalized representation space. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Imagenette show that CSC achieves the highest linear Top-1 accuracy among the evaluated non-contrastive methods on all three benchmarks, and the highest kNN Top-1 accuracy on both CIFAR datasets. A ridge-parameter sensitivity study reveals an empirical alignment--diversity trade-off: increasing $κ$ strengthens view alignment but reduces representation effective rank. These results show that a unified spectral objective yields competitive visual representations without explicit contrastive negatives or separately weighted alignment and diversity penalties.

</details>

Abstract: Egocentric 3D hand pose estimators still miss hands at the image border, misplace occluded hands and jitter. Such failures are usually fixed by hand-written inference refinements and by fine-tuning, two interdependent steps that are tuned separately. We present HandRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework for a hand pose system that consists of a video estimator and its executable inference harness. In each round, coding agents refine the harness, and a change is accepted only if it improves a composite of all ten benchmark metrics on held-out data without significantly regressing any of them. The accepted harness then guides the estimator through selective distillation, which supervises hand presence and temporal consistency on frames without ground truth, while ground truth supervises pose. Since the updated estimator may change which refinements remain useful, the harness is re-validated on it. Starting from the released ACE-Ego-Hand model, five rounds reduce MPJPE-p by 35% on HOT3D and 11% on ARCTIC and roughly halve jitter. Under a unified protocol, it outperforms nine re-run published methods on all ten metrics of both benchmarks. Hypervolume selection on the accuracy-speed front yields Lite, Medium and Heavy systems running at 20.7 to 41.1 FPS. This report gives the full method, every stage of every round and the complete protocol. Code, evaluator, harnesses and weights are public.

</details>

*Soham Dan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CueClash 基准，分离二维图像线索与真实三维布局，发现主流 VLM 的 3D 关系判断高度依赖 2D 捷径，瓶颈位于"图像→布局"的转换步骤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 判断 3D 关系时，图像中的 2D 线索与真实地面布局通常一致，导致无法区分模型是真正推理 3D 布局还是利用 2D 捷径。需要人为解耦二者以量化捷径依赖。

Method: 构建 CueClash：渲染场景中使五种关系的 2D 线索在恰好一半陈述上正确、一半错误，定义"捷径差距"=线索正确时准确率 − 线索错误时准确率。测试 Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.6 Flash（低推理强度），并做对照实验：给定地面坐标与关系定义、像素测量加相机深度；同时分析模型自绘的俯视地图，并与人类观察者对比；最后在 CV-Bench 真实照片上验证。

Result: 捷径差距为 +18 至 +37 个百分点；剔除两个与边界案例/遮挡混淆的关系后为 +7 至 +29。给定地面坐标时准确率达 99–100%；对可穿过开口的物体，像素测量加相机深度可消除大部分差距。俯视地图多保留深度顺序但压缩深度；GPT-5.5 地图近似图像拷贝，Opus 与 Gemini 约恢复 0.6 的压缩量，Gemini 还额外施加均匀深度缩放；Opus 主要在"能否通过"关系上跟随图像，其深度校正程度与真实场景人类观察者相当。在 CV-Bench 中可靠 2D 线索误导时三模型同样掉点；两个开源模型中布局信息能到达语言模型，但其地图丢失了大量信息。

Conclusion: VLM 的 3D 关系错误并非源于关系推理本身，而源于从图像到布局的感知转换：模型易被 2D 捷径误导、深度被压缩。改进应聚焦于布局估计环节而非下游语言推理。

Abstract: A vision-language model (VLM) can judge 3-D relations from the picture or from the ground layout. In photographs the two usually agree. We separate them with CueClash, rendered scenes in which the 2-D cue for each of five relations is right on exactly half the statements. The shortcut gap is accuracy when the cue is right minus accuracy when it is wrong. For Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.6 Flash at low reasoning effort it is +18 to +37 percentage points. It is +7 to +29 without two relations whose cue-wrong items are confounded with borderline cases or occlusion. Given ground coordinates and each relation's definition, they answer 99 to 100% correctly. Pixel measurements with camera depths remove most of the gap for objects fitting through openings. The failure lies in the step from the picture to the layout. The maps that the models draw of the scene from above mostly keep the depth order but, like the picture, shorten depth. GPT-5.5's maps stay close to a copy of the picture. Opus 5.5's and Gemini's maps undo about 0.6 of this shortening. Gemini's then shrink all depths by a further uniform factor. Opus 5.5 follows the picture mainly on fits, and its maps correct depth about as much as human observers of real scenes do. The three models also lose accuracy on CV-Bench photographs where a reliable 2-D cue misleads. In two open models the layout information reaches the language model, but their maps lose much of it.

</details>

*Zhiyuan Yang,Jiahao Cheng,Vincent Quoc-Huy Trinh,Mahdi S. Hosseini*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算病理中高倍（20x）WSI保留细节但需编码大量patch、计算昂贵；低倍（5x）覆盖视野大、计算省但细节损失。现有跨倍率蒸馏直接匹配特征，而低倍输入无法获得高倍特征所编码的细节，存在"不可达"目标问题；且部分方法依赖切片级标签，限制可扩展性。
