We propose PRUDENT, which first answers with about half the budget and spends the saved tokens on re-answering the disagreeing questions at twice the budget. We show when such re-answering pays and why the small VLM should read the full image. On 18 benchmarks, PRUDENT outperforms eight existing pruning methods at the same average budget of visual tokens. Its lead widens as the budget tightens, and holds across five InternVL sizes. PRUDENT also has the highest average in two more model families. The disagreement of the small VLM flags most pruning failures of all eight methods, and re-answering on it also improves the two strongest with their own rankings. Other checkers give similar gains, and the extra tokens go where the first pass hurts the answer. These results suggest that identifying which pruned answers are trustworthy provides an additional lever for visual token pruning beyond the ranking of tokens. Code and data are available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/PRUDENT.

</details>


### [75] [LeViT-UNet++: Towards Balanced Fine-Grained Details and Context for Efficient Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22482)
*Guoping Xu,Jinling Zhu,Liuyue Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出高效编码器-解码器架构 LeViT-UNet++，通过 Haar 小波多尺度下采样与深度可分离卷积解码器，在低参数量下实现精度-效率良好平衡的医学图像分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床场景（手术导航、放疗、实时影像引导）需要快速且精准的分割。CNN 与 Transformer 虽进展显著，但在有限算力下难以兼顾精度：降低复杂度往往牺牲细粒度结构细节与全局上下文建模，形成不利的精度-效率权衡。

Method: 1) Haar Wavelet Multi-Scale Downsampling (HWMD)：将特征表示分解为低频与高频分量，提取多尺度结构信息，缓解下采样中的细节丢失；2) 基于深度可分离卷积的解码器：将 Transformer 块的多尺度全局表示与局部空间特征融合，实现渐进式特征细化并降低计算开销。

Result: 在 Synapse、ACDC、LA2018、MSD Heart 四个基准的 2D 与 3D 设置下评估，以紧凑参数量与快速推理取得有竞争力的精度。以 Synapse 为例：DSC 76.57%，仅 8.025M 参数，241.72 FPS。

Conclusion: 小波多尺度特征提取与轻量局部-全局特征融合的结合对高效医学分割有效，验证了 LeViT-UNet++ 在精度-效率平衡上的优势；代码已开源。

Abstract: Efficient medical image segmentation is essential for clinical applications requiring fast and accurate delineation, such as surgical navigation, radiation therapy, and real-time image-guided intervention. Despite substantial advances in convolutional neural networks and Transformers, attaining high accuracy under limited computational resources remains difficult, because reducing model complexity often sacrifices fine-grained structural details and global context modeling, yielding an unfavorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. To address this, we propose LeViT-UNet++, an efficient encoder-decoder architecture that better balances local detail preservation and global context modeling. Specifically, we introduce a Haar Wavelet Multi-Scale Downsampling (HWMD) module that decomposes feature representations into low- and high-frequency components to extract multi-scale structural information, thereby mitigating detail loss during downsampling. We further develop a depthwise convolution-based decoder that integrates multi-scale global representations from Transformer blocks with local spatial features, enabling progressive feature refinement while reducing computational overhead. Evaluated on four benchmarks (Synapse, ACDC, LA2018, and MSD Heart) under both 2D and 3D settings, LeViT-UNet++ achieves competitive accuracy with a compact parameter footprint and fast inference. On Synapse, for instance, it attains a DSC of 76.57% with only 8.025M parameters and 241.72 FPS, confirming a favorable accuracy-efficiency balance. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining wavelet-based multi-scale feature extraction with lightweight local-global feature fusion for efficient medical segmentation. The source code is available at https://github.com/apple1986/levit_unet_pp.

</details>


### [76] [Fast and Strong Image Protection against Diffusion Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22494)
*Jiwon Park,Jihye Kang,Namhyuk Ahn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出保护性扩散模型（PDM），一次训练即可对新图像通过多步去噪采样生成对抗扰动，用于阻止个性化文生图模型对人物照片的未授权复现；在面部与艺术作品上与9个基线对比最优，成本仅为迭代教师模型的十分之一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化文生图扩散模型可凭少量照片复现特定人物，因此需要在发布前对图像加扰动以使其微调失效（图像保护）。现有方法对每张图从零优化扰动，计算成本随图像数量线性增长，缺乏可摊销、可泛化的扰动生成器。

Method: PDM为一次性训练好的扩散式扰动生成模型，对每张新图像通过多步去噪采样得到扰动。训练上先蒸馏一个迭代优化教师模型，再以目标残差投影（TRP）损失作为奖励进行后训练，该目标强于现有保护目标。

Result: 在面部与艺术作品数据集上，PDM优于9个基线方法；性能接近其教师模型，而推理成本约为教师的十分之一。

Conclusion: 将图像保护从逐图优化重构为摊销式生成式建模是可行且高效的，扩散采样加TRP奖励后训练可在显著降低保护成本的同时保持强保护效果。

Abstract: Personalized text-to-image diffusion models can reproduce a person from a handful of photographs. Image protection perturbs each image before publication so that fine-tuning on it fails, but it optimizes every perturbation from scratch, so its cost grows with the number of images. We present the protective diffusion model (PDM), which is trained once and samples the perturbation of a new image over many denoising steps. PDM distills an iterative teacher and is then post-trained with the target residual projection (TRP) loss as a reward, a stronger objective than existing ones. PDM outperforms nine baselines on faces and artworks and nearly matches its teacher at a tenth of the cost.

</details>


### [77] [Motion-Aware Reward Modeling for Instruction-Guided Video Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22495)
*Li Li,Xiangbo Gao,Bo Ni,Samyadeep Basu,Viet Dac Lai,Jing Shi,Seunghyun Yoon,Gang Wu,Yu Wang,Thien Huu Nguyen,Tyler Derr,Franck Dernoncourt,Zhengzhong Tu,Yue Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 指令引导视频编辑的奖励模型存在“运动坍缩”问题（偏好时序一致性而牺牲运动），本文提出显式建模运动的运动感知奖励模型，将误选运动抑制候选的比例从97%降至0%，并与人评的Spearman相关达0.57。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有奖励模型可能以牺牲运动为代价换取时序一致性。在VE-Bench上，复合奖励在97%的情况下更偏好运动被抑制的候选；学习式视频奖励与VLM评判器对轻度运动抑制同样不敏感，且潜空间优化与奖励引导微调会利用该弱点。线性探针在轻度抑制下接近随机水平，说明缺乏显式帧间动态输入。

Method: 提出运动感知奖励模型：(1) 引入RGB帧差分支显式编码帧间动态；(2) 以运动抑制样本与伪造运动负样本进行偏好训练；(3) 加入蒸馏锚点以保持与人类质量判断的对齐。通过真实编辑的运动抑制变体进行受控分析。

Result: 在VE-Bench运动阶梯上，运动抑制候选选择率由97%降至0%；与人评质量的Spearman相关系数为0.57；可检测未见过的抑制变体；在两条编辑流水线的奖励引导微调中能保持运动。

Conclusion: 结果支持在视频编辑奖励中显式建模运动，运动感知奖励可缓解运动坍缩并保持人类偏好对齐。

Abstract: Reward models for instruction-guided video editing can favor temporal consistency at the expense of motion. We study this failure, termed \emph{motion collapse}, using controlled motion-suppression variants of real edits. On VE-Bench, the evaluated composite reward prefers a motion-suppressed candidate in $97\%$ of cases. Learned video rewards and a VLM judge also struggle with mild suppression, while latent optimization and reward-guided fine-tuning exploit this weakness to increase reward as motion declines. A linear probe of our base reward backbone performs near chance on mild suppression, motivating an explicit inter-frame dynamics input. We propose a motion-aware reward model that combines an RGB frame-difference stream with preference training against motion-suppressed and fabricated-motion negatives. A distillation anchor preserves alignment with human quality judgments. On the VE-Bench motion ladder, our model reduces the rate of selecting motion-suppressed candidates to $0\%$ while achieving a Spearman correlation of $0.57$ with human quality ratings. It also detects unseen suppression variants and preserves motion during reward-guided fine-tuning on two editing pipelines. These results support explicitly modeling motion in rewards for video editing.

</details>


### [78] [Efficient Self-Supervised Adaptation of 3D Abdominal Vision-Language Model for Institution-Specific HCC Classification via Full Fine-Tuning and PEFT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22504)
*Febryan Putra Kartika,Cheng-Yu Ma,Ying-Jia Lin,Chi-Tung Cheng,Kuan-Fu Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究将预训练的3D医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）通过CT-报告对比学习跨机构适配到肝细胞癌（HCC）分类任务，比较全微调与参数高效微调（PEFT），在无病灶级标注条件下取得AUC 0.82（全微调）/0.79（PEFT）的可比性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学VLM能建模图文跨模态关系，但其向特定机构临床任务的适配尚缺乏研究；同时PEFT因降低算力成本、适配小数据场景而被广泛采用，需要实证考察其与全微调在跨机构域偏移下的实际取舍。

Method: 使用来自另一机构的配对腹部CT与放射报告（采集特性与预训练语料不同），对预训练3D医学VLM进行自监督CT-报告对比学习微调，用于HCC分类。对比两种策略：全微调与PEFT（图像编码器用ConvLoRA、文本编码器用LoRA）。训练目标为图文对比损失，不依赖病灶级标注或HCC分类标签；并分析对比温度初始化的影响。

Result: 在跨机构域偏移下两种策略均获较强下游性能：PEFT AUC 0.79、F1 0.70；全微调AUC 0.82、F1 0.71，仍低于有监督HCC分类方法，但优于原始预训练模型。全微调收敛快但数轮内即过拟合；PEFT仅更新约1%参数即可达可比性能，但需更多训练步。对比温度初始化显著影响分类表现。

Conclusion: 3D医学VLM可通过自监督CT-报告对比学习高效适配到机构特异的HCC分类任务；全微调与PEFT在性能、收敛速度、参数开销与过拟合风险间存在实际权衡，PEFT是受限数据与算力条件下的可行方案。

Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) capture cross-modal relationships between image and text, yet their adaptation to institution-specific clinical tasks remains underexplored. In this study, we fine-tuned a pretrained 3D medical VLM for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) classification using paired abdominal CT scans and radiology reports from a different institution with acquisition characteristics that differ from the model's original pretraining corpus. We compared two adaptation strategies: full fine-tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), motivated by the common use of PEFT to reduce computational cost and enable adaptation under limited-data constraints. Both approaches achieve strong downstream HCC classification performance despite the cross-institutional domain shift, with PEFT reaching an AUC of 0.79 and F1 of 0.70, and full fine-tuning achieving an AUC of 0.82 and F1 of 0.71. Although these results remain below the performance reported by supervised HCC classification approaches, our method achieves improvements over the pretrained model through CT-report contrastive learning without requiring lesion-level annotations or HCC classification labels as training targets. Full fine-tuning converges rapidly but overfits within a few epochs, whereas PEFT (ConvLoRA for the image encoder and LoRA for the text encoder) attains comparable performance while updating approximately 1% of the model parameters, although requiring more training steps. We also examine the role of contrastive temperature, observing that temperature initialization significantly affects classification performance. This study demonstrates that a 3D medical VLM can be efficiently adapted to institution-specific HCC classification using self-supervised CT-report contrastive learning, while highlighting the practical trade-offs between full fine-tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

</details>


### [79] [EfficientVPR: Toward Efficient Visual Place Recognition via Scene-Aware Prompt Tuning and Adaptive Feature Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22506)
*Wenjing Tang,Chuanguang Yang,Zhulin An,Libo Huang,Yongjun Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出高效一阶段视觉位置识别框架 EfficientVPR，通过场景感知视觉提示调优与实例相关关键局部特征增强，在轻量 DINOv2-small 上实现速度-精度最优折中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VPR 方法多依赖扩大模型容量或计算密集的重排序阶段来应对极端环境变化，造成显著效率瓶颈，难以满足实际应用的算力约束。

Method: 两项创新：i) 场景感知视觉提示调优（scene-aware visual prompt tuning），以更少参数适配预训练特征并动态适应样本特性；ii) 实例相关关键局部特征增强模块（instance-dependent key local feature enhancement），强化判别性区域。整体为一阶段轻量框架。

Result: 在 Pitts250k、MSLS、Eynsham、AmsterTime、SVOX 上评估，刷新 DINOv2-small 规模 SOTA，优于所有同规模方法；相较 SOTA 的 DINOv2-large 两阶段方法实现 73 倍加速、特征维度降低 60%，同时平均 R@1 差距保持在 2.5% 以内。

Conclusion: 无需扩大模型或引入重排序即可兼顾效率与精度，EfficientVPR 为资源受限场景下的视觉位置识别提供了实用的轻量化方案。

Abstract: Visual place recognition (VPR) faces critical challenges in handling extreme environmental variations while meeting the computational constraints of practical applications. Current methods predominantly address these challenges by either scaling up model capacity or employing computationally intensive reranking stages, creating a significant efficiency bottleneck. To overcome this limitation, we propose EfficientVPR, a lightweight one-stage framework that achieves speed-accuracy trade-offs through two key innovations: i) a scene-aware visual prompt tuning method which adapts pretrained features with less parameters while dynamically adjusting to sample-specific characteristics, and ii) an instance-dependent key local feature enhancement module that further reinforces discriminative regions. Comprehensive evaluations on Pitts250k, MSLS, Eynsham, AmsterTime and SVOX demonstrate that our method establishes a new SOTA for DINOv2-small models by outperforming all same-scale competitors, and delivers a $73\times$ speedup with 60\% lower-dimensional features while maintaining competitive (within 2.5% average R@1 gap) against the SOTA DINOv2-large-based two-stage method. Our code will be available at https://github.com/WiniTang/EfficientVPR.

</details>


### [80] [Reliability-Driven Feature Correction for Hyperspectral and LiDAR Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22508)
*Lianming Zhang,Xiaolu Wang,Qiya Song,Jinyang Liu,Renwei Dian,Xudong Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ReDF框架，用类别证据强度显式建模每个模态在各空间位置的可靠度，并据此指导跨模态特征校正与融合，在三个HSI-LiDAR数据集上取得更高的OA与Kappa。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HSI与LiDAR提供互补的光谱与高程信息，但模态特征中“类别判别可靠性”随空间位置而变化，这一性质很少被显式建模，导致弱特征或歧义特征会干扰跨模态交互与融合。

Method: 可靠性估计：为每个模态构建类原型库，将特征-原型相似度转化为类别证据，从而逐空间位置估计可靠度。可靠性引导特征校正（RGFC）：用可靠度构建可靠性加权共享表示，并基于邻域一致性进行双向跨模态特征校正，用另一模态信息修正类别证据较弱的特征。可靠性引导特征重加权（RGFR）：以可靠度与跨模态分歧为条件生成低秩调制，作用于校正后的模态特定描述子，自适应缩放各模态对融合表示的贡献。

Result: 在三个公开HSI-LiDAR数据集上，平均总体精度（OA）与Kappa系数均高于对比方法。

Conclusion: 显式建模并利用空间变化的模态可靠度，可有效抑制弱/歧义特征的负面干扰，提升跨模态交互与融合质量及分类性能。

Abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) and LiDAR data provide complementary spectral and elevation information for land-cover classification. However, the spatially varying class-discriminative reliability of modality features is rarely modeled explicitly, allowing weak or ambiguous features to adversely affect cross-modal interaction and fusion. To address this issue, we propose ReDF, a reliability-driven framework that quantifies the reliability of each modality's features at each spatial location through the strength of class-related evidence they provide, and uses it to guide feature correction and fusion. Specifically, a Reliability-Guided Feature Correction module introduces a class prototype bank for each modality and converts feature-prototype similarities into class evidence for reliability estimation. The estimated reliabilities are used to construct a reliability-weighted shared representation and to guide bidirectional cross-modal feature correction based on neighborhood agreement, refining modality features with weak class evidence through information from the other modality. Building on these outputs, a Reliability-Guided Feature Reweighting module conditions a low-rank modulation on the estimated reliabilities and the cross-modal disagreement, and applies it to the corrected modality-specific descriptors to adaptively rescale each modality's contribution to the fused representation used for final classification. Experiments on three public HSI-LiDAR datasets show higher mean overall accuracy and Kappa than the compared methods.

</details>


### [81] [Distilling World Action Models for Efficient Bimanual Manipulation via Anchored Path Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22592)
*Jialong Liu,Junjie He,Yandu Chen,Bin Zhou,Heng Su,Peijun Tang,Jianan Wang,Changhao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Anchored Path Matching（APM），以学生实际到达的状态为起点，用教师在该状态的端点与首个中间状态作为双重锚点监督，并通过模态路由适配器与锚点优先梯度冲突消解，实现单检查点支持 1/2/4 步联合视频-动作生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: World Action Models 通过迭代去噪联合生成未来视频与机器人动作，推理开销大；少步蒸馏虽减少模型评估次数，但其粗粒度更新会使学生偏离教师轨迹，导致误差累积与生成质量下降。因此需要在蒸馏中显式约束学生的轨迹一致性。

Method: APM 从学生自身到达的每个状态出发，继续运行教师至零噪声，取其端点与首个中间状态作为目标；用模态路由适配器（modality-routed adapters）从同一初始状态同时拟合两个目标。当端点梯度与局部转移梯度冲突时，采用锚点优先更新：保留端点梯度方向，并在各模态内部剔除局部梯度中与之相反的分量。单一检查点即可部署时选择 1、2、4 步采样预算，无需重训或查询教师。

Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上仅用 Clean 演示训练、直接在域随机化的 Random 设置评估：1 步时相比同等推理预算的基线蒸馏，闭环成功率在 Clean 提升 2.0 个百分点、Random 提升 1.4 个百分点；视频 PSNR 由 30.169 dB 升至 32.317 dB，SSIM 与 LPIPS 同步改善。两个真实机器人任务上，成功率优于 1 步教师，控制周期延迟较 8 步教师降低 21.3 倍。

Conclusion: APM 通过锚定学生可达状态的双目标监督与梯度冲突消解，有效缓解少步蒸馏的轨迹漂移，在仿真与真实机器人上同时提升闭环成功率、视频生成保真度与推理效率，并具备部署时灵活选择步数的实用优势。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative denoising. Few-step distillation reduces the number of model evaluations, but its coarse updates can move the student away from the teacher's trajectory. We propose Anchored Path Matching (APM), which supervises endpoint and short-transition predictions from states reached by the student. From each state, we continue the teacher to zero noise and use its endpoint and first intermediate state as targets. Modality-routed adapters learn to match both targets from the same starting state. When the two gradients conflict, anchor-priority updates preserve the endpoint gradient and remove the opposing component of the local gradient within each modality. One checkpoint supports 1-, 2-, and 4-step joint generation. The sampling budget can be chosen at deployment without retraining or teacher queries. On RoboTwin 2.0, we train only on Clean demonstrations and evaluate directly on the domain-randomized Random setting. At one step, APM improves closed-loop success over continued base distillation at matched inference budgets by 2.0 percentage points on Clean and 1.4 on Random. Video peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) rises from 30.169 to 32.317 dB, with gains in structural similarity (SSIM) and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS). On two real-robot tasks, APM improves success over the one-step teacher and reduces control-cycle latency by $21.3\times$ relative to the eight-step teacher.Project page: https://jialonglong.github.io/Anchored-Path-Matching/.

</details>


### [82] [ATS: Anti-Aliased Triangle Splatting with Exact Per-Primitive Integrals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22512)
*Brent Zoomers,Joni Vanherck,Leander Winters,Jeroen Put,Lode Jorissen,Nick Michiels*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Triangle Splatting 窗口在像素上的精确闭式积分：按角平分线把三角形切成三个子三角形，配合格林公式将积分及其梯度化为裁剪到像素后每条边一项，从而实现抗锯齿与保守剔除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Triangle Splatting 在像素中心点采样，造成严重走样；且以“内切圆半径小于一像素”为条件剔除三角形，在低分辨率下会错误剔除大量场景元素。

Method: 推导窗口函数在像素区域上的精确解析积分：角平分线将三角形分为三个子三角形，每个子区域内窗口是到某条边距离的幂函数，故存在闭式原函数；用格林定理把面积积分及梯度化为子三角形被像素裁剪后逐边的单角点项，整体三角形积分亦有闭式解。

Result: 该积分可对已有模型免重训实现抗锯齿；时间走样低于 2x2 超采样；基于整三角形闭式积分可实现保守剔除（仅剔除在任何像素都无法达到 alpha 阈值的三角形），并支持多尺度训练，在降低分辨率下匹配或超过超采样训练。

Conclusion: 把像素中心采样替换为精确面积积分，可同时解决走样与非保守剔除问题，是一种即插即用、支持多尺度训练的高效渲染改进。

Abstract: Triangle Splatting represents scenes using semi-transparent triangles, but it evaluates each triangle at the pixel center and culls any triangle with an inradius smaller than one pixel. The former causes severe aliasing, while the latter culls most of the scene at lower resolutions. We show that the integral of the Triangle Splatting window over a pixel admits an exact closed-form solution. The angle bisectors split the triangle into three sub-triangles, in each of which the window is a power of the distance to one edge. Each piece therefore has a closed-form antiderivative, and Green's theorem reduces the integral and its gradients to one term per side of the sub-triangle clipped against the pixel. The integral over the whole triangle, which we show has a closed form, then allows conservative culling, removing only triangles that cannot meet the renderer's alpha cutoff at any pixel. This exact formulation anti-aliases existing models without retraining, exhibits less temporal aliasing than 2x2 supersampling, and enables multi-scale training, matching or outperforming supersampled training at reduced resolutions.

</details>


### [83] [VSpark: Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22666)
*Suho Yoo,Youngjoon Jang,Hyebin Cho,Taeyeop Lee,Jaewook Jeong,Joon Son Chung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VSpark 通过校准动作噪声收集 rollout、特征对齐训练草稿模型、以及复用被拒绝草稿的延续预测，改进自回归 VLA 的投机解码，在四种 VLA 与四个操作基准上实现 1.28x–2.10x 无损加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视觉-语言-动作模型逐 token 生成动作，推理慢。投机解码本可加速，但在机器人控制中受限于"动作多 token 同义"问题：许多不同 token 编码几乎相同的运动，导致接近正确动作的草稿仍被拒绝，接受率低、加速有限。

Method: 三个设计：(i) 用带校准动作噪声的 rollout 采集数据，使草稿模型暴露于更广的机器人状态分布；(ii) 特征对齐，训练草稿模型拟合 VLA 的隐藏特征而非仅输出 token；(iii) 延续复用，保留 VLA 在拒绝草稿上已计算的预测，作为下一轮验证的候选而非丢弃。

Result: 在四种使用不同动作分词器的 VLA 与四个操作基准上，取得 1.28x 至 2.10x 的加速，同时保持 VLA 解码无损。

Conclusion: 针对动作空间语义冗余导致的草稿拒绝问题，从数据分布、表示对齐与计算复用三方面提升投机解码接受率，可在不改变输出的前提下有效加速 VLA 的实时机器人控制推理。

Abstract: Our aim is to accelerate autoregressive vision-language-action models (VLAs), which generate robot actions one token at a time. Speculative decoding makes this possible: a lightweight draft model proposes several tokens at once, and the VLA verifies them in a single pass, accepting only those that match its own predictions, so decoding remains lossless. The speedup, however, is limited in robot control, where many different tokens encode nearly the same motion and a draft close to the correct action is still rejected. To address this, our approach, VSpark, is built upon three design choices: (i) rollouts collected with calibrated action noise, which expose the draft to a wider range of robot states; (ii) feature alignment, which trains the draft to match the VLA's hidden features rather than its output tokens alone; and (iii) continuation reuse, which keeps the predictions the VLA has already computed along rejected drafts as candidates for the next verification step, instead of discarding them. On four VLAs with different action tokenizers and four manipulation benchmarks, VSpark achieves 1.28x to 2.10x speedup while keeping the VLA's decoding lossless.

</details>


### [84] [From Perception to Simulation: Unveiling and Empowering Mental Spatial Dynamics in MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22541)
*Jiachun Li,Zhuoran Jin,Kang Liu,Jun Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出动态空间模拟基准 MentalGrid，并借助三阶段课程学习框架训练 SpatialWalker，在空间模拟任务上较基座模型平均提升 33.8%，并可泛化至域外基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多聚焦静态场景中的空间关系感知，而要求模型在无中间视觉反馈条件下推演空间状态演变的"动态空间模拟"能力尚未被系统探索，亟需专门基准与改进方法。

Method: 构建 MentalGrid 基准，聚焦需模拟空间状态演化的推理任务；通过大规模评测定位瓶颈（简单场景受限于感知、复杂场景受限于多步推理）；进而设计三阶段课程学习框架，使用 16k 专用空间推理样本训练得到 SpatialWalker。

Result: 现有 MLLM 空间模拟能力显著不足；SpatialWalker 相对基座模型平均提升 33.8%，在空间模拟上超过 Gemini-3-Flash 等闭源模型，并在域外基准上保持 4.9% 的平均增益。

Conclusion: 空间模拟是更广泛空间智能的基础构件；针对性课程学习可有效缓解感知与多步推理瓶颈，并带来稳健的跨域泛化能力。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning is a fundamental component of world understanding for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While existing research has advanced the perception of spatial relations in static scenes, the domain of dynamic spatial simulation remains relatively unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce MentalGrid, a benchmark focused on spatial reasoning tasks that require models to simulate evolving spatial states without intermediate visual feedback. Extensive evaluation on our benchmark reveals a significant deficiency in the spatial simulation capabilities of existing models. Specifically, we find that performance is constrained by perceptual limitations in simple simulation scenarios and hindered by inadequate multi-step reasoning as complexity increases. To address these challenges, we propose a three-stage curriculum learning framework utilizing 16k specialized spatial reasoning samples. This approach yields SpatialWalker, which achieves a 33.8% average improvement over its base model, surpassing proprietary models like Gemini-3-Flash in spatial simulation. Furthermore, SpatialWalker demonstrates robust generalization, maintaining a 4.9% average gain on out-of-domain benchmarks, demonstrating the pivotal role of spatial simulation as a fundamental building block for broader spatial intelligence.

</details>


### [85] [Fast Training-Free Low-Light Video Enhancement with a Frozen Image Diffusion Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22551)
*Hon Ming Yam,Chun Pong Lau*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种因果、免训练的弱光视频增强流水线，在冻结的MR. Illuminate图像先验上加入时间输入融合与晚启动偏移传播两个时间组件，在ZVRD分辨率下比ZVRD快261倍且五项指标全面更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有唯一的免训练弱光视频方法ZVRD过慢（256×256帧需一分钟以上），无法实用；同时希望在不需弱光训练数据、不需为新相机重训的前提下利用预训练图像扩散模型增强视频。

Method: 因果、免训练流水线，在冻结的MR. Illuminate图像先验上加两个时间组件：(1) 时间输入融合——在扩散反演前对运动补偿后的弱光帧做递归平均；(2) 晚启动偏移传播——仅在关键帧上跑完整采样轨迹，非关键帧只反演自身轨迹的低噪声部分并叠加上从最近关键帧变换（warp）来的增强偏移；并用线性-高斯反演模型进行解释。

Result: ZVRD分辨率下快261倍且五项指标均更好；13个留出SDSD片段（1280×720）上较逐帧八步处理PSNR提升0.55 dB、LPIPS提升0.034、warping误差减半，耗时少10%；融化效应验证：融合在反演放大噪声前去除帧间噪声，光流误差对传输偏移的扰动比对传输状态小十倍；但低分辨率346×260下LPIPS变差0.028，且帧率仅0.65 fps。

Conclusion: 该流水线以显著效率优势超越ZVRD并在高分辨率上获得感知与保真收益，但其感知增益不能迁移到低分辨率，且0.65 fps的帧率仍属离线方法。

Abstract: Pretrained image diffusion models can enhance low-light video without low-light training data and without retraining for a new camera. ZVRD, the only published training-free method for low-light video, is too slow to use: our implementation needs over a minute per $256 \times 256$ frame. We present a causal, training-free pipeline that adds two temporal components to a frozen MR. Illuminate image prior. Temporal input fusion recursively averages motion-compensated low-light frames before diffusion inversion. Late-start offset propagation runs the full sampling trajectory only on key frames. Each non-key frame inverts the low-noise part of its own trajectory and adds an enhancement offset warped from the latest key frame. At ZVRD's own resolution the pipeline is $261\times$ faster than ZVRD and scores better on all five metrics we report. On 13 held-out SDSD clips at $1280 \times 720$, it improves on framewise eight-step processing by 0.55 dB in PSNR and 0.034 in LPIPS and halves the warping error, in 10% less time. Measurements inside the model show why, and a linear-Gaussian model of inversion explains them. Fusion removes frame-to-frame noise before inversion amplifies it. A flow error perturbs the transported offset ten times less than it perturbs a transported state. The perceptual gain does not transfer to low resolution: at $346 \times 260$, LPIPS is worse by 0.028. At 0.65 frames per second, the pipeline is an offline method.

</details>


### [86] [Strong Fused Performance Can Mask Branch Collapse in a Dual-View Heart-Sound Classifier: A Three-Part Diagnostic Protocol](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22556)
*Safayet Khan,Hasan Zohirul Islam,Md. Tauhid Bin Iqbal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出分支坍塌（branch collapse）现象：在双视角心音分类的双分支融合模型（AudioFuse，谱图Transformer+波形CNN）中，尽管融合分数很高，谱图分支实际上未被使用。作者设计三部分诊断流程，并发现该现象在PhysioNet上成立但不完全复现于ICBHI/CirCor。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 融合模型通常仅以融合分数（fused score）评估，隐含假设每个分支都学到了有用表征。作者指出该假设可能"静默失效"——融合性能良好但某分支实质未被利用，因此需要显式的分支级诊断方法。

Method: 提出三部分诊断：(1) 分支删除——删除该分支是否改变融合分数；(2) 未训练对照线性探针——在其特征上做线性探针是否优于同架构随机初始化（未训练）副本；(3) 单独训练——该分支独立训练时能否学到其视角。辅以更新统计量和初始化实验定位原因，并以人为标签线索在输入间的迁移实验检验分支依赖可切换性。

Result: AudioFuse中删除谱图分支对融合分数影响可忽略；线性探针相对未训练副本提升极小，即联合训练后该分支近乎随机（近chance）；但同架构单独训练可达>0.9 AUC，说明视角本身可学习。更新统计与初始化实验指向早期优化不平衡。将强人工标签线索从一路输入移至另一路，可切换模型依赖的分支，而分支架构不变。该坍塌在PhysioNet可见，但在ICBHI与CirCor上未满足完整诊断。

Conclusion: 仅凭融合性能无法证明每个分支学到有意义表征；建议在报告融合分数之外，同时报告分支删除实验结果与未训练对照探针，以检测静默的分支坍塌。

Abstract: Fusion models are usually judged by their fused score, a practice that assumes that every branch has learned something useful. We show that this assumption can fail silently in dual-view heart-sound classification. In AudioFuse, which fuses a spectrogram transformer with a waveform CNN, the spectrogram branch is unused despite strong fused performance when both branches are trained from scratch. We introduce a three-part diagnostic for branch collapse: whether deleting a branch changes the fused score, whether a linear probe on its features beats an untrained copy of the same branch, and whether the branch can learn its view when trained alone. Deleting the branch has negligible effect, and probing its features shows little improvement over an identically initialised, untrained copy. Yet the same architecture trained alone exceeds 0.9 AUC, so its view is learnable, while the jointly trained model is near chance when it must rely on this branch. Update statistics and an initialisation experiment point to an early optimisation imbalance. Moving a strong artificial label cue from one input to the other can switch which branch the model relies on, even though the branch architectures stay the same. We observe branch collapse on PhysioNet, but the full diagnostic is not met on ICBHI or CirCor. Fused performance alone therefore cannot establish that every branch learned a meaningful representation, and we recommend reporting branch deletion and an untrained-control probe alongside it.

</details>


### [87] [Plausible Videos Can Lead to Poor Decisions: Diagnosing and CURE-ing World Models for Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22561)
*Raphael C. Kim,Michele Santacatterina,Jingsen Zhu,Ramin Zabih*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CURE 证书引导框架，判断动作条件世界模型何时可用于规划，并给出对应处置策略，以决策质量而非视频感知质量提升规划可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动作条件世界模型被广泛用于规划，但即便生成的视频逼真且与训练数据一致，也可能导出劣质决策；因此需要回答：何时可信任世界模型进行规划，以及不可信任时应采取何种措施。

Method: CURE（Certify, Upweight, Rollout, Explore）四步机制：先用证书评估世界模型在规划中的可信度并衡量训练数据对规划器决策的"支撑度"（support）；当支撑不足时，分别在训练端上采样（upweight）数据以去偏、在测试端增加 rollout 采样，或主动探索采集缺失支撑区域的新数据。

Result: 在 PhyWorld 模拟物理、MuJoCo 机械臂控制以及仿真与真实视频上的 Language-Table 推物任务中验证：证书信任的决策遗憾显著更低（Language-Table 仿真 0.06 vs 0.38，MuJoCo 接触任务 0.07 vs 0.38），而视频感知质量无法区分决策优劣；相同数据下，CURE 相较最优悲观决策规则降低遗憾 10–25%（各支撑水平），相较世界-动作模型、搜索与策略学习方法降低 41–64%。

Conclusion: 世界模型的视频逼真度不能作为规划可信度的指标；应以决策质量为导向，通过证书识别可信区域并对不可信情形采取针对性补救（加权、采样、探索），从而在同等数据条件下显著降低规划遗憾。

Abstract: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly used as world models for planning, yet a world model that makes plausible, realistic-looking videos that are consistent with the training data can produce poor decisions. We address two key questions: (1) when can we trust a world model for planning, and (2) what should we do when we cannot? We introduce CURE (Certify, Upweight, Rollout, Explore), a certificate-guided technique that assesses whether a world model can be trusted for planning and determines what to do next: whether to upweight the training data to debias the model; roll out more samples at test time; or explore by collecting new data where support (how well the training data cover the planner's decisions) is missing. We deploy CURE across multiple domains, spanning simulated physics based on PhyWorld, MuJoCo arm control, and Language-Table pushing in simulation and on real videos. The decisions our certificate trusts have lower regret than those it does not (e.g., 0.06 vs. 0.38 on Language-Table sim and 0.07 vs. 0.38 on MuJoCo contact), whereas video perceptual quality does not identify good decisions. By focusing on decision quality rather than perceptual quality, CURE lowers regret over the best pessimistic decision rule by 10-25% across support levels, and over world-action models, search and policy learning by 41-64%, given the same data.

</details>


### [88] [Multimodal Masked Diffusion Autoencoder for Modeling Impaired Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23211)
*John Gideon,Anshul Gupta,Megan Applegate-Kenton,Kayli Battel,Todd J Rowell,Patricio Reyes Gomez,Laporsha Dees,Emily Sumner,Avinash Balachandran,Guy Rosman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多模态掩码扩散自编码器ID-MAE，在损伤预测之外加入自监督重建目标，并发布103小时驾驶模拟器数据集DIVERT，实现损伤推断与轨迹/注视预测的显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶场景中人类认知状态（分心、压力）、注视与行为同环境的交互微妙复杂，AI可借此辅助驾驶员；但大规模获取认知状态等级的ground-truth标注代价高昂。作者希望利用无标注数据通过自监督学习提升损伤推断性能。

Method: 提出ID-MAE：多模态掩码扩散自编码器，将损伤标签作为被掩码的token进行预测，同时重建被掩码的注视与轨迹，从而在损伤预测任务上叠加自监督目标。构建DIVERT数据集：驾驶模拟器数据，103小时、n=109，涵盖认知、视觉、情绪三类共十种损伤诱导，采集注视、车辆状态与场景视频。并系统探查输入模态、掩码策略、位置编码、注意力机制与解码方式的设计空间，以及不同损伤在训练/推理中的交互。

Result: 在DIVERT及现有数据集上均取得显著提升；对位置匹配样本，损伤检测配对AUC为0.706，而无重建损失时为0.590，优于现有基线；并在轨迹预测与注视预测等附加任务上表现良好。分析表明视觉负荷型分心与认知型分心可区分。

Conclusion: 将自监督重建目标与损伤预测联合建模，可有效缓解认知状态标签稀缺问题，多模态掩码扩散框架在驾驶员状态推断及多种相关任务上具有优势；DIVERT为多损伤类型研究提供了可复用的基准。

Abstract: Human cognitive state (e.g., distraction, stress), gaze, and behavior interact with the driving environment in subtle ways that AI could use to assist drivers, but ground-truth labels for human cognitive state levels are costly to obtain at scale. We propose a multimodal masked-diffusion autoencoder, ID-MAE, that adds a self-supervised objective to impairment prediction: alongside predicting the impairment label as a masked token, it reconstructs masked gaze and trajectory. To probe the effects of different modalities and types of impairments on model inference, we introduce DIVERT, a driving-simulator dataset containing 103 hours of driving data (n = 109) with ten impairment inductions spanning cognitive, visual, and emotional states, recorded with gaze, vehicle state, and scene video. We demonstrate how ID-MAE affords significant improvements in impairment inference results on both the DIVERT dataset and existing datasets, and enables strong results in additional tasks, such as trajectory and gaze prediction. For location-matched pairs, our model achieves a paired AUC of 0.706 for impairment detection on DIVERT, compared to 0.590 without reconstruction loss, improving over existing baselines. We probe the design space in terms of input modalities, masking scheme, positional encoding, attention mechanism, and decoding. We also investigate the interaction between various impairments in training and inference, demonstrating that visually demanding distractions are separable from cognitive distractions. Code and data will be available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [89] [Lost in Read-out: Locating the Image Quality Gap in Vision-Language Models with a Closed-Form Edit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22564)
*Zhuangzi Li,Shilv Cai,Jian Jin,Zhiyi Pan,Haihong Xiao,Weisi Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"失败于看见质量还是说出质量"的问题，通过逐层探针与干预实验证明：VLM的图像质量信息在视觉编码器与语言模型末层仍可线性解码，主要损失发生在最终读出层；对末层单个神经元做闭式编辑可部分弥合该差距，且不损害感知问答能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）常被用作零样本图像质量评估器，但其好/差判断与人类主观意见仅呈中等一致性。作者希望厘清这种不一致的来源：究竟是模型"看不见"质量（表征层面缺失），还是"说不出"质量（读出/作答环节损失）。

Method: 1）在五个VLM上做逐层线性探针，检验质量信息在视觉编码器与各语言层的可解码性，并测试所需标注量（约百条即恢复大部分信息）；2）用岭回归头（ridge head）在末层状态上拟合并与模型答案对比，量化"答案之外的差距"；3）分析读出偏差，发现相对人类意见，五个模型均过度奖励色彩丰富度、低估清晰度；4）干预实验：对末层单个神经元做闭式编辑、一次性在多个提示上拟合，并在未参与拟合的提示上评估；5）鲁棒性与副作用检验（迁移判据、感知问答、是/否与评分式问题、情感化语句后的对比反转）。

Result: 在未用于拟合的提示下，该编辑在KonIQ上恢复了岭回归头相对于原答案所获增益的86%–100%；当差距本身较小时增益很小，在两个最大模型上未达到迁移判据；当岭回归头本身低于原答案时，编辑反而降低得分；编辑仅当从语言模型中段起写入时才有效。与无约束微调不同，该编辑保持了感知问答能力；但它不迁移到是/否或评分式问题，且在情感色彩强烈的句子之后会反转好—差对比。

Conclusion: VLM的质量评估短板主要不在感知表征，而在最终读出环节，且读出部分地在读"别的东西"（过度依赖色彩、忽视清晰度）。单神经元闭式编辑是一种精准、低副作用的部分修复手段，能恢复大部分可解码但未被表达的质量信息，同时保留感知问答能力；但其效果受限于原始差距大小与语言层位置，且对问题形式与上下文情感敏感，说明读出层的质量表达是脆弱且依赖任务的。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are widely used as zero-shot image quality assessors, yet their good-vs-poor answers agree only moderately with human opinion. We ask whether these models fail to see quality or fail to say it. Layer-wise probes on five VLMs point to the second: quality is linearly decodable from the vision encoder and still from the last language layer, far better than the answer reveals, and about a hundred labels recover most of it. The loss lies mainly in the final read-out, which partly reads something else: relative to human opinion, it over-rewards colorfulness and under-rewards sharpness on all five models. We test this by intervention: if the read-out is at fault, a closed-form edit of a single last-layer neuron, fitted to many prompts at once, should close the gap and no more. Both hold. Under prompts never used for fitting, the edit recovers 86--100\% of what a ridge head on the last-layer state, fitted under the same prompts, finds beyond the answer on KonIQ. Where that gap is small, it gains little, too little for our transfer criterion on the two largest models; where the head itself is below the answer, it lowers the score; and it works only when written from the middle of the language model on. Unlike unconstrained fine-tuning, the edit leaves perception question answering intact. It does not carry over to yes-or-no or rating questions, and it reverses the good--poor contrast after sentiment-laden sentences. Code will be made available.

</details>


### [90] [Semantic-Guided Geometric Decoding for Token-Efficient Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22577)
*Zhaojie Chen,Junyan Yang,Le Yang,Qi Dang,Yucheng Huang,Qianyi Che,Zhaoqiang Chen,Xinqi Zhu,Qiang Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SemGeo，用单个grid token做粗定位、几何解码器并行回归离散框坐标，结合高斯软标签SFT与强化后训练，在八个基准中六个取得最高F1@mIoU，吞吐较基线提升2.07×（vLLM）与1.25×（Transformers）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素到序列的自回归坐标生成每个框需多步顺序解码，推理成本随实例数增长；像素到嵌入方法虽降低开销，但共享特殊token缺乏显式空间编码。

Method: 以单个grid token表示每个实例实现粗定位；几何解码器复用视觉特征与隐藏状态并并行恢复精确离散框坐标；SFT阶段引入编码坐标距离的高斯软标签联合训练proposal生成与框定位；强化后训练结合框集合奖励与模型自生成proposal上的坐标监督，缓解teacher-forcing与推理的失配。

Result: 在覆盖目标检测、指代目标检测、文档版面grounding的八个基准上，六个基准的F1@mIoU优于对比MLLM；在vLLM与Transformers下平均框生成吞吐分别为代表性grounding基线的2.07×和1.25×，且准确率更高。

Conclusion: 以单token粗定位加并行几何解码的框架在保持甚至提升定位精度的同时显著降低推理开销，软标签监督与基于自生成结果的强化后训练是训练-推理解耦问题的有效缓解手段。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a unified interface for language-conditioned visual perception. In pixel-to-sequence grounding, autoregressive coordinate generation requires multiple sequential decoding steps per box, increasing inference cost with the number of instances. Pixel-to-embedding methods reduce this overhead but lack explicit spatial encoding when using a shared special token. We introduce SemGeo, a token-efficient visual grounding framework that represents each instance with a single grid token for coarse localization. A geometric decoder reuses visual features and hidden states to recover precise discrete box coordinates in parallel. To train proposal generation and box localization together, we introduce Gaussian soft labels that encode coordinate distances during supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Reinforcement post-training further combines box-set rewards with coordinate supervision on model-generated proposals. This stage trains the language model and geometric decoder on their own predictions to mitigate the mismatch between teacher-forced training and inference. Across eight benchmarks spanning object detection, referring object detection, and document layout grounding, SemGeo achieves the highest F1@mIou among compared MLLMs on six benchmarks. It also delivers $2.07\times$ and $1.25\times$ the mean box-generation throughput of representative grounding baselines under vLLM and Transformers, respectively, while achieving higher accuracy in both comparisons.

</details>


### [91] [Propose with the Gradient, Accept with the Loss: One Hedged Attack for Pixel-Sparse Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22596)
*Hon Ming Yan,Chun Pong Lau*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将像素稀疏对抗攻击视为"提议分布+接受准则"的局部搜索，用泰勒界推导出五条梯度使用规则，据此提出单次运行、每步仅需一前一后向传播的GRS攻击；在13种CIFAR-10配置和5个ImageNet模型上，GRS达到或超过sAA最强成员，18个设置中17个与sAA差距在1个点以内或更强，8个显著更强，计算量降至3个前向单位、速度快3.7–5.0倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素稀疏对抗鲁棒性目前依赖sAA集成度量，因为其成员sPGD（信任被全像素改动破坏的一阶模型）与Sparse-RS（即使梯度有信息也忽略梯度）在不同位置失败。作者希望统一理解这两类攻击，并回答局部搜索究竟能从梯度中学习到什么，从而用单一高效攻击替代集成。

Method: 将sPGD与Sparse-RS统一为局部搜索（提议分布+接受规则）框架；通过泰勒界确定应度量的量，并在搜索实际访问的状态上进行测量，得到五条规则：单像素处梯度符号最可靠，用于设定新像素值；候选像素的梯度排序应宽松遵循；待移除像素的排序更可靠、可更严格遵循；在一次移动被接受前不应重复提议同一像素；接受与否仅由损失决定。由此构建GRS，每步一次前向与一次反向传播。

Result: 在13种CIFAR-10配置与5个ImageNet模型上，GRS匹配或超过sAA最佳单一成员；18个设置中17个处于sAA的1个点以内或更强，其中8个显著强于sAA；仅需3个前向传播单位（sAA最多7个），在CIFAR-10上比sAA成员完整运行快3.7–5.0倍。

Conclusion: 梯度在稀疏攻击中应被"有选择地"使用：符号用于定值、排序用于候选筛选且移除排序更可信，而非整体信任一阶模型或完全丢弃梯度。GRS以更低成本达到集成级评测强度，可作为sAA的实用替代。

Abstract: A pixel-sparse adversary may change a few pixels of an image to any value. Robustness to such attacks is currently measured with an ensemble, sparse-AutoAttack (sAA), because its members fail in different places: sparse projected gradient descent (sPGD) trusts a first-order model that a full pixel change breaks, and sparse random search (Sparse-RS) ignores the gradient even where it is informative. We show that both attacks are local searches, each a proposal distribution plus an acceptance rule, and ask what such a search can learn from the gradient. A Taylor bound says what to measure, and measurements at the states the search visits give five rules. The sign of the gradient is its most reliable use at a single pixel and sets a new pixel's value. Its ranking of candidate pixels should be followed loosely, and its ranking of the pixels to remove, which is often more reliable, can be followed more closely. A pixel should not be proposed twice before a move is accepted, and acceptance should be decided by the loss alone. These rules define Gradient-guided Random Search (GRS), which runs once and costs one forward and one backward pass per step. On 13 CIFAR-10 configurations and 5 ImageNet models, GRS matches or beats the best single member of sAA and is within one point of sAA itself or stronger on 17 of 18 settings, and it is significantly stronger than sAA on 8. It uses 3 instead of up to 7 forward-pass units, and on CIFAR-10 it runs 3.7 to 5.0 times faster than the members of sAA run in full.

</details>


### [92] [PlaceTally: A Test-Time Memory Model for Constructing Place Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22608)
*Alibay Osmanli,Shaogang Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PlaceTally：一种问题无关的测试时记忆模型，用"地点图"将视频按地点分组，解决视频重复到访场景下的计数难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法存在缺陷：整段视频读取的VLM只能给出粗略小数；分段读取会重复计数；目标跟踪器需预知类别或固定词表。核心观察：计数记忆无需知道"找什么"，只需知道"去过哪"——物体很少在两次到访间离开房间，故按地点分组的片段几乎不共享物体。

Method: 构建每个视频的地点图：每个视频片段与最佳历史匹配所在地点合并，若无强匹配则新建地点（强匹配极少出错，而真实重返往往匹配较弱）。冻结的VLM对每个地点仅从不超过128帧中计数一次，使每次读取输入有界，记忆规模随地点数增长；图构建速度比实时快15倍。

Result: 在RevisitCount（真实房间重录基准）上，测试房间平均相对准确率62.5%，留出房间61.2%，而同一模型整段读取仅51.2%和44.3%。性能在房间重返频率变化时保持稳定，而"累加访问次数固定修正"基线从38.5%波动至61.4%。

Conclusion: 基于地点先验的问题无关记忆可实现高效、鲁棒的视频计数，避免重复计数与类别预知依赖，且对到访频率变化稳健。

Abstract: Counting distinct objects in a video is hard when the camera returns to places it has seen. A vision-language model that reads the whole video answers with a few small numbers, and one that reads it in parts counts an object again in every part that shows it. Object trackers need the category before the video is read, or a fixed vocabulary. We observe that a memory for counting does not need to know what it is looking for, only where it has been: objects rarely leave a room between visits, so parts of a video grouped by place share almost no objects, and a place can be recognised before any question is asked. Building on this, we introduce PlaceTally, a question-blind test-time memory model that constructs a place graph for each video. Each video fragment joins the place of its best earlier match or opens a new place, because a strong match is rarely wrong while a true return often matches weakly. A frozen vision-language model counts each place once from at most 128 of its frames, so every read has a bounded input and the memory grows with the number of places; the graph is built 15 times faster than real time. On RevisitCount, our benchmark of real room re-recordings, it scores 62.5% mean relative accuracy on test rooms and 61.2% on held-out rooms, against 51.2% and 44.3% for the same model reading the whole video. It stays level as rooms return more or less often, while a fixed correction of summed visits moves from 38.5% to 61.4%.

</details>


### [93] [Sub-Meter Canopy Height Synthesis from Sentinel-2 via Anchored Residual Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22636)
*Kiarie Ndegwa,Tony Chang,Andreas Gros,Vincent A. Landau,David D. Diaz,Luke Zachmann,Nathan E. Rutenbeck,Guy C Bayes*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文利用免费Sentinel-2 10m影像生成0.5m冠层高度模型（CHM），提出基于感知-失真权衡的两个工作点：Anchor确定性回归器追求低保真度误差，AR-flow条件流匹配模型在学到的CHM隐空间中拟合并生成残差以提升感知质量，在大规模LiDAR配对数据上验证并给出可用性与局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 亚米级CHM对森林碳核算、火险燃料制图与单木生态研究至关重要，但依赖需多年更新周期的机载LiDAR，成本高、刷新慢。作者希望用免费、高频的光学卫星影像在20倍跨模态超分辨率条件下预测几何高度，以低成本实现大陆尺度近实时刷新。

Method: 将问题建模为跨模态超分辨率，受感知-失真权衡启发设计两个共享条件的工作点：(1) Anchor确定性回归器以低失真为目标；(2) AR-flow条件流匹配模型，在学习到的CHM潜空间中拟合Anchor的残差，以提升感知保真度。训练集为覆盖美国本土69个生态区的197k个LiDAR配对瓦片，输出0.5m分辨率CHM，测试集为2,530个留出瓦片，与8个基线对比。

Result: 仅用免费卫星输入时，Anchor的MAE为2.83m；AR-flow将切片Wasserstein距离从Anchor的1.13降至0.208，但MAE升高至3.68m。冠尺度统计量有所改善，但严格的单木检测仍偏弱，生成出的亚像素细节更接近合理的结构猜测而非真实测量的个体树木。

Conclusion: 该方法使大陆尺度季度级CHM刷新在工程上可行，可用卫星监测为更昂贵的数据采集在时机与范围上提供指导；但在严格单木层面，生成式细节的可靠性有限，应视作合理结构而非实测个体树木。

Abstract: Canopy height models (CHMs) - per-pixel maps of vegetation top height - are essential for forest carbon accounting, wildfire fuel mapping, and tree-level ecology, yet sub-meter CHMs require airborne LiDAR refreshed on multi-year national cycles. We produce 0.5 m CHMs from free 10 m Sentinel-2 imagery, a 20$\times$ cross-modal super-resolution task where optical reflectance must predict geometric height it does not directly observe. Motivated by the perception-distortion trade-off, we derive two operating points with shared conditioning. A deterministic regressor (Anchor) targets low distortion; a conditional flow matching model, trained on the Anchor's residual in a learned CHM latent space (AR-flow), targets perceptual fidelity. Trained on 197k LiDAR-paired tiles spanning 69 ecoregions across the contiguous United States and evaluated on 2,530 held-out tiles against eight baselines, the Anchor achieves 2.83 m MAE using only free satellite input. The AR-flow reduces sliced Wasserstein distance from the Anchor's 1.13 to 0.208, at a higher MAE of 3.68 m. Crown-scale statistics improve, but strict individual-tree detection remains weak: generated sub-pixel detail represents plausible structure rather than measured individual trees. Quarterly continental refresh becomes tractable, letting satellite monitoring inform timing and extent for more expensive data acquisitions.

</details>


### [94] [OVET-Consensus: Rank-Preserving Counterfactual Event Verification for Video Moment Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22637)
*Alibay Osmanli,Shaogang Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对视频时刻检索中"窗口重叠却选错"的评分器瓶颈，提出保持排序的 OVET-Consensus 反事实事件校验层，仅允许高置信度 rank-1 覆盖，将 QVHighlights val 的 R1@0.5 从 64.71 提升至 65.35，mAP 基本不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频时刻检索系统常能提出与目标事件重叠的候选窗口，但最终排序时仍选错窗口，即"评分器瓶颈"。作者在固定时间专家（QD-DETR 派生、parent-aware）的条件下验证该瓶颈：时间专家为 64.71 R1@0.5，而同候选族上的诊断性 oracle 可达 75.68（parent 重排池内）与 94.97（完整 100 候选池），说明瓶颈主要在打分/校验而非候选生成。

Method: OVET-Consensus：一种保持排序的反事实事件校验层。默认沿用时间专家的排序列表，仅允许由在留出训练视频上校准的策略触发的高置信度 rank-1 覆盖。校验器融合多源信号：parent-aware 区间证据、结构化 Qwen3-VL 事件判断、VideoLLaMA3 成对时序信号、稠密时序证据；但禁止这些信号自由重排 top-K 列表。

Result: QVHighlights 验证集上，parent-aware 时间专家由 64.71 提升至 65.35 R1@0.5，配对 bootstrap 区间为正；mAP 由 42.67 至 42.74，基本不变。共发生 20 次覆盖，其中 15 次有益纠正、3 次有害纠正。

Conclusion: 语义兼容性是有效证据，但时序定位仍需判定事件在视觉兼容场景内的起止、变化与结束位置；这构成校验器设计的实际约束——受限的高置信度覆盖优于自由重排。

Abstract: Modern video moment retrieval systems often propose windows that overlap the target event, yet still select the wrong one. We study this scorer bottleneck on QVHighlights with a fixed QD-DETR-derived temporal expert: the parent-aware temporal expert reaches 64.71 R1@0.5, while diagnostic oracles over the same candidate family reach 75.68 R1@0.5 within the parent-reranked pool and 94.97 R1@0.5 over the full 100-candidate evidence pool. We introduce OVET-Consensus, a rank-preserving counterfactual event verification layer that keeps the temporal expert's ranked list as the default and permits only high-confidence rank-1 overrides from a policy calibrated on held-out training videos. The verifier uses parent-aware interval evidence, structured Qwen3-VL event judgments, VideoLLaMA3 pairwise temporal signals, and dense temporal evidence, but never lets those signals freely reorder the top-K list. On QVHighlights validation, OVET-Consensus improves the parent-aware temporal expert from 64.71 to 65.35 R1@0.5 with a positive paired-bootstrap interval, while mAP is largely unchanged, from 42.67 to 42.74; it makes 20 overrides, with 15 helpful corrections and 3 harmful corrections. The results point to a practical constraint on verifier design: semantic compatibility is useful evidence, but temporal grounding still requires deciding where the event starts, changes, and ends inside a visually compatible scene.

</details>


### [95] [REVEAL: Reconstructing Video Amodal Content via Language and Flow Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22645)
*Minh Tran,Winston Bounsavy,Ngan Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: REVEAL：统一文本与光流先验的扩散式视频非模态补全框架，并贡献 LAVAT 长视频基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频非模态补全需在严重遮挡下重建被遮挡内容并保持长序列时序一致性，现有扩散方法缺乏辅助先验引导。

Method: 文本查询双重作用（驱动开放词表视频分割获取可见掩码 + 语义引导纹理重建）；光流引导：将前帧可见掩码 warp 至当前帧，把可见内容传播到遮挡区域近似当前形状，作为形状先验；文本约束被遮挡外观重建并提供稳定语义参考。

Result: 在现有基准上达到 SOTA，并在长序列上保持高质量时序一致性；贡献 LAVAT 基准（长视频+文本描述，重遮挡场景）。

Conclusion: 运动先验与语义先验互补结合可有效提升视频非模态补全的形状推断与外观一致性。

Abstract: Amodal perception enables humans to perceive entire objects even when parts are occluded, a remarkable cognitive skill that artificial intelligence struggles to replicate. Recent diffusion-based methods have extended amodal completion from images to videos, yet they lack auxiliary priors to guide the reconstruction of heavily occluded content and to maintain temporal consistency over long sequences. We present REVEAL (REconstructing VidEo Amodal content via Language and flow guidance), a unified diffusion-based framework that integrates complementary motion and semantic priors for video amodal completion. A user-provided text query serves a dual role: it drives open-vocabulary video segmentation to obtain visible masks, and it provides semantic guidance for texture reconstruction. For amodal segmentation, we introduce optical flow guidance: by warping visible masks from previous frames to the current frame, the flow-warped mask propagates visible content into occluded regions and approximates the object's current shape, providing a strong shape prior even under simultaneous deformation and occlusion. For texture completion, text guidance constrains the reconstruction of occluded appearance while providing a stable semantic reference that helps maintain visual coherence throughout the reconstruction. We also contribute LAVAT, a new benchmark featuring long video sequences paired with text descriptions, enabling evaluation of text-guided video amodal completion under heavy occlusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that REVEAL achieves state-of-the-art performance on existing benchmarks while maintaining high-quality temporal consistency over extended sequences. The project page is available at: https://uark-aicv.github.io/REVEAL/.

</details>


### [96] [Must You See Fakes to Catch Fakes? Language Says What to Look For, Real Images What to Ignore](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22650)
*Tianchi Xu,Yuxuan Zhou,Yuheng Zhang,Yanan Guan,Tao Dai,Shu-Tao Xia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的AI生成图像检测器SaySee：不在生成图像上训练，利用视觉基础模型已习得的"AI生成"概念，通过文本构建生成方向进行打分，并用真实图像校正格式与内容偏移，在24个评测集上平均AUC达98.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检测器面临两大问题：(1)仅在训练集少数生成器上学到的线索具有生成器特异性，跨生成器迁移差，泛化受限；(2)真实与生成训练图像在格式和内容上存在差异，检测器将这些差异误当作真实性证据，导致决策受与真实性无关的因素影响，损害鲁棒性与泛化性。二者根源均在于"在生成图像上训练"。

Method: 提出免训练检测器SaySee，包含两部分：Say——从仅在真实性上存在差异的成对描述集合中构建"生成方向"，将图像嵌入投影到该方向上得到分数；See——利用真实图像校正由格式、图像类型和内容引起的分数偏移。

Result: 在覆盖标准基准、真实场景数据与最新生成器的24个评测集上，SaySee配合MoE-ViE取得平均AUC 98.2%，比最佳现有检测器高4.2个百分点；在将格式与真实性解耦后仍为所有方法中最优。

Conclusion: 检测器无需"见过"生成图像即可检测：借助视觉基础模型预训练中已获得的"AI生成"语义概念与文本引导，可从根本上规避生成器特异性线索和格式/内容伪影带来的泛化与鲁棒性问题。

Abstract: Must a detector see generated images in order to catch them? Detection of AI-generated images has long faced two problems. The cues a detector learns from the few generators in its training set carry traces specific to those generators and transfer poorly to new ones, which limits generalization. The real and generated training images also differ in format and content, so the detector takes these differences as evidence of authenticity, and its decisions change with factors that have nothing to do with authenticity, which harms robustness as well as generalization. Both problems stem from training on generated images. A detector never trained on them can largely avoid both at the source. Vision foundation models have already learned the concept of "AI-generated" during pretraining, and text can point to it directly. Building on this, we propose SaySee, a training-free detector: Say builds a generation direction from sets of paired descriptions that differ only in authenticity and scores an image by the projection of its embedding onto it, and See uses real images to correct the score offsets caused by format, image type and content. On 24 evaluation sets that span standard benchmarks, in-the-wild data and the latest generators, SaySee reaches a mean AUC of 98.2% with MoE-ViE, 4.2 points above the best existing detector. When format is decoupled from authenticity, it remains the best of all methods. Code will be released.

</details>


### [97] [OmniTongue: A Comprehensive MLLM Benchmark for Automated Tongue Diagnosis in Traditional Chinese Medicine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22652)
*Liuyi Xu,Yun Guo,Shusheng Li,Xuewen Zhang,Yining Qian,An-Yang Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OmniTongue——首个面向中医舌诊的综合细粒度视觉问答基准，包含1351张专家校验图像与21616个指令对，覆盖16个临床维度、区域级病理标注与66个细粒度标签，并系统评测现有MLLMs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLMs在西方医学影像上表现优异，但其在中医舌诊中的潜力尚未被系统评估；舌诊需兼具全局与局部感知能力，是检验MLLMs视觉理解深度的严格试金石。现有数据集存在维度单一、粒度粗、标签歧义等问题，难以评估真实临床能力。

Method: 构建OmniTongue基准：整合1351张经专家校验的舌象图像与21616个指令对；核心设计包括16个临床维度以支持多维评估、区域级标注以定位病理、66个细粒度标签以实现精确诊断表征；并在此基础上对现有MLLMs开展大规模评测。

Result: 广泛评测揭示现有MLLMs存在显著性能差距：医学专用模型并未展现出领域优势；普遍偏低的Macro-F1表明模型依赖统计捷径而非对舌象病理的真实理解。

Conclusion: 研究结果既凸显MLLMs在解读区域性医学特征上的当前局限，也说明OmniTongue对发展鲁棒的自动化舌诊模型具有重要意义；代码与数据集将于后续公开。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have excelled in Western medical imaging, yet their potential in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) tongue diagnosis remains systematically unevaluated. Tongue diagnosis requires sophisticated global and local perception, serving as a rigorous touchstone for assessing the visual understanding depth of MLLMs. However, existing datasets are limited by single dimensions, coarse granularity, and ambiguous labels, hindering the evaluation of authentic clinical capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniTongue, the first comprehensive, fine-grained Visual Question Answering benchmark for TCM tongue diagnosis. This benchmark integrates 1,351 expert-validated images and 21,616 instruction pairs. Its core design features 16 clinical dimensions for multidimensional evaluation, region-specific annotations for pathological localization, and 66 fine-grained labels for precise diagnostic representation. Extensive evaluations of existing MLLMs reveal significant performance gaps, demonstrating that medical-specific models lack domain advantages, while universally poor Macro-F1 scores expose a reliance on statistical shortcuts rather than genuine understanding of tongue pathology. These findings not only highlight the current limitations of MLLMs in interpreting regional medical features but also underscore OmniTongue's significance for developing robust automated tongue diagnosis models. The code and dataset will be made publicly available in a future release.

</details>


### [98] [Unified Residual Translation for Paired Image Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22655)
*Joyanta Jyoti Mondal,Mridul Banik,Ibne Farabi Shihab,Md. Shifatul Ahsan Apurba*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出统一残差翻译器URT，将通道/尺度映射（确定性参考）与学习式残差预测解耦，用同一套预测规则、ℓ1目标与优化器统一处理MRI对比度合成、可见光到红外、SAR到光学、真实相机超分四类配对图像恢复任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 配对图像恢复任务（成像对比度变化、传感器模态转换、空间分辨率变化）在输入通道数与目标网格上差异很大，需要回答"预测流程有多少必须针对具体任务专门化"这一问题；作者希望找到一种异构任务通用的表述方式。

Method: URT将流程分为两部分：①确定性参考，用通道平均、通道复制或双三次插值先将输入对齐到目标尺寸；②NAFNet编码器-解码器从完整输入预测加性残差修正。各任务分别训练实例，但共享预测规则、ℓ1目标函数与优化器；另做四种光谱替代方案消融，分析拟合参考与分波段残差增益的互补性。

Result: 在六个任务-尺度设置中，URT在IXI、SEN1-2及RealSR ×3/×4上取得对比基线中最高的PSNR和SSIM：IXI 30.774dB，SEN1-2 13.478dB，RealSR三个尺度亮度PSNR为33.596/28.742/27.342dB；在LLVIP上PSNR与SSIM均列第二。光谱替代研究显示拟合参考与分波段残差增益具有互补收益。

Conclusion: 显式维度对齐加学习式残差修正可作为异构配对成像任务的通用统一表述；任务特异性主要体现在确定性映射，而残差预测规则可跨任务共享。

Abstract: Paired image restoration spans changes in imaging contrast, sensor modality, and spatial resolution. These settings differ in their input channels and target grids, raising the question of how much of the prediction pipeline must be specialized to each task. We present the Unified Residual Translator (URT), which separates fixed channel and scale mapping from learned residual prediction. A deterministic reference uses channel averaging, replication, or bicubic interpolation to match the target dimensions, while a NAFNet encoder-decoder predicts an additive correction from the complete input. Separately trained instances share the prediction rule, $\ell_1$ objective, and optimizer across MRI contrast synthesis, visible-to-infrared translation, SAR-to-optical translation, and real-camera super-resolution. Across six task and scale settings, URT achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM among the evaluated baselines on IXI, SEN1-2, and RealSR $\times3$ and $\times4$. It reaches 30.774dB on IXI and 13.478dB on SEN1-2, with luminance PSNR of 33.596, 28.742, and 27.342dB at the three RealSR scales. On LLVIP, it ranks second in PSNR and SSIM. A study of four spectral alternatives identifies complementary benefits of fitted references and bandwise residual gains. Together, these results support explicit dimensional alignment and learned residual correction as a common formulation for heterogeneous paired imaging tasks.

</details>


### [99] [SpatialCast: Reading the 3D World via Cast Shadows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22657)
*Enhan Li,Jinghao Zhou,Jiaze Zhang,Hongyang Du*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SpatialCast 基准，利用投影阴影（由物体几何/位姿、光照、视点共同决定）系统评估多模态大模型将物理场景条件与视觉观测联系起来的能力；含 21,000 道合成题（分场景与几何测试子集）及 200 道真实照片题。实验显示开源模型接近随机水平，强闭源模型在影长与光源高度判断上仍有困难；用其训练数据做 GRPO 后训练可提升性能，并在多个外部空间基准上表现出迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM 正走向理解并与物理世界交互，空间推理因而至关重要。现有空间基准在空间关系、记忆与视点推理上已有较多积累，但较少系统评估模型如何把物理场景条件与视觉观测关联起来，缺少可控诊断手段。

Method: 以投影阴影作为评估载体：阴影是 3D 场景的可观测证据，其图像外观由物体几何与位姿、光照、视点共同决定。设计三个互补任务：①场景—投影一致性判断；②预测干预引起的变化；③由视觉变化反推物理变化。构建 21,000 道合成问题（场景划分与几何划分分离），并补充来自 20 个实拍场景的 200 道 SpatialCast-Real 题。另用基准训练数据对开源 MLLM 进行 GRPO 后训练。

Result: 闭源 MLLM 优于通用开源权重 MLLM 与专为空间推理设计的 MLLM，后者在合成基准上接近随机水平；即使强闭源模型在影长与光源高度判断上也表现不佳。使用 SpatialCast 数据做 GRPO 后训练可提升开源模型在该基准上的表现，并在若干外部空间基准上取得提升，提示所学能力具有迁移性。

Conclusion: SpatialCast 是一个受控资源，可用于诊断空间推理能力并研究其学习与泛化过程。

Abstract: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance toward understanding and interacting with the physical world, spatial reasoning becomes essential for understanding scene structure and anticipating the effects of physical changes. Existing spatial benchmarks have made substantial progress in evaluating spatial relations, memory, and viewpoint reasoning, but less systematically assess how models connect physical scene conditions with visual observations. We introduce SpatialCast, a benchmark that uses cast shadows to evaluate this ability. Cast shadows provide observable evidence of a 3D scene. Their image appearance depends on object geometry and pose, illumination, and viewpoint. We examine this relationship through three complementary tasks that assess scene-projection consistency, predict intervention-induced changes, and infer the physical changes behind visual transitions. The benchmark contains 21,000 synthetic questions with separate scene and geometry test partitions, complemented by 200 SpatialCast-Real questions from 20 photographed scenes. Evaluations show that closed-source MLLMs outperform general-purpose open-weight MLLMs and MLLMs designed for spatial reasoning, which remain near chance on the synthetic benchmark, while even strong closed-source models struggle with shadow-length and light-height judgments. We also use SpatialCast training data for GRPO post-training, improving open-weight MLLM performance on the benchmark. Further evaluations show improvements on several external spatial benchmarks, suggesting transfer of the learned capabilities. These experiments support SpatialCast as a controlled resource for diagnosing spatial reasoning capabilities and studying their learning and generalization.

</details>


### [100] [Let Samples Sing in Chorus: Mitigating Spurious Correlations via Cross-view Consensus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22668)
*Weiwei Li,Junzhuo Liu,Tong Chu,Hengfu Yu,Yinjie Lei,Wen Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CHORD多视图去偏框架，通过跨多个表示空间的"合唱式"共识聚合类内划分以探测候选偏置，在无偏置标注下实现鲁棒去偏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度模型依赖虚假相关，在欠代表群体上失效。现有方法要么纠正人工指定的偏置属性，要么从单一表示空间中推断未知偏置；但人工标注属性可能与模型实际使用的捷径不一致，且单一表示提供的证据不完整且有噪声。

Method: 核心思想是"在某一特征空间中被遮蔽的偏置，可能在另一空间更清晰"。CHORD在多视图框架中让样本跨多个表示空间"合唱"，对每个视图的类内划分（作为候选偏置的代理）进行聚合，实现跨视图共识；随后在无偏置监督下对目标表示与分类器进行去偏，并通过离群反转（Outlier Reversal）机制强化对少数群体的修正。

Result: 在视觉、语言、语音、医学影像共七个基准上，最差组准确率（worst-group accuracy）均取得一致的提升。

Conclusion: 多视图共识比单一表示更可靠地揭示偏置，无需人工偏置标注即可有效提升最差组鲁棒性，且方法跨模态通用。

Abstract: Deep models often rely on spurious correlations that fail on underrepresented groups. Existing methods either correct human-specified bias attributes or infer unknown biases from the learned representation space. However, annotated attributes may differ from the shortcuts actually used by a model, while a single representation provides incomplete and potentially noisy evidence. Our key insight is that a bias obscured in one feature space may be clearer in another. In this work, we propose CHORD (Cross-view Harmonic Outlier Reversal for Debiasing), a multi-view framework that allows samples to "sing in chorus" across diverse representation spaces to achieve robust cross-view consensus. CHORD aggregates aggregates within-class partitions in each view, which is a proxy for specifying candidate biases, to debias the target representation and classifier without bias supervision. Experiments on seven benchmarks across vision, language, speech, and medical imaging show consistent improvements in worst-group accuracy. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/davelee-uestc/chord_debiasing_public .

</details>


### [101] [Beyond the Camera: A Tri-Modal Driving World Model for Future RGB, Thermal, and LiDAR Forecasting in Adverse Weather](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22669)
*Faysal Mehrab Chowdhury,Md. Mahfuzur Rahman,Ahmed Rafi Hasan,Kishor Datta Gupta,Mohd Ariful Haque,Savannah Shannon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究在对真实恶劣天气序列上RGB、热成像与LiDAR三传感器的联合预测，将LiDAR表示为与RGB相机对齐的深度视频，并以同一视频分词器做压缩匹配的持久性基线对比。结果显示：在同一分词器下，热成像在雾天对持久性基线的"劣势"消失；58条验证序列上后训练的RGB与热成像预测均优于压缩匹配持久性；联合训练将2秒LiDAR误差降低2.1m而仅带来轻微相机保真度损失；仅三传感器模型的LiDAR预测在平均误差上优于持久性；遮挡单一传感器对其它传感器预测的退化在雪天大于雾天。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型多预测相机视频，部分加入LiDAR，但热成像相机（在黑暗和部分恶劣天气下仍可成像）几乎不作为预测目标，据作者所知尚无世界模型同时预测三种传感器。作者希望填补这一空白，并考察在恶劣天气下多传感器联合预测的可行性与收益。

Method: 在DSERT-RoLL数据集真实恶劣天气序列上研究RGB、热成像与LiDAR的联合预测。对每个传感器后训练一个预训练视频世界模型；将LiDAR表示为与RGB相机对齐的深度视频，其稠密化与编码方式依据模型视频分词器可重建的效果来选择。构建一个将三种传感器视为单一视频的三传感器模型。LiDAR以米为单位对照实测回波打分，并与经过同一分词器的持久性基线比较。

Result: 在压缩匹配条件下，热成像模型在雾天相对持久性的表观劣势消失。在六种天气条件的全部58条验证序列上，后训练的RGB与热成像预测均优于压缩匹配持久性。联合训练在2秒时将LiDAR误差降低2.1m，相机保真度仅有小幅代价；且仅有三传感器模型的LiDAR预测在平均误差上优于持久性。遮挡单一传感器会使其它传感器的预测退化，且雪天退化大于雾天。

Conclusion: 三传感器（RGB、热成像、LiDAR）联合世界模型可行且优于压缩匹配持久性基线；联合训练可显著提升LiDAR预测精度且代价很小，传感器间存在互补信息依赖，且在雪天更为明显。同时强调基线需与模型经过相同的分词器以保证公平比较。

Abstract: Driving world models forecast what a vehicle's sensors will record next. Most forecast camera video and some add LiDAR, but thermal cameras, which still see in darkness and some adverse weather, are rarely a forecast target, and to our knowledge no world model forecasts all three sensors. We study joint forecasting of RGB, thermal, and LiDAR on real adverse-weather sequences of the DSERT-RoLL dataset. We post-train a pretrained video world model for each sensor and represent LiDAR as a depth video aligned with the RGB camera, with densification and encoding chosen by what the model's video tokenizer can reconstruct. A tri-sensor model sees all three sensors as one video. We score LiDAR in meters against measured returns and compare against persistence baselines passed through the same tokenizer as the model. With this matching, an apparent loss of the thermal model to persistence in fog disappears. On all 58 validation sequences in six weather conditions, post-trained RGB and thermal forecasts beat compression-matched persistence. Joint training lowers the LiDAR error at 2s by 2.1m at a small cost in camera fidelity, and only the tri-sensor model's LiDAR forecasts beat persistence in mean error. Blanking one sensor degrades the forecasts of the others more in snow than in fog.

</details>


### [102] [FVScore: Specification-Driven Neuro-Symbolic Video Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22673)
*Do Xuan Long,Long T. Le,Yiwen Song,Min-Yen Kan,Tomas Pfister,Yale Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出神经符号框架FVSCORE，通过将视频生成结果编译为显式与隐式命题，结合专用感知工具与软时序算子进行验证，并用显著性感知校准对齐人类判断，实现可溯源、可解释的规格驱动视频生成评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成评测器依赖MLLM整体判断或视觉-语言指标，难以与人类判断对齐，也难以将分数溯源到具体的时序违规点，缺乏可解释性。

Method: FVSCORE将视频编译为两类命题：捕捉提示词要求的显式命题，以及捕捉未明示的物理、时序与跨模态约束的隐式命题；用专用感知工具对每个命题做grounding，得到置信度轨迹；再用受线性时序逻辑（LTL）启发的软时序算子对其评估；最后经显著性感知校准（Significance-Aware Calibration）仅保留感知显著的违规，输出带时间戳与证据的报告。

Result: 在公开基准与复杂多事件基准上，针对当前最强视频模型开展大量实验，FVSCORE在人类相关性上优于整体式与agent式评测器，同时提供高准确、可解释的反馈。

Conclusion: 规格驱动+神经符号的评测路线可有效提升视频生成评测与人类判断的一致性，并实现细粒度时序归因；但摘要未给出具体量化提升幅度与计算开销数据。

Abstract: We introduce Faithfulness Video Score (FVSCORE), a neuro-symbolic framework for specification-driven video generation evaluation. Existing evaluators rely on holistic MLLM judgments or vision-language metrics, yet aligning their scores with human judgments and tracing them to specific temporal violations remain open challenges. FVSCORE addresses these limitations by compiling each video into explicit propositions capturing prompt requirements and implicit propositions capturing unstated physical, temporal, and cross-modal constraints. It grounds each proposition using specialized perceptual tools and evaluates the resulting confidence traces with soft temporal operators inspired by Linear Temporal Logic. A Significance-Aware Calibration step then aligns verification with human perception by retaining only perceptually significant violations before producing a timestamp- and evidence-grounded report. We conduct extensive experiments across public and complex multi-event benchmarks with the strongest video models to date, demonstrating that FVSCORE outperforms holistic and agent-based evaluators in human correlation while providing highly accurate and interpretable feedback.

</details>


### [103] [Classification of Tissues on MALDI-MSI Image Modality for Pancreatic Cancer Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22680)
*Abubakar Qahir,Jenny Benois-Pineau,Victoria Bourgeais,Fabien Baldacci,Sandrine Dabernat,Nicolas Desbenoit,Mélanie Moreau,Mehdi Boubaddi,Marion Marty*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出全自动MALDI-MSI数据预处理与深度学习流水线，将原始谱图转为图像块用于胰腺肿瘤vs非肿瘤的二分类，质量接近人工流程但耗时从一整天降至约20分钟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MSI可空间映射组织切片中的分子分布，但现有预处理工具难以直接构建面向深度学习的端到端工作流，且人工交互式处理耗时过长。

Method: 开发全自动流水线，将原始MALDI-MSI数据转换为可供深度学习使用的图像块（patch），并分别在高/低分辨率谱图上训练单模型进行肿瘤区域识别；与参考交互式流程通过MSE进行图像质量对比，并记录计算耗时。

Result: 所提流水线输出图像与参考交互式流程在MSE指标上非常接近；平均计算时间约20分钟，而参考流程需整整一个工作日；模型在高分辨率谱图上达到0.94准确率，在低分辨率谱图上平均准确率为0.59。

Conclusion: 自动化流水线可在保证图像质量的前提下大幅提升MSI预处理效率，并支持有效的肿瘤区域分类；低分辨率谱图性能明显下降，提示谱图质量对模型精度影响显著。

Abstract: Mass Spectrometry Imaging (MSI) spatially maps molecular distributions in tissue sections. Despite the availability of preprocessing tools for MSI data, building end-to-end workflows suitable for deep learning remains challenging. We have developed a fully automated pipeline for transformation of raw Matrix-Assisted Laser Desorption/Ionization Mass Spectrometry imaging (MALDI-MSI) data into deep-learning-ready image patches for binary pancreatic tissue classification (tumoral vs non-tumoral) and built individual models for recognition of tumoral regions in spectral images. Images resulting from the proposed pipeline and from reference interactive workflow are very close in terms of image quality metric mean squared error (MSE). The proposed pipeline computational time is of 20 min in average compared to a full working day of the reference interactive workflow. The models achieved 0.94 accuracy on high-resolution spectra and a mean accuracy of 0.59 on lower-resolution spectra.

</details>


### [104] [CascadeJEPA: Enhancing 3D Geometric Representations via Spatially Coupled Cascaded Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22686)
*Kailai Zhou,Ziqi Chen,Xiaoning Xu,Yuefeng Wu,Zixuan Fu,Zijun Lin,Zhihao Li,Youwei Pang,Xiaoqi Zhao,Xun Cao,Bihan Wen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CascadeJEPA：通过全网格上下文编码与级联预测阶段间的交叉注意力增强 patch 级交互，缓解 I-JEPA 语义与几何表征失衡的问题，在保持语义识别性能的同时显著提升 3D 几何任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者分析 I-JEPA 发现语义学习与几何学习之间存在逐渐扩大的落差：预训练中语义识别能力提升的同时，3D 几何表征反而退化。其假设原因是：以不完整的空间上下文去预测高度抽象的隐表征，使模型偏好语义规律而牺牲细粒度几何信息。

Method: 提出 CascadeJEPA，一种空间耦合的级联预测框架：采用全网格（full-grid）上下文编码以获得完整空间信息，并在多个预测阶段之间引入跨注意力（cross-attention），促进更丰富的 patch 级交互；同时尽量保留原始 I-JEPA 架构。

Result: 在多个 3D 几何任务上相对 I-JEPA 取得显著提升，同时维持较强的语义识别性能；优势还延伸到未来特征预测与世界模型规划任务。

Conclusion: 预测式视觉表征学习中，空间上下文的完整性与阶段间的 patch 级交互对几何表征质量至关重要；增强的几何表征可支撑预测式世界建模，说明语义与几何能力可协同而非互斥。

Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for predictive visual representation learning. However, our analysis of I-JEPA reveals a growing discrepancy between semantic and geometric learning: improved semantic recognition during pretraining is accompanied by degraded 3D geometric representations. We hypothesize that this partly stems from predicting highly abstract latent representations with incomplete spatial context, favoring semantic regularities over fine-grained geometric information. To address this issue, we introduce CascadeJEPA, a spatially coupled cascaded prediction framework that promotes richer patch-level interactions through full-grid context encoding and cross-attention between prediction stages, while largely preserving the original I-JEPA architecture. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial improvements over I-JEPA across multiple 3D geometric tasks while maintaining strong semantic recognition performance. Furthermore, its advantages extend to future feature forecasting and world model planning, highlighting the potential of enhanced geometric representations to support predictive world modeling.

</details>


### [105] [TANGO: Real-World Unregistered RGB-Guided Hyperspectral Super-Resolution with Two-Camera Acquisitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22699)
*Matteo Kolyszko,Marco Buzzelli,Simone Bianco,Raimondo Schettini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出首个大规模真实双相机未配准RGB引导高光谱超分辨数据集DUET，并给出对齐方法TANGO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未配准高光谱图像超分辨已有方法开始处理模态间几何失配，但缺乏基于真实双相机采集、且带高分辨率HSI参考的大规模公开基准，导致评估受限。

Method: 构建DUET数据集（403个室内外场景，分别用RGB与高光谱相机采集）；提出TANGO：先通过端到端全局对齐补偿主导的跨相机位移，再用由粗到细的局部特征对齐修正残余不一致，并引入学习式门控机制在双视图无法一致匹配处削弱RGB引导。

Result: 在DUET与REAL数据集上所有评估尺度因子下均取得SOTA；在DUET上PSNR最高领先最强对手2.29 dB，同时FLOPs减少2.5倍。

Conclusion: DUET填补了真实未配准RGB-HSI超分辨基准的空白，TANGO通过全局-局部对齐加门控引导实现了高精度、低计算量的未配准高光谱超分辨。

Abstract: Unregistered hyperspectral image super-resolution aims to recover a high-resolution HSI from a low-resolution hyperspectral observation and an unregistered high-resolution RGB reference. Although recent methods have begun to address the geometric misalignment between the two modalities, their evaluation is still constrained by the lack of a large-scale public benchmark based on real two-camera RGB--HSI acquisitions with a high-resolution HSI reference. To address this gap, we introduce DUET, the first large-scale public dataset for unregistered RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution, comprising 403 indoor and outdoor scenes captured with two separate RGB and hyperspectral cameras. We further propose TANGO (Two-camera AligNment with Gated Occlusions), which first compensates for the dominant cross-camera displacement through end-to-end global alignment and then refines the remaining inconsistencies with a coarse-to-fine local feature alignment. A learned gating mechanism further attenuates the RGB guidance where the two views cannot be consistently matched. Experimental results show that TANGO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both DUET and REAL across all evaluated scale factors, outperforming the strongest competitor on DUET by up to 2.29 dB in PSNR while requiring 2.5$\times$ fewer FLOPs. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/FagiolottoConSombrero/TANGO-DUET

</details>


### [106] [Social Signal Bench: Evidence-Weighted Evaluation of Co-occurring Social Signals in Video and Audio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22704)
*Siddharth Ravi,Anders R. Bargum,Hugo Anselme,Patrizio Cugia di Sant'Orsola,Alberto Cardaci,Flora Kincso Parragi,Vincent Borowiec,Line H. Clemmensen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Social Signal Bench（47小时密集标注基准，含视频25小时/音频22小时两个数据集）及 Evidence-Weighted F1（EW-F1）评估指标，用于社会信号识别与参与度评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 识别兴趣、犹豫等社会信号需理解会话中共现的情境依赖行为，但现有情感计算基准很少评估共现信号，且传统多标签 F1 忽略语义关系与标注者分歧。

Method: 构建 47 小时密集标注基准：Social Signal Bench Video（25 小时，视听数据，10 类信号）与 Social Signal Bench Audio（22 小时，纯音频，6 类信号）；每个数据集由公开训练集（在线会话视频，10 小时专家标注、其余伪标注）与覆盖四个会话领域的私有专家标注测试集配对。提出 EW-F1：按标注者证据加权参考标签，并通过逐片段最优匹配对语义相关预测给予梯度得分。

Result: 受控扰动实验表明 EW-F1 能区分语义相关错误与无关错误，而传统 F1 无法做到；在统一评估协议下，基于该基准后训练的 7B 开源模型在视频任务上优于通用前沿模型，在音频任务上与之持平。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了面向共现社会信号的标准化评估资源与更贴合语义与标注分歧的指标，并证明领域后训练可使中小规模开源模型达到或超越前沿通用模型。

Abstract: Recognizing social signals such as interest and hesitation requires interpreting context-dependent behaviors that may co-occur in conversation. Existing affective computing benchmarks rarely evaluate such co-occurring signals, and conventional multi-label F1 overlooks semantic relationships and annotator disagreement. We introduce Social Signal Bench, a 47-hour densely annotated benchmark for the evaluation of social signal recognition and engagement, comprising two datasets: Social Signal Bench Video (25 hours), covering ten social signals in audiovisual recordings, and Social Signal Bench Audio (22 hours), covering six signals in audio-only recordings. Each dataset pairs a public training set of online conversational video, of which 10 hours are expert-annotated and the remainder pseudo-labeled, with a private expert-labeled test set spanning four conversational domains. We also propose Evidence-Weighted F1 (EW-F1), which weights reference labels by annotator evidence and assigns graded credit to semantically related predictions through optimal per-clip matching. Controlled perturbations demonstrate that EW-F1 distinguishes semantically related errors from unrelated ones, unlike conventional F1. Under a shared evaluation protocol, 7B open models post-trained on Social Signal Bench outperform general-purpose frontier models on video and match them on audio.

</details>


### [107] [Know When to Zoom: How Small Is Too Small for Vision-Language Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22709)
*Siddharth Vohra,Min Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统量化了在线视觉语言模型处理大图时小细节的丢失程度，并提出分块与两步缩放等补救策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线视觉语言模型服务通常会在模型看到图像前缩小或直接拒收大尺寸图片，导致大图中宽度很小的对象（如8000×6000无人机照片中20像素宽的汽车被压到约6像素）丢失细节，而现有研究缺乏对该问题的定量刻画。

Method: 作者用打印编码的"视力测试"和针对真实照片中小物体的601个问题，评测4家厂商7个模型的细节保留能力；对比分块（最多9块）、两步缩放（模型先指出所需区域）等策略，并考察基于细节大小的预检查与基于模型"不确定"回复的触发式分块。

Result: 模型能半数正确识别的最小文字尺寸在默认设置下由小图的≤6像素增至7680×4320照片上的预测10–13像素；分块使Claude与Gemini准确率提升11.1–14.5个百分点，并使GPT-6.1 Sol从50.7%升至83.7%（主要因避免拒收）；两步缩放在Gemini上追平或超过分块，在Claude上差距仅2.5个点且仅用约40%图像token；细节丢失时两者约半数承认无法判断，但Gemini有43%–48%给出自信的错误答案，Claude仅5%–9%；基于细节大小的预检查几乎无法复现分块收益，而"先不确定再分块"在Claude上距始终分块仅1.4个点，仅用62%–70%的token。

Conclusion: 大图细节损失普遍且厂商间失败模式差异显著；分块与两步缩放能有效恢复细节，其中基于模型自身不确定回复的触发式分块是高性价比方案。作者据此提出智能体何时应缩放的五条规则，并公开视力测试、全部模型回答与代码。

Abstract: Online vision-language models often miss small details in large images, because the service shrinks the image, or rejects it, before the model ever sees it. A car 20 pixels wide in an 8000 by 6000 drone photo reaches Claude about 6 pixels wide, and OpenAI's default rejects the photo outright. We measure how much detail survives for seven models from four vendors, using an eye exam of printed codes and 601 questions about small objects in real photos. The smallest text a model reads half the time grows from 6 pixels or less on a small image to a predicted 10 to 13 pixels on a 7680 by 4320 photo at default settings. Zooming wins much of the detail back. Splitting each photo into up to nine tiles raises accuracy by 11.1 to 14.5 percentage points for Claude and Gemini, and by avoiding rejections it lifts GPT-6.1 Sol from 50.7% to 83.7%. A two-step zoom, in which the model first names the region it needs, matches or beats tiles on Gemini and comes within 2.5 points of them on Claude, with about 40% of their image tokens. When a detail is lost, Claude and Gemini both say they cannot tell about half the time, but they fail differently in the rest: Gemini gives a confident wrong answer in 43% to 48% of these cases, Claude in only 5% to 9%. A check based on detail size, run before the call, misses most of the gain from tiles on Claude and Gemini, but Claude's own reply is a reliable trigger: tiling only after an unsure reply comes within 1.4 points of always tiling with 62% to 70% of the image tokens. We turn these findings into five rules for when an agent should zoom, and release the eye exam, every model answer and code at https://siddvoh.com/know-when-to-zoom.

</details>


### [108] [PCRG: Training-Free Pruning and Caching of Reference Tokens for Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22717)
*Siyuan Wang,Haoran Li,Yi Yue,Tak L. Fung,Quan Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PCRG：无需训练、即插即用的参考token剪枝与缓存方法，依据VAE潜变量冗余度r与VLM条件器重要性g将参考token分为剪枝/缓存/保留三级，加速参考到视频扩散Transformer生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参考到视频扩散Transformer将全部参考帧与生成token打包为单一全注意力序列，参考token约占一半；注意力代价随序列长度二次增长，使参考token占据更大计算份额，但其中多数为静态、平滑或与输出无关的冗余信息，存在显著加速空间。

Method: 训练无关、即插即用。利用模型已有两路信号对每个参考token分级：(1)来自VAE潜变量的低层冗余度r——token潜变量随时间或邻域变化微小则贡献新内容少；(2)来自VLM条件器的高层重要性g——提示词及首/末帧对该token的注意力反映输出是否需要读取。非冗余token保留；冗余token若重要则缓存、否则剪枝。剪枝token在首步前移出序列且保持全部RoPE位置不变；缓存token的K/V仅计算一次并复用；保留token照常处理。

Result: 在已蒸馏至8步并量化至int8的MiniMax-H3上，PCRG端到端在自建V2V-Bench加速1.57×、在公开VACE-Benchmark加速1.49×，VBench质量仅分别下降0.24%与0.17%。与步缓存及稀疏注意力可叠加：V2V-Bench上配合TeaCache达1.86×、配合Spark近无损达1.82×、配合Veda达2.15×。

Conclusion: PCRG通过缩短序列长度而非改变注意力计算方式或采样步数实现加速，与步级缓存和稀疏注意力正交可组合，具备良好的通用性与叠加增益。

Abstract: Reference-to-video diffusion transformers pack the variational autoencoder (VAE) latents of all references and the generated tokens into one full-attention sequence, in which reference tokens make up about half. Because attention cost grows quadratically with sequence length, these tokens take up an even larger share of the attention computation, yet most of them are static, smooth or irrelevant to the output. To accelerate reference-conditioned generation, we propose pruning and caching of reference tokens for video generation (PCRG), a training-free, plug-and-play method that uses two signals the model already computes to assign each reference token to one of three tiers, namely pruned, cached or kept. The first is a low-level redundancy r from VAE latents, since a token whose latent barely changes over time or across its neighbors adds little new content. The second is a high-level importance g from the vision-language-model (VLM) conditioner, where the attention that the prompt and any first or last frames pay to a token tells whether the output needs to read it. Tokens that are not redundant are kept, and redundant tokens are cached if important and pruned otherwise. Pruned tokens leave the sequence before the first step with all rotary position embedding positions unchanged. Cached tokens have their keys and values computed once and reused, and kept tokens are processed as usual. On MiniMax-H3, already distilled to 8 timesteps and quantized to int8, PCRG is 1.57x faster end to end on our V2V-Bench and 1.49x faster on the public VACE-Benchmark, while the quality of VBench drops by only 0.24% and 0.17%, respectively.
