We applied VITAL across epidemiology and treatment-landscape analysis, site selection, enrolment rescue and trial-design trade-off support to translate autonomy, reversibility, transparency and patient impact into proportionate validation activities, evidence requirements and auditable reconstruction of system behaviour. VITAL may inform evidence requirements and lifecycle accountability for higher-risk pharmaceutical uses; evaluation should assess reproducibility across assessors, organisations and system configurations.

</details>


### [270] [Structured AI ideation yields physical strategies for epithelial barrier repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22988)
*Geonho Nah,Johyun Park,Kyung-Ah Cho,Suyoung Hwang,Yoon Hee Lim,Eun-kyung Min,Seunghyun Moon,Donghyun Koh,Seungwon Kim,Jiho Park,Hojin Yoo,Myungsun Nam,Haneul Choi,Kyungsu Kim,In-Sun Hong,YunJae Jung,Minhyeong Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Abelio：一个通过重构研究目标、跨学科元素选取与假设精炼来生成新颖研究方向的AI系统，其生成的假设在量化评测中优于前沿大模型，并在肠道上皮屏障修复场景中产出经独立实验验证的可行性方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI已能辅助文献分析、候选方案评估与假设精炼，但如何帮助研究者跳出既有学科范式的路径依赖、探索学科边界之外的研究方向，仍是未解决的难题。

Method: 构建Abelio系统，流水线包含三阶段：重构研究目标（reformulate objectives）、以替代性表述检索常规学科边界之外的相关元素（Element Selection）、精炼所得假设（Refinement）；每个阶段均由专门子系统实现发散性探索与收敛性选择的结合。评估上采用量化对比（与四个前沿LLM比较科学合理性、假设多样性、与现有文献的距离）及子系统消融实验；并以肠道上皮屏障修复为案例，在损伤Caco-2单层细胞模型中独立验证所提方案。

Result: Ideation Core生成的方案在科学合理性与假设多样性上优于四个前沿LLM，在与现有文献的距离上优于其中三个；消融实验表明各子系统均对目标属性有贡献，且Element Selection的作用在Refinement之前即可测得。案例中提出的膜锚定PEG与胆固醇锚定互补DNA两种物理干预在Caco-2模型中均获验证：PEG以膜表面依赖方式维持屏障功能，互补DNA实现可序列特异性、可按需逆转的屏障恢复。

Conclusion: 结构化研究构思流程能够识别超出既定学科惯例、且具备实验可检验性的研究路径，说明AI可有效拓展研究者的探究空间而非仅做效率工具。

Abstract: AI systems increasingly support literature analysis, candidate evaluation and hypothesis refinement, but enabling researchers to explore research directions beyond established disciplinary approaches remains challenging. We developed Abelio, an AI system designed to generate novel research directions by expanding investigators' avenues of inquiry. Abelio reformulates research objectives, uses these alternative formulations to identify relevant elements outside conventional disciplinary boundaries, and refines the resulting hypotheses. Each stage integrates divergent exploration with convergent selection through a dedicated subsystem. In quantitative evaluations, proposals generated by the Ideation Core (Abelio's hypothesis-generation core) outperformed those of four frontier large language models in scientific soundness and hypothesis diversity, and three of four in distance from existing literature. Subsystem ablation showed that each subsystem contributes to the property it targets, with the contribution of Element Selection measurable before Refinement. To investigate intestinal epithelial barrier restoration, Abelio proposed physical interventions involving membrane-tethered poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG) and cholesterol-anchored complementary DNA. Both proposals were archived before experimentation and subsequently tested independently in damaged Caco-2 monolayers. PEG preserved barrier function in a membrane-surface-dependent manner, whereas complementary DNA enabled sequence-specific restoration that was reversible on demand. These findings demonstrate how structured research ideation can identify experimentally testable approaches beyond established disciplinary conventions.

</details>


### [271] [RagHarnessDebugger: Jev-Guided Agentic RAG in Contract Inference Repair Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22991)
*Moriya Dechtiar,Daniel Martin Katz,Michael J. Bommarito,Hongming Wang,Sylvain Jaume*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 RagHarnessDebugger 调试框架，记录并审计 RAG 修复过程中的每一次决策，暴露聚合指标掩盖的失败模式，并据此改进 harness 提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体式 RAG 系统需通过补充证据、测试替代策略来自我修复答案，但准确率等聚合指标会产生误导，难以判断修复是否真正生效，也缺少对"修复为何缺失"的根因可见性。

Method: 构建基于 Jev 引导 harness 的调试器：记录修复旅程中每一次修复决策，进行契约推断（contract inference），并审计记录——校验每条 trace 完整、每个验证应用于其所归属的候选、以及接受规则可达哪些答案；结合带标注的错误分析与反事实重放机制追踪执行路径直至最终决策。

Result: 在 ContractNLI 保密协议上用两个 reader 模型及独立合同复制集测试：审计层揭示策略接受成本（修复 vs 回归）与策略接受缺口，开发集与复制集分别有 77% 和 76% 的可用修复未被实现；改进后 harness 相比初始 BM25-only 基线准确率提升 3.6（开发）与 3.7（复制）个百分点，完整合同访问参考分数亦提升 1.1 与 2.4。

Conclusion: 该调试器可对遗漏修复进行决策级根因分析；其核心价值在于提供判断可见性，支撑 RAG 决策的持续改进与可解释性。

Abstract: Agentic systems using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must repair their own answers by gathering more evidence, testing alternative policies and deciding if, when, and what repairs are needed. Yet how do we know if a system's repairs are working when metrics like accuracy can be misleading? We present RagHarnessDebugger, a framework that records every repair decision in a Jev-guided harness for contract inference and audits the record to facilitate complete debugging of all decisions taken during a RAG repair journey. RagHarnessDebugger checks that each trace is intact, that each validation applies to the candidate it is counted for, and which answers the acceptance rule can reach. We tested our approach on ContractNLI non-disclosure agreements with two reader models and a replication set of separate contracts. Our debugger's audit layer exposed failure patterns that were hidden under aggregate metrics, policies acceptance cost of repairs vs regressions and policy acceptance gap of 77% and 76% of available but unrealised repairs on development and replication sets. Our audit, together with a labeled error analysis and replay mechanism, allowed following the execution path all the way to the terminal decision - uncovering where missing repairs became lost. Our revised harness improved accuracy over the initial BM25-only baseline by 3.6 points on development contracts and 3.7 points on the replication set, and even improved our full contract access reference score by 1.1 on development and 2.4 on replication set. While our work here demonstrates how the debugger can conduct decision root-cause analysis for missed repairs, the true value lies with providing this debugger for judgment visibility serving continuous improvement of RAG decisions and their explainability.
  Keywords: agentic RAG, AI evidence repair, harness explainability, counterfactual replay, Jev, ContractNLI

</details>


### [272] [PhysScope: Agentic Multimodal Physics Reasoning with Grounded Visual Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23010)
*Haoyang Liu,Kecheng Liang,Xinyu Li,Weixing Chen,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PhysScope——一种推理时视觉"外挂"框架，通过显式管理物理适用范围与依赖关系，实现VLM物理推理中的自我纠错，无需更新权重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM能正确解读物理图示，但会把约束条件错误地套用到其并不成立的状态或前提之外，导致"适用范围错配"(scope mismatch)，且这种前提错误会沿后续计算链传播。现有方法未对此进行显式建模与修正。

Method: PhysScope为推理时视觉harness：(1) 让模型将物理适用范围直接与视觉观测关联；(2) 显式构造派生视图以支撑推理；(3) 对状态区分、条件与物理适用范围施加显式约束；(4) 校验智能体提出的修订是否与来源及范围一致；(5) 被接受的修订会使已注册的依赖项失效，从而维护"范围感知"的工作记忆。

Result: 在PhysAlign上，对6个评测VLM解题得分均优于直接求解；以Gemini-3.8-flash为例，较Canvas-CoT提升9.34个百分点，并在分布外基准PhysUniBench上显著提升求解准确率。消融实验支持"显式范围管理"与"依赖维护"作为多模态物理解题智能体的设计原则。

Conclusion: 显式的物理范围管理与前提依赖追踪是提升多模态物理推理可靠性的有效设计原则，可在不改动模型权重的前提下缓解前提错误传播问题。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can correctly interpret physics diagrams yet apply constraints outside the states or conditions in which they hold, causing premise errors to propagate through subsequent calculations. We introduce PhysScope, an inference-time visual harness that supports self-correction of these scope mismatches without updating model weights. PhysScope enables the model to link physical scopes directly to its visual observations and explicitly constructs derived views to support reasoning. The harness imposes explicit constraints on state distinctions, conditions, and physical scopes during model reasoning, and checks agent-proposed revisions against sources and scopes. Accepted revisions invalidate registered dependents, thereby maintaining scope-aware working memory. On PhysAlign, PhysScope achieves higher solving scores than direct solving across all six evaluated VLMs. With Gemini-3.8-flash, it outperforms Canvas-CoT by 9.34 percentage points and substantially improves solving accuracy on the out-of-distribution (OOD) PhysUniBench benchmark. Ablation studies support explicit scope management and dependency maintenance as design principles for multimodal physics reasoning agents.

</details>


### [273] [PeriaTrace: Tooth-Level Grounding Diagnosis and Patient-Facing Explanations from Periapical Radiographs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23012)
*Zhenhuan Zhou,Yuchen Zhang,Jingbo Zhu,Shiqing Ma,Yanlin Wu,Tao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PeriaTrace：三阶段框架实现根尖片"牙位级诊断—视觉可溯源报告生成—患者友好解释与护理建议"一体化，在12,877张根尖片上验证，内部宏Dice 85.35%、BLEU-4 0.6504、牙位定位+FDI识别联合F1 94.37%、grounding标签F1 77.93%，外部队列中91.16%/84.52%的报告被资深牙髓专科医师认为可直接保留或小幅修订，单张生成平均4.41秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 根尖片（PR）是牙髓诊断的核心依据，但人工阅片与撰写报告耗时；专业术语阻碍患者理解；现有自动化方法多在"发现—图像证据"之间缺乏牙位级关联，缺乏可溯源性，也缺少面向患者的通俗沟通输出。

Method: 提出PeriaTrace三阶段框架：(1) 牙位级诊断，联合牙齿定位与FDI编号识别；(2) 视觉接地的报告生成，在发现与图像证据间建立牙位级grounding标签；(3) 面向患者的通俗语言解释与护理建议生成。基于内部数据集12,877张PR并加两个外部临床队列进行开发与评估，采用分割Dice、BLEU-4、定位/FDI联合F1、grounding-tag F1，以及牙髓专科医师评分与196名非医学背景受试者问卷。

Result: 内部评估：宏Dice 85.35%，BLEU-4 0.6504，牙位定位+FDI识别联合F1 94.37%，grounding-tag F1 77.93%。两个外部队列中，资深牙髓专科医师判定91.16%与84.52%的报告可"保留或修订即用"，无需完全重写。平均生成耗时4.41秒/张，较人工撰写快数十倍。196名无医学背景受试者中，96.4%偏好含通俗解释与护理建议的报告，84.7%认为视觉定位提示有帮助。

Conclusion: PeriaTrace可在保证牙位级证据可溯源的前提下实现快速报告生成，兼顾临床复核效率与医患沟通，具备临床转化潜力。

Abstract: Periapical radiographs (PRs) are central to endodontic diagnosis, but interpreting them and preparing reports are time-consuming. Technical language can limit patients' understanding, while existing automated methods often lack tooth-level links between findings and image evidence. We present PeriaTrace, a three-stage framework integrating tooth-level diagnosis, visually grounded report generation, and patient-friendly explanations and care recommendations. PeriaTrace was developed and evaluated using 12,877 PRs from an internal dataset and two external clinical cohorts. In internal evaluation, it achieved a macro Dice coefficient of 85.35%, BLEU-4 of 0.6504, an F1 score of 94.37% for joint tooth localization and Fédération Dentaire Internationale (FDI) identification, and a grounding-tag F1 score of 77.93%. In the two external cohorts, senior endodontists considered 91.16% and 84.52% of reports suitable for retention or revision without complete rewriting. Generation averaged 4.41 seconds per PR, several tens of times faster than manual drafting. Among 196 survey participants without medical backgrounds, 96.4% preferred reports with plain-language explanations and care recommendations, and 84.7% found visual localization cues helpful. PeriaTrace may enable faster, evidence-traceable reporting while supporting clinical review and patient communication. (Abridged version)

</details>


### [274] [ForecastGym: A Live, Controlled, and Replayable Benchmark for Forecasting Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23045)
*Yicheng Tao,Yuante Li,Zipei Fan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ForecastGym 每两天抓取四个商用搜索 API 对开放预测市场问题的返回结果，冻结证据后离线回放，实现固定证据获取策略下的模型、记忆与搜索源对比。首个版本含150个问题、614个证据状态、13.1万条搜索结果。实验显示：结算后重跑查询会泄漏结果（最高92%的问题几乎直接给出答案），且所有被测 LLM 在冻结证据上仍不及市场；搜索 API 切换带来的 Brier 分数变化（≤0.043）超过模型间差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 预测智能体的评估存在两个混淆：(1) 在线评估中各系统自行检索，检索与推理混杂；(2) 回溯式检索会通过日期过滤或今日的历史页面排序泄漏后续信息。要比较模型、搜索源与记忆策略，必须同时固定证据并记录证据在结果揭晓前的演化过程。

Method: 构建 ForecastGym 平台：对开放式预测市场问题每两天调用四个商用 Web 搜索 API 采集结果并存储，待结果确定后离线回放冻结证据；在固定的证据获取策略下比较不同模型、记忆策略与已捕获的搜索源。首个发布版包含150个问题、614个证据状态（每问题每采集时点一个）及13.1万条搜索结果；并做诊断分析，区分"遗漏公开信息"与"误读证据"对预测差距的贡献，另设结算后重跑查询的泄漏检验。

Result: 结算后重跑相同查询，对最多92%的问题返回的结果几乎直接揭示答案，测试的日期过滤未能阻止。在冻结证据上，所有被测 LLM 的预测准确度均落后于市场。诊断分析表明，在高差距状态下，遗漏公开信息对差距的贡献大于误读。切换搜索 API 可使模型 Brier 分数变化达0.043，超过模型间的差异幅度；持久化笔记与重读全部证据得分相近，但仅用一半输入 token。

Conclusion: 预测智能体的表现既取决于模型也取决于其看到的证据，证据本身可能与读取证据的模型同等重要。评估须控制证据来源以分离检索与推理；同时，持久记忆可作为高效的证据复用手段。

Abstract: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) increasingly forecast real-world events by searching the Web and reasoning over what they find. How well such an agent forecasts depends on both the retrieved evidence and the model, making control over that evidence essential for evaluation. Live evaluations can mix retrieval with reasoning when each system searches on its own, while retrospective search can leak later information through date filters or today's ranking of historical pages. Comparing models, search sources, and memory strategies requires both fixed evidence and a record of how it evolved before resolution. We introduce ForecastGym, which records what four commercial web search APIs return for open prediction-market questions every two days and replays this frozen evidence offline once outcomes are known, comparing models, memory, and captured search sources under a fixed evidence-acquisition policy. Its first release covers 150 questions, 614 evidence states, one per question and collection time, and 131k search results. Rerunning the same queries after settlement returns results that all but state the outcome for up to 92% of the questions, despite the tested date filters. On the frozen evidence, all tested LLMs trail the market in forecasting accuracy. Our diagnostic analysis suggests that missed public information contributes more to the gap in high-gap states than misreading does. Switching the search API changes a model's Brier score by up to 0.043, more than the spread across models, while persistent notes score similarly to rereading all evidence at half the input tokens. The evidence a forecaster sees can matter as much as the model that reads it.

</details>


### [275] [FrameRouter: Frame Budget Routing for Long-Video Understanding on Video-MME-v2 and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23055)
*Bingjun Luo,Jialin Guo,Siqi Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出现有长视频问答评测对每个问题采用统一的帧预算，忽略了不同问题对视觉证据需求的差异，提出在固定平均预算约束下按问题难度路由帧预算的无训练测试时框架 FrameRouter。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Video-MME-v2 等长视频问答基准对所有问题使用统一的帧数预算，但不同查询所需证据量差异巨大；作者分析发现不同问题子集偏好不同的冻结帧预算策略，且统一增加帧数并不能稳定提升所有指标，因此需要按问题分配帧预算。

Method: 提出 fixed-mean frame-budget routing（固定均值帧预算路由）这一受控推理设定：每个问题可获不同帧预算，但平均预算与统一基线一致。在此设定下设计 FrameRouter，一个免训练的测试时框架，包含三部分：证据需求路由器（判断问题所需视觉证据量）、预算约束分配规则（在总预算约束下分配帧数）、以及由多种帧采样策略构成、保持冻结的策略库。

Result: 在 Video-MME-v2 及多个长视频理解基准上，FrameRouter 在相同平均视觉预算下，通过更有选择性地跨问题分配预算，提升了长视频问答性能。

Conclusion: 帧预算应作为可路由的资源而非统一超参数；通过仅控制每问题获得的视觉证据量而不改动底层采样器，FrameRouter 与查询感知的帧选择方法正交，可组合使用。

Abstract: Long-video question answering benchmarks like Video-MME-v2 typically evaluate systems under a uniform frame budget for every question, despite stark variation in the evidence each query actually demands. We analyze this mismatch on Video-MME-v2 and find that different question subsets prefer different frozen frame-budget policies, while uniformly increasing the frame count does not reliably improve all metrics. These findings motivate fixed-mean frame-budget routing, a controlled inference setting in which each question may receive a different frame budget while the average budget matches a uniform reference. We introduce FrameRouter, a training-free test-time framework that combines an evidence-demand router, a budget-constrained allocation rule, and a frozen bank of frame-sampling policies. By controlling how much visual evidence each question receives while leaving the underlying samplers unchanged, FrameRouter is orthogonal to query-aware frame selection. Across Video-MME-v2 and several long-video understanding benchmarks, FrameRouter improves long-video question answering by using the same average visual budget more selectively across questions. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/FrameRouter.

</details>


### [276] [Deep Reinforcement Learning for Heat Pump and Underfloor Heating Control: An End-to-End Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23063)
*Antonio Manjavacas,David Suárez-Caro,Alejandro Campoy-Nieves,Guillermo Rey,Gonzalo Satrústegui,Miguel Molina-Solana*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文以端到端案例研究验证了深度强化学习（DRL）控制器在地暖-热泵耦合系统中的实际部署可行性：经仿真预研与数字孪生训练后，最优智能体无需在线微调即在真实住宅中维持了室内热舒适并动态调节供水温度与阀门开度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地暖系统热惯性大、动态响应慢，与热泵耦合后控制难度高；DRL可同时优化能耗与热舒适，但现有研究多在仿真中进行，缺乏在真实有人居住建筑中的实际运行验证，数字策略向物理系统迁移的可行性尚不明确。

Method: 提出"开发—评估—部署"三阶段流程：(1) 基于仿真的先导研究，比较不同DRL算法、控制策略与配置；(2) 构建真实住宅的数字孪生，在模拟工况下训练DRL智能体；(3) 选取性能最优智能体部署至实体建筑，且不进行额外的在线微调。

Result: 实测结果显示，该控制器能将室内温度维持在设定的舒适区间内，同时动态调节热泵供水温度与地暖阀门开度；验证了DRL控制器在有人居住建筑中部署的可行性，并揭示了策略由数字环境向真实供暖系统迁移时的鲁棒性及实际挑战。

Conclusion: DRL控制策略可成功落地于真实地暖-热泵系统，数字孪生训练+零样本部署具备工程可行性；但仿真到现实的迁移仍存在实际差距，需在后续研究中关注模型精度、安全约束与部署鲁棒性。

Abstract: Efficient control of underfloor heating (UFH) systems coupled with heat pumps (HPs) is challenging due to the high thermal inertia of buildings and the slow dynamic response of UFH systems. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers a data-driven control approach capable of simultaneously optimizing energy consumption and thermal comfort. However, the application of DRL-based controllers in occupied buildings under real operating conditions remains limited. This work presents and end-to-end case study (development, evaluation, and real-world deployment) of a DRL-based controller for an integrated UFH-HP system. First, a simulation-based pilot study was conducted to assess different DRL algorithms, control strategies, and configurations. Subsequently, a digital twin of a real residential building was developed and used to train DRL agents under simulated operating conditions. The best-performing agent was then deployed in the physical building without additional online fine-tuning. The results show that the controller successfully maintained indoor temperatures within the prescribed comfort limits while dynamically adjusting the HP supply temperature and UFH valve positions. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of deploying DRL controllers in occupied buildings and highlight their robustness and the practical challenges associated with transferring control policies from digital environments to real heating systems.

</details>


### [277] [Values Shape What Self-Improving Coding Agents Build](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23067)
*Jason Liang,Dylan Waldner,Risto Miikkulainen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在自改进编码智能体的持久指令文件中加入一句简短的价值观陈述，会同时影响其任务表现与所构建的解决方案；其中"开放"类价值观提升留出集表现，"保守"类价值观甚至低于无价值观基线，且价值观会改变解法的规模、复杂度与思路，但价值观的设计仍需人工把关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自改进智能体主要针对产出结果进行优化，对"如何工作"关注不足；设计者通过指令塑造智能体行为的手段有限，尤其在开放式任务中更显薄弱。作者希望探究：在智能体的持久指令文件中写入一句简短价值观陈述，是否不仅改变其表现水平，也改变其实际构建出的东西。

Method: 采用Schwartz基本人类价值观理论中的四类高阶价值观（开放变革、保守、自我增强、自我超越）作为实验变量。在多样化编码任务上，于同一轮运行内的多次自我改进迭代中保持价值观固定不变，对比不同价值观条件与无价值观基线的表现，并分析产出解法的规模、复杂度与方法差异；同时考察智能体自行修订价值观以及从AI文献中提炼价值观的效果。

Result: 三项发现：(1) 价值观对多样化任务的表现确有影响——开放类价值观在留出数据上提升表现，而相反的保守类价值观得分低于无价值观智能体；(2) 价值观改变智能体所构建之物，产生在规模、复杂度与方法上各异的求解算法；(3) 价值观设计仍需人类监督——允许智能体自行修订价值观会缩小不同价值观集合之间的差异，而从AI文献中提炼的价值观相比无价值观无可检测的增益。

Conclusion: 精心设计的价值观能够影响自改进编码智能体构建什么，并在任务允许的情况下影响其表现优劣；但价值观的拟定、修订与取舍不能完全交由智能体自身或文献自动推导，人类的监督与设计仍不可替代。

Abstract: Self-improving agents are typically optimized for the results they produce, with less attention to how they produce them. Their instructions give designers limited ways to shape how they work, especially when the task is open-ended. This paper studies whether a short value statement in an agent's persistent instruction file changes not only how well the agent performs but also what it builds. Four higher-order value types in Schwartz's theory of basic human values were evaluated: openness to change, conservation, self-enhancement, and self-transcendence. Across diverse coding tasks, the values were held fixed within each run over multiple iterations of self-improvement. Three findings emerged: (1) Values matter for performance across a diverse set of tasks. The openness values increase performance on held-out data, whereas the opposite conservation values result in scores below those of an agent given no values. (2) Values change what agents build, producing solution algorithms that differ in size, complexity and approach. (3) Human oversight is still needed for designing values. Allowing the agent to revise its own values narrows the differences between sets of values, and values distilled from the AI literature provide no detectable gain over having no values. Properly designed values can thus influence what a self-improving coding agent builds and, where the task permits, how well it performs.

</details>


### [278] [The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23068)
*Yuanhao Zeng,Shaocheng Lan,Ao Lu,Kuang Yan,Heng Lin,Xinang Xu,Yuan Luo,Yueting Wang,Yexin Li,Ruo Shan,Kan Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"分辨率假设"（Resolution Hypothesis）：智能体进化停滞的根源不是提议阶段无法产生更好的产物，而是评测噪声太大，无法可靠地区分优劣。基于7种进化方法、6个模型、逾1000万次LLM调用的实验，在候选选择和方法排序两个层面均验证了该假设，呼吁研究重心从"设计更强的改进提议系统"转向"让真实改进可被检测与累积"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体进化范式（proposer提出候选prompt/skill/memory，selector按得分筛选）存在两大困惑：不同论文中方法优劣此消彼长、无法相互复现；在某些任务上进化根本无法启动（bootstrap失败）。作者试图定位这一现象的根因，判断瓶颈究竟位于"提议端"还是"评测端"。

Method: 提出并检验Resolution Hypothesis：进化停滞源于评测分辨率不足，而非候选质量不足。实验覆盖7种进化方法与6个模型、累计超1000万次LLM调用，在两个使用评测分数的层级上分别检验：(1) 候选层面——比较选择器区分"有益候选"与"有害候选"的准确率与随机基线；(2) 方法层面——比较不同方法间排名差距（通常仅几个百分点）与同一方法两次独立运行之间的方差。

Result: 候选层面：有益候选确实存在，但选择器区分有益与有害候选的能力与随机猜测无显著差异（selection is no better than random），导致误差在多轮迭代中累积。方法层面：方法间的典型优势幅度小于同一方法两次独立运行的差异，故已发表的方法排名在很大程度上依赖随机性（运气），缺乏统计可靠性。

Conclusion: 智能体进化的瓶颈在于"可靠识别改进"这一环节，而非候选提议能力。研究与发展范式应从不断设计更复杂的候选改进系统，转向提升评测信噪比、增强真实改进的可检测性与可累积性；同时提示现有方法排行榜的结论需以方差/多次运行的方式重新审视。

Abstract: Agent evolution follows a simple loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) and selection accepts those that score higher. This loop has shown promise, yet practitioners face a puzzle: methods trade wins across papers, and evolution often fails to bootstrap on certain tasks. We trace this puzzle to the Resolution Hypothesis: agent evolution stalls not because methods fail to propose better artifacts, but because noisy evaluations cannot reliably identify them. Across seven evolution methods and six models (over 10M LLM calls), we find support for the hypothesis at both levels where evaluation scores are used. At the candidate level (choosing artifacts), helpful candidate artifacts exist, but selection is no better than random at telling them from harmful ones, so errors accumulate across rounds. At the method level (ranking methods), typical margins of a few percentage points are smaller than the difference between two independent runs of the same method, so published rankings often rest on luck. Together, these findings indicate that agent evolution is often bottlenecked by reliably identifying improvements. This calls for a shift in how we develop and evaluate self-improving agents, from designing ever more candidate improvement systems to making true improvements detectable and accumulable.

</details>


### [279] [Colombo: A Frontier-to-Frontier Autoresearch System for Oracle-Based Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23080)
*Haihan Zhang,Wendao Wu,Chenheng Zhang,Chunyuan Zheng,Yanyi Li,Cong Fang,Haoxuan Li,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出Colombo——一个面向"预言机式优化"的自组织AI研究者系统，通过复杂度图谱、自组织研究议程、对抗式协同爬升、独立评审与Lean形式化验证，在50余个设定上取得最优或近最优速率，迈向"自创生科学"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学前沿由"可达保证"与"不可避免下界"之间的差距所刻画，而现有AI科研系统多为单点任务求解，缺乏持续把未解缺口转化为研究计划、并让验证成果反过来重塑研究组织方式的自我推进机制。

Method: 以基于预言机（oracle-based）的优化为初始落地领域，构建四个核心组件：1) Complexity Atlas——记录前沿设定与当前知识状态的活图谱，衡量信息接口下的可解效率与任何可行算法绕不开的代价；2) Self-Organization——将未解决的gaps转化为自适应研究程序，协调猜想生成、数学探究与随证据累积的重规划；3) Adversarial Co-Ascent——通过算法与困难实例族的相互挑战，揭示信息利用与隐藏机制，指导更强方法与下界证明；4) 独立评审与Lean形式化认证校验数学主张，Long-Term Memory跨设定携带已验证结论与研究经验。

Result: 在Complexity Atlas中已为50多个设定建立了最优或近最优的速率结果。

Conclusion: Colombo是迈向"自创生科学"（Autopoietic Science）的具体一步：其经校验的进展能够再生自身进步的条件，持续重塑研究如何被组织以及能发现什么。

Abstract: Science advances from frontier to frontier as discoveries reshape what is known and create the basis for further discovery. We present Colombo, a self-organizing AI researcher that drives this renewal, first instantiated in oracle-based optimization. Here, the central question is how efficiently a problem class can be solved through a prescribed information interface and what costs no admissible algorithm can avoid. The gap between achievable guarantees and unavoidable limits defines the frontier recorded in its Complexity Atlas, a living map of frontier settings and the current state of knowledge. Self-Organization turns unresolved gaps into adaptive research programmes, coordinating conjecture formation, mathematical investigation, and replanning as evidence accumulates. Adversarial Co-Ascent develops algorithms and hard families through reciprocal challenge, exposing mechanisms of information use and concealment that guide stronger methods and proofs of unavoidable costs. Independent review and Lean-based formal certification check mathematical claims, while the Long-Term Memory carries supported findings and research experience across settings. To date, Colombo has established optimal or near-optimal rates for more than fifty settings in the Atlas. Colombo thus takes a concrete step toward Autopoietic Science: a scientific process whose validated advances regenerate the conditions of its own progress, continually reshaping how inquiry is organized and what it can discover.

</details>


### [280] [Hidden-State Similarity Predicts Re-Elicitation After Inoculation Prompting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23096)
*Rose N. Kwon,Samy Mammeri,Sabyasachi Sahoo,Christian Gagné,Thomas Jiralerspong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究"接种式提示"（inoculation prompting）抑制涌现性失准后行为复现的条件，发现文本相似度是不充分的预测因子，真正的触发因素在于评测提示是否产生与接种上下文相似的激活状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在狭窄有害任务上微调会引发"涌现性失准"（emergent misalignment），使模型将有害行为泛化到训练分布之外。接种式提示通过在训练中显式诱发不良行为来缓解该效应，但后续工作显示：当评测提示包含训练上下文线索时，该行为会重新出现。作者希望弄清什么样的提示会成为有效"触发器"，即揭示行为复现的内在机制。

Method: 以接种式提示训练后的模型为对象，考察评测提示重新诱发被抑制行为的预测因素。对比检验文本相似度（与接种提示的词汇／语义相似性）与激活空间相似性（内部激活状态与接种上下文所产生激活的接近程度）两类指标的解释力，采用激活空间分析定位行为可及性的判据。

Result: 文本相似度与接种提示的相似程度只能部分预测行为的复现，属于不充分预测因子；而评测提示若能诱导出与接种上下文相似的激活状态，则更可能重新诱发被抑制的行为。这表明条件性失准的可及性主要由表征层面的相似性决定，而非表层文本线索。

Conclusion: 研究推进了对接种式提示如何调节"条件性失准"的理解：触发机制在于激活状态的相似性而非文本相似性。据此提出，激活空间分析可用于识别在评测提示下被抑制行为是否仍然可及，为评估与监控微调后的行为抑制提供可操作的工具。

Abstract: Fine-tuning on narrow harmful tasks can cause emergent misalignment, where models generalize harmful behavior beyond the training distribution. Inoculation prompting can reduce this effect by explicitly eliciting the undesired behavior during training, but recent work shows that the behavior can reappear when evaluation prompts contain cues from the training context. We study what makes such prompts effective triggers. We find that, surprisingly, textual similarity to the inoculation prompt is an incomplete predictor. Instead, prompts are more likely to re-elicit suppressed behavior when they induce activation states similar to those produced by the inoculation context. These findings advance our understanding of how inoculation prompting modulates conditional misalignment, and suggest that activation space analysis can help identify when suppressed behaviors remain accessible under eval-time prompts.

</details>


### [281] [RSI-Prime: Training Models to Train Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23138)
*Dewu Zheng,Yang Ye,Hongyu Zhang,Jun Yu,Yanlin Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建 RSI-Prime 数据集（7 类任务、350 条完整实验轨迹），通过细粒度决策识别与质量标注，并施加决策级损失掩码屏蔽低质量行为的监督，以提升 LLM 的"模型训练能力"。在 PostTrainBench 上训练 GLM-5.3 后，整体性能相对原始模型提升 31.95%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）要求 LLM 不仅能被训练，还能自主开展训练以改进目标模型。然而 LLM 的角色正从"被训练者"扩展为"训练执行者"，其模型训练能力缺乏专门研究与系统性开发，需要专门的数据与方法支撑。

Method: 1）构建 RSI-Prime 数据集，覆盖 7 类任务的 350 条完整实验轨迹；2）对轨迹进行细粒度决策识别与决策质量标注；3）采用决策级损失掩码（decision-level loss masking），在监督微调中排除对低质量行为的监督信号；4）在自主后训练基准 PostTrainBench 上以 GLM-5.3 为基座进行训练与评估。

Result: 在 PostTrainBench 上，基于 RSI-Prime 训练的 GLM-5.3 整体性能较原始 GLM-5.3 取得 31.95% 的相对提升。

Conclusion: 通过高质量实验轨迹与决策级监督筛选，可有效提升 LLM 的自主训练能力，指向未来 RSI 系统中模型能够自主维持自身进步的发展路径。

Abstract: Enabling large language models (LLMs) to autonomously conduct training and improve target models is an important foundation for recursive self-improvement (RSI). As LLMs expand their role from being trained to conducting training, their model-training capability warrants dedicated study and systematic development. To this end, we construct RSI-Prime, a dataset for improving model-training capability, comprising 350 complete experimental trajectories across seven task categories. To help LLMs learn to make high-quality experimental decisions from training practice, we perform fine-grained decision identification and quality annotation, then apply decision-level loss masking to exclude supervision on low-quality behavior. Experiments with GLM-5.3 on PostTrainBench, a benchmark for autonomous post-training, show that training on RSI-Prime yields a 31.95% relative improvement in overall performance over the original GLM-5.3, highlighting a path toward future RSI systems in which models autonomously sustain their own advancement.

</details>


### [282] [Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI): A Federated Identity, Trust, Attestation, and Accountability Architecture for Cross-Organization Autonomous AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23202)
*Viet K. Nguyen,Mohammad I. Husain*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ATI（Agent Trust Infrastructure），一种独立于框架的安全架构，基于PKI、零信任架构与远程证明，为跨组织AI代理协作提供身份验证、执行完整性与授权保障，在不修改底层模型的前提下将攻击遏制率从43%提升至84%，单请求开销约174微秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理日益跨越组织边界协作，调用工具并与独立实体运营的代理交互；现有代理框架虽支持规划与协调，但缺乏统一机制来验证跨组织代理身份、执行完整性和授权，导致跨域协作缺乏可信安全基座。

Method: 构建ATI：1）通过各组织自有证书颁发机构（AgentCA）建立联邦信任，无需共享根权威；2）请求执行前验证代理证书，核验经批准的模型、工具与系统提示配置；3）通过三项策略检查实施授权；4）以外部安全执行层形式集成现有代理框架，不修改其底层模型；5）采用IETF WIMSE工作负载令牌格式进行身份与请求验证，用实体证明令牌（EAT）验证模型、工具与系统提示完整性。

Result: 在8个组织、6种代理框架（每个部署5代理团队）的模拟联邦中评估；安全实验涉及2个组织、14种攻击场景与6个良性任务、5种代理模型，每种变体5种攻击变体×3次重复，由评委模型评估结果。全部执行机制启用后，攻击遏制率由43%提升至84%（在全部配置中一致评估的11种攻击场景下由40%提升至80%），每请求额外开销约174微秒。

Conclusion: ATI以开源、框架无关的形式发布，基于WIMSE工作负载令牌与EAT证明了可落地的跨组织代理信任方案，在保持低开销的同时显著提升攻击遏制能力，为多组织代理协作提供了可复用的安全基础设施。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly collaborate across organizational boundaries, invoking tools and interacting with agents operated by independent entities. Although existing agent frameworks support planning and coordination, they lack a common mechanism for verifying cross-organizational agent identity, execution integrity, and authorization. We propose the Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI), a framework-independent security architecture built on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), and remote attestation. ATI establishes federated trust through peer organizational certificate authorities (AgentCAs), eliminating the need for a shared root authority. Before executing requests, ATI validates agent certificates, verifies approved model, tool, and system-prompt configurations, and enforces authorization through three policy checks. We implement ATI as an external security enforcement layer that integrates with existing agent frameworks without modifying their underlying models. We evaluate ATI in a simulated federation of eight organizations using six agent frameworks, each deploying a five-agent team. Security experiments involve two organizations and assess 14 attack scenarios and six benign tasks across five agent models, using five attack variations and three repetitions per variation. A panel of judge models evaluates the experimental outcomes. With all enforcement mechanisms enabled, attack containment increases from 43% to 84% (40% to 80% for the 11 attack scenarios evaluated consistently across all configurations), while enforcement introduces approximately 174 microseconds of overhead per request. ATI is released as an open-source, framework-independent package that uses IETF WIMSE workload token formats for identity and request verification and Entity Attestation Tokens for model, tool, and system-prompt integrity verification.

</details>

### [283] [An Open-Source da Vinci X/Xi Instrument Module for Laparoscopic Surgery Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21771)
*Douglas McDonough,Justin Liao,Jiawei Ge,Antony Goldenberg,Yvonne Zhang,Mackenzie A Eagleson,Ravi Prakash,Axel Krieger,Chunwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向UR5/UR5e机械臂的da Vinci X/Xi器械开源控制模块，可同步控制器械运动与电外科能量激活，并记录每次激活的时间与来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在研究机器人上开展电外科任务，需同时控制器械运动与能量激活，并记录各动作发生的时刻；现有方案缺乏对器械驱动与电外科命令的统一、可记录的控制接口。

Method: 设计五电机经同步带驱动弹簧加载驱动盘的传动结构；开发电外科中间层（interposer），接受软件指令、以外科医生脚踏板为优先，并记录每次激活请求的来源；在台架测试中验证激活事件记录，离体实验开展单极与双极凝血及单极切割，并用光学跟踪校准Fenestrated Bipolar Forceps的俯仰与偏航增益。

Result: 台架测试中中间层完整记录了6次踩踏板产生的全部12个激活/去激活事件；离体演示实现脾组织单极/双极凝血与胆囊剥离中的单极切割；校准使俯仰与偏航增益分别由0.904、1.14改善至1.00、1.02。

Conclusion: 该开源模块使研究者能够在腹腔镜任务中同步记录器械运动、视频以及电外科命令的时间与来源，为电外科机器人研究提供可复用的实验平台。

Abstract: Studying electrosurgical tasks on a research robot requires control of both instrument motion and energy activation, along with a record of when each action occurs. This paper presents an open-source module for da Vinci X/Xi instruments on a UR5/UR5e robotic arm. Five motors transmit torque through timing belts to spring-loaded drive discs. An electrosurgical interposer accepts software commands, gives the surgeon's foot pedals priority, and records the source of each activation request. In bench testing, the interposer recorded all 12 activation and deactivation events from six pedal presses. Ex vivo demonstrations included monopolar and bipolar coagulation of splenic tissue and monopolar cutting during gallbladder dissection. Optical tracking of the Fenestrated Bipolar Forceps showed that calibration brought pitch and yaw gains from 0.904 and 1.14 to 1.00 and 1.02, respectively. The module enables researchers to record instrument motion, video, and the timing and source of electrosurgical commands during laparoscopic tasks.

</details>


### [284] [Better Calibrated, Better Planned: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-ASV Informative Path Planning for Oil Spill Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21783)
*Alejandro Casado-Pérez,Marija Popović,Daniel Gutiérrez-Reina,Sergio L. Toral.,Samuel Yanes*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究不确定性校准如何影响多ASV信息路径规划（IPP），提出用证据深度学习（EDL）作为不确定性驱动的信息模型，并在物理仿真中与GP、MC Dropout、Deep Ensembles做闭环对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IPP研究多聚焦规划策略，信息模型几乎默认使用高斯过程（GP），其不确定性校准问题被忽视；而多ASV监测溢油需在稀疏噪声观测与紧时间/能量预算下重建异质污染场，模型不确定性质量直接决定采样决策。

Method: 构建由重建模型与规划器耦合的闭环IPP框架，多车通过共享不确定性地图在线协同；引入EDL作为校准不确定性信息模型，与GP、MC Dropout、Deep Ensembles在基于物理的溢油仿真中、搭配五种规划器进行基准对比，共60张地图。

Result: 模型选择主导结果：解释最终重建误差方差的80%，而深模型中规划器仅占1%。EDL在所有规划器下误差最低、IoU最高，校准最优，单步耗时3.9 ms；每车50单元即优于MC Dropout与Deep Ensembles每车150单元；Deep Ensembles随误差增大反而更自信，EDL无此退化。

Conclusion: 不确定性感知IPP的核心要求是信息模型对"自身规划器所采集数据"具有鲁棒性；校准良好的不确定性模型比规划器选择更关键，EDL是高效可用的候选方案。

Abstract: Monitoring oil spills with fleets of Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) requires mapping a heterogeneous pollutant field from sparse, noisy measurements under tight time and energy budgets. Informative Path Planning (IPP) addresses this problem by coupling a reconstruction model, which infers the field and its uncertainty, with a planner that decides where to sample next. Prior work has focused on planning strategies and has largely relied on Gaussian Processes (GPs), leaving the calibration of the model's uncertainty underexplored. We study how uncertainty calibration conditions multi-vehicle IPP with a fleet of ASVs that coordinates online through a shared uncertainty map. We introduce Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) as an uncertainty-calibrated information model. We benchmark EDL, Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensembles against a GP in closed loop with five planners on physics-based oil spill simulations. Across 60 maps, the choice of model dominates the outcome, explaining 80\% of the variance of the final reconstruction error, against 1\% for the planner among the deep models. EDL achieves the lowest error and the highest IoU under every planner, is the best calibrated model and runs at 3.9 ms per step. With 50 cells per vehicle it reconstructs the spill better than MC Dropout and Deep Ensembles with 150. Deep Ensembles become more confident as their error grows, whereas EDL is unaffected. Robustness of the information model to the data its own planner collects is therefore a requirement of uncertainty-aware IPP.

</details>


### [285] [ASTRA: ASV Simulator for Transferable Realistic Autonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21789)
*Tsimafei Lazouski,Cody Sheltraw,Alan Papalia,Maani Ghaffari*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 ASTRA——一个基于 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 构建的无人水面艇（ASV）仿真框架，融合 Fossen 海洋动力学、物理真实感感知与 ROS 2 自主接口，并以 BlueBoat 实艇配置进行对接与波浪-船体耦合验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海上自主水面艇的自主性研发受制于实海测试成本高、可重复性差；现有海洋仿真工具虽在船体动力学、机器人集成、视觉渲染方面各有成熟能力，但侧重分散、缺乏统一环境中的整合，难以同时支撑动力学、感知与控制研发。

Method: 在 Isaac Sim 中构建统一仿真环境：采用 Fossen 风格海洋动力学模型，结合基于几何的浮力计算与可编程谱波浪扰动，实现非平面静水与波浪诱导运动；按实体 BlueBoat 测试平台复现 GPS、IMU、LiDAR、RGB-D 传感器配置并通过 ROS 2 暴露；将 BlueBoat 现有 ROS 2 定位与感知模块直接移植入仿真器；设计零推力（zero-propulsion）针对性实验验证波浪-船体耦合。

Result: 仿真横摇响应符合预期的非振荡静水行为；垂荡与生成波场高度相干，在测试海况下于主导波浪频率处增益约为 1，表明波浪-船体耦合实现正确。

Conclusion: ASTRA 可作为海洋自主性开发、仿真基准评测与 sim-to-real 实验的开源测试平台。

Abstract: Autonomy development for marine autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs) remains challenging because field testing is costly and difficult to reproduce. Existing marine simulation tools provide mature capabilities in vessel dynamics, robotics integration, and visual rendering, but these strengths are emphasized differently across platforms. This paper presents ASTRA, an ASV simulation framework built in NVIDIA Isaac Sim that combines marine vehicle dynamics, photorealistic perception, and Robot Operating System (ROS 2) autonomy interfaces within a common environment. ASTRA incorporates a Fossen-style marine dynamics model together with geometry-based buoyancy and programmable spectral wave disturbances, enabling non-planar hydrostatic and wave-induced motion. The simulator reproduces the sensor configuration of a physical BlueBoat testbed, including GPS, IMU, LiDAR, and RGB-D sensing exposed through ROS 2. This allows localization, perception, planning, and control software to be developed against interfaces consistent with the physical platform. The BlueBoat's existing ROS 2 localization and perception modules were ported directly into ASTRA, while targeted zero-propulsion experiments were used to verify the implemented wave-body coupling. The simulated roll response was consistent with the expected non-oscillatory hydrostatic behavior, and heave remained highly coherent with the generated wave field, with approximately unity gain at the dominant wave frequency in the tested sea states. ASTRA is intended as an open-source testbed for marine autonomy development, simulation-based benchmarking, and sim-to-real experimentation.

</details>


### [286] [A Probabilistic Lateral Motion Prediction Model with Improved Response Fidelity for Vehicle-in-the-Loop Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21806)
*Xiangyang Ye,Chaosheng Huang,Jinwen Yang,Zhengxian Chen,Jun Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种带概率输出的横摆侧向运动预测模型：以二自由度车辆模型为物理先验，循环神经网络学习侧向加速度与横摆角速度的残差修正，结合多步 rollout 训练与条件高斯不确定性传播，显著提升 VIL 仿真中的横向响应与积分运动预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VIL 仿真需要能准确复现车辆响应、并能通过递推积分可靠生成横向位置与航向指令的侧向动力学模型；纯数据驱动模型在递推过程中误差累积、响应保真度不足。

Method: 1) 以 2-DOF 车辆模型作为物理先验；2) 用 RNN 学习侧向加速度与横摆角速度的相关残差修正；3) 采用多步 rollout 训练，将修正后的响应回灌到后续状态与历史输入，并直接惩罚累积侧向速度误差；4) 用条件高斯刻画响应不确定性，并通过增广状态线性化把不确定性传播到侧向响应、位置与航向预测。

Result: 侧向响应与积分运动预测均改善；相比 Deep Dynamics 侧向自适应方法，平均侧向位置 RMSE 由 0.596 m 降至 0.483 m（降低 19.0%），平均侧向速度 RMSE 由 0.0469 m/s 降至 0.0441 m/s。

Conclusion: 物理先验、概率残差学习与多步 rollout 训练的结合，可有效实现响应保真的侧向运动预测，适用于 VIL 仿真中的递推运动生成。

Abstract: Vehicle-in-the-loop (VIL) simulation requires a lateral dynamics model that accurately reproduces vehicle responses and reliably generates horizontal lateral-position and heading commands through recursive integration. This paper presents a probabilistic lateral motion prediction model with improved response fidelity. A two-degree-of-freedom vehicle model provides the physical prior, while a recurrent neural network learns correlated residual corrections to lateral acceleration and yaw rate. To maintain prediction fidelity during recursive motion generation, multistep rollout training feeds corrected responses into subsequent states and histories and directly penalizes accumulated lateral-velocity error. A conditional Gaussian characterizes response uncertainty, which is propagated to lateral-response, position, and heading predictions through augmented-state linearization. Evaluation results demonstrate improved lateral-response and integrated-motion prediction. Compared with the Deep Dynamics lateral adaptation, the proposed model reduces mean lateral-position root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 0.596 m to 0.483 m, an improvement of 19.0%, while reducing mean lateral-velocity RMSE from 0.0469 m/s to 0.0441 m/s. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining physical priors, probabilistic residual learning, and multistep rollout training for response-faithful lateral motion prediction.

</details>


### [287] [ARC-2: Continuous Compliance Through Delta Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21811)
*Tord Johan Eide,Einar Holt*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Delta Management，一个在部署后持续治理自主系统的框架，通过连续监测系统当前运行状态与认证基线（以"区域"而非固定点定义）之间的偏差来评估合规性，以四项扩展将 ARC 由部署时认证架构升级为全生命周期持续合规框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原 ARC 架构（模型安全验证、CRAB 认知认证、LEA 运行授权）仅覆盖部署前三层治理，未说明部署后如何维持合规；而 EU AI Act 第72(2)条对部署后持续合规提出了义务要求，存在治理缺口。

Method: 提出 Delta Management 框架，用连续监测替代静态认证，测量运行状态相对认证基线的偏差，并给出四项扩展：(1) CRAB 评估纳入最差已验证行为偏差，孤立离群点先行隔离待确认，避免不当限制；(2) 分层触发分类法，区分硬性安全违规、关键单维失效、多系统相关性退化、风险加权复合指标，并匹配相应响应；(3) 分级安全过渡协议，将撤销运行授权与物理停机分离，契合现行安全标准与 EU AI Act 要求；(4) 引入"环境 delta"作为基线有效性条件，环境漂移超出认证 ODD 时触发重新认证或 ODD 修订，而非自动收缩授权。

Result: 框架实现了偏差度量、分层触发与分级响应的闭环，并将环境漂移纳入基线有效性判定，使合规评估从一次性静态认证转为持续监测；摘要未给出实证实验结果。

Conclusion: 四项扩展共同把 ARC 从部署时认证架构转变为贯穿运行生命周期的持续监测、评估与合规执行框架，对应 EU AI Act 第72(2)条的持续合规义务。

Abstract: ARC 1 introduced a three-layer governance architecture for autonomous systems comprising model safety validation, cognitive certification (CRAB), and operational authorization (LEA). However, it did not address how compliance should be maintained after deployment.
  This paper introduces Delta Management, a continuous governance framework that measures deviations between a system's current operational state and its certified baseline, defined as a region rather than a fixed point. Compliance is assessed through continuous monitoring instead of static certification.
  Four extensions are proposed. First, CRAB evaluation incorporates the worst verified behavioral deviations, with isolated outliers quarantined pending confirmation to prevent unjustified restrictions. Second, a layered trigger taxonomy distinguishes hard safety violations, critical single-dimension failures, correlated multi-system degradation, and risk-weighted composite indicators, each triggering proportionate responses. Third, a graduated safe transition protocol separates withdrawal of operational authorization from physical shutdown, consistent with established safety standards and EU AI Act requirements. Fourth, environmental delta is introduced as a distinct baseline validity condition: environmental drift beyond the certified Operational Design Domain (ODD) triggers recertification or ODD revision rather than automatic authority contraction.
  Together, these extensions transform ARC from a deployment-time certification architecture into a continuous framework for monitoring, evaluating, and enforcing compliance throughout the operational lifecycle of autonomous systems. The framework addresses the continuous compliance obligations established by EU AI Act Article 72(2).

</details>


### [288] [Agile Monoped Hopping on Complex and Discrete Terrain via Kinodynamic Planning with Distilled MPPI Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21905)
*Yue Qin,Denglin Cheng,Jingyu Liu,Yanran Ding*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 FlowRRT，一种用于离散地形上单足跳跃的动力学规划器，将 RRT 的 steering（转向）视为集值问题，用条件流匹配从多起点 MPPI 专家数据中学习可行动作的分布生成器，从而高效协调长时程连续跳跃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单足跳跃的可行动作集狭窄且不连通，传统动力学 RRT 依赖运动基元或闭环策略导致动作多样性受限或规划慢；将轨迹优化器蒸馏为回归单解的网络又会因多峰、不连通的动作分布而失效。因此需要能表达“多个可行解”的 steering 方式。

Method: 1) 用多起点 MPPI 作为专家，离线为每个查询采集完整可行动作集；2) 用条件流匹配将该集合蒸馏为生成式采样器，实现集值 steering；3) 将采样器嵌入 RRT，用于长时程连续跳跃的规划，并配合 MuJoCo 全阶动力学做 sim-to-sim 跟踪验证。

Result: 在不同地形基准上成功率更高、规划时间显著短于采样类基线；在含倾斜平台地形上，FlowRRT 在 1 s 内达到 80% 成功率，RL-RRT 需 24 s，SST 需 77 s；MuJoCo sim-to-sim 跟踪验证了全阶动力学下的执行精度。

Conclusion: 将 steering 建模为集值预测并用流匹配生成式蒸馏，可克服动力学规划中动作集不连通的问题，使 RRT 能在长时程发现非贪心机动，兼具高成功率与实时性。

Abstract: This paper presents FlowRRT, a kinodynamic planner for agile monoped hopping on discrete terrain. Steering for kinodynamic RRT on complex dynamical systems currently relies on motion primitives or closed-loop policies, limiting the diversity of motions or the planning speed. Distilling a trajectory optimizer avoids both, but existing methods regress a single solution per query, which fails on monoped hopping, where the feasible action set is narrow and disconnected. Our key insight is to treat steering as set-valued and predict the distribution of feasible actions instead. A multi-start MPPI expert collects the entire feasible set of each query offline, and conditional flow matching distills it into a generative sampler. With this sampler, FlowRRT coordinates successive jumps over long horizons and finds non-greedy maneuvers that are hard for reactive policies to discover. Benchmarks across different terrains show higher success rates and substantially shorter planning times than sampling-based baselines. On terrains with inclined platforms, FlowRRT reaches $80\%$ success within $1$~s, versus $24$~s for RL-RRT and $77$~s for SST. Sim-to-sim tracking in MuJoCo confirms accurate execution under full-order dynamics.

</details>


### [289] [From Human Videos to Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Data: Confidence-Guided RL Refinement of Video Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21908)
*Yanghong Liu,Yang Chen,Kailang Xu,Bang Du,Feiyang Yang,Jiawei Xia,Zhengtao Yao,Yubiao Zhang,Masayoshi Tomizuka,Ruihai Wu,Wei Zhan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PriDex 提出一种框架，将人类视频先验经由仿真强化学习转化为可执行的机器人双臂灵巧操作示范，用于生成训练数据并支撑下游视觉扩散策略学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双臂灵巧操作示范采集成本高昂，人类视频是有潜力的替代数据源；但视频推断的运动估计存在不确定性，且人机具身差异导致直接运动迁移困难。

Method: 1) 由人物交互提供可供性线索，从基于几何的候选抓取中筛选任务相关且机器人特定的抓取；2) 以物体轨迹作为任务级参考、相对双臂腕部轨迹作为协调运动补充引导；3) 利用物体运动置信度自适应平衡两类先验——高置信度时侧重物体级引导，低置信度（遮挡或视觉歧义）时增强腕部级引导；4) 在机器人运动学与物理约束下用强化学习精化先验，rollout 生成机器人示范以训练视觉扩散策略。

Result: 在倒水、扫入簸箕、拧瓶盖、擦盘子四项双臂灵巧操作任务上评估，同时考察仿真机器人数据生成与下游视觉运动策略学习两方面表现。

Conclusion: PriDex 能在保留任务相关交互结构的同时，为机器人重新生成具身特定的行为，实现从人类视频先验到可执行灵巧操作示范的有效转化。

Abstract: Collecting demonstrations for bimanual dexterous manipulation is costly, motivating the use of human videos as a source of robot training data. However, uncertainty in video-derived motion estimates and differences between human and robot embodiments make direct motion transfer challenging. In this work, we introduce PriDex, a framework that transforms human-video Priors into executable robot Dexterous manipulation demonstrations through reinforcement learning in simulation. PriDex preserves task-relevant interaction structure while allowing embodiment-specific behavior to be regenerated for the robot. Human-object interactions provide affordance cues for selecting task-relevant, robot-specific grasps from geometry-based candidates. For motion refinement, object trajectories provide a task-level reference, while relative bimanual wrist trajectories offer complementary guidance for coordinated motion. Since object-motion estimates can become unreliable under occlusion or visual ambiguity, PriDex uses object-motion confidence to adaptively balance these two priors, emphasizing object-level guidance when confidence is high and increasing the contribution of wrist-level guidance as confidence decreases. Reinforcement learning refines these video-derived priors under the robot's kinematic and physical constraints, and the resulting policies are rolled out to generate robot demonstrations for training a vision-based diffusion policy. We evaluate PriDex on four bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks, including pouring, sweeping into a dustpan, bottle-cap unscrewing, and plate cleaning, assessing both simulation-based robot data generation and downstream visuomotor policy learning.

</details>


### [290] [ALOHA Lightning: Learning Fast and Precise Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21919)
*John Hua Yao. Qi Wu,Yihuai Gao,Chelsea Finn,Zipeng Fu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ALOHA Lightning（Flash ALOHA）通过可反驱双臂平台上的动觉示教采集接近人类速度的演示数据，并结合测试时动作平滑与视觉掩码对齐的数据学习流程，实现高速、精确的双臂操作技能，成功率超80%且接近人类速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从人类演示中学习已使机器人掌握多种操作技能，但学到的策略执行速度通常远慢于普通人类。该速度差距主要源于两点：缺乏高速采集演示数据的接口，以及难以训练能鲁棒执行高速动作的策略。

Method: 系统采用动觉示教（kinesthetic teaching）在可反驱（backdrivable）双臂平台上直观采集接近人类速度的演示，获得自然、快速的轨迹；学习流程引入测试时动作平滑（test-time action smoothing）以实现平滑高速执行，并用掩码（masking）对齐数据采集与部署阶段的视觉数据分布。

Result: 每个任务仅需50条演示，即可自主完成抛接球、叠短裤、电池插入、收拾餐桌等双臂任务，成功率超过80%，且速度接近人类。

Conclusion: 高速演示采集接口与配套学习流程的结合可有效缩小机器人策略与人类之间的速度差距，在少量演示下实现快速、精确的双臂操作。

Abstract: Learning from human demonstrations has enabled robots to acquire a wide range of manipulation skills, but learned policies typically execute far slower than ordinary humans. This speed gap is mainly due to lack of an interface for collecting demonstration data at high speed, and the difficulty in training policies that can robustly execute high-speed motions. In this paper, we present ALOHA Lightning (Flash ALOHA), a system for learning fast and precise robotic manipulation. Our system uses kinesthetic teaching to intuitively collect near-human-speed demonstrations on a backdrivable bimanual platform, yielding natural and fast trajectories. We also present a learning pipeline that enables smooth high-speed execution through test-time action smoothing and aligns the visual data distribution between data collection and deployment with masking. Given 50 demonstrations for each task, ALOHA Lightning autonomously completes bimanual tasks such as ball tossing and catching, folding shorts, battery insertion, and bussing tables for over 80% success rates while close to human speed. Project website: https://flash-aloha.github.io/

</details>


### [291] [HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21938)
*Javad Amirian,Armin Kiani,Loïc Schaeffer,Tim Sprecher,Mohamed Taha,Karthik Yadati*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HubEgo-100K v1.0 发布 10,124 小时第一人称（egocentric）视频数据集，配合同步 100 Hz IMU 数据，强调"环境与物体多样性"而非单环境示范数量，用于提升机器人模仿学习策略的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模仿学习得到的机器人策略在训练环境与物体之外泛化差；已有数据扩展研究显示泛化主要随环境/物体多样性增长，而非单环境示范数量。机器人数据跨环境采集成本高，而第一人称人类视频可大规模野外采集，但现有第一人称视频多为日常生活、缺乏真实工作场景中的熟练作业。

Method: 构建以多样性为目标的数据集：单头戴手机摄像头采集 1080p 第一人称视频并同步 100 Hz IMU；12,227 名贡献者在 15,548 个环境（11 类场景、30 个工作类别、56 种任务类型、35 个动作族）中录制无脚本自发性工作，83% 时长来自工作场所；共 72,754 个 episode，附机器生成的动作与语言标注，提供 LeRobot 与 MCAP 格式、CC BY 4.0 许可。沿各多样性维度量化，并将测量结果与已有关于六项影响策略性能的数据属性（含手部可见性、惯性感知）的证据相关联。

Result: 在 v1.0 内按随机顺序遍历 episode 时，新贡献者与新词汇持续出现，说明数据尚未饱和、多样性充裕；对采集、清洗、隐私措施与数据格式作了记录，并提供 datasheet。

Conclusion: 该工作以多样性为核心组织数据采集，为具身/机器人策略学习提供可扩展的第一人称视频+IMU 资源；后续版本将加入 benchmark 并扩展至 100,000 小时规模。

Abstract: Robot policies trained by imitation generalize poorly outside the environments and objects seen in training. Published data-scaling studies find that generalization grows with the diversity of training environments and objects rather than with more demonstrations per environment. Robot data is costly to collect across many environments, whereas egocentric human video can be recorded in the wild at scale; existing egocentric video, however, mostly shows daily-life activity and contains little skilled work in real workplaces. We present HubEgo-100K, a dataset built for diversity. This version of the paper covers the first release, v1.0: 10,124 hours of 1080p egocentric video with synchronized 100 Hz inertial (IMU) data from one head-mounted phone camera. In v1.0, 12,227 contributors record their own unscripted work in 15,548 environments (each one contributor's own setting of one type, such as their kitchen or workshop) across 11 setting types, 30 work categories, 56 task types and 35 action families, with 83% of hours in workplace settings. The release comprises 72,754 episodes with machine-generated action and language annotations, in LeRobot and MCAP formats under CC BY 4.0. We measure diversity along each axis, show that inside v1.0, with episodes in random order, new contributors and words keep appearing, and relate the measurements to published evidence on six data properties tied to policy performance, including hand visibility and inertial sensing. We also document collection, curation, privacy measures and data format, and provide a datasheet. Later versions of this paper will add benchmarks and cover further releases toward 100,000 hours.

</details>


### [292] [DreamFAR: Real-Time and Long-Horizon Interaction with Diverse Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22001)
*Yiming Dou,Botao He,Antonio Loquercio,Andrew Owens,Jitendra Malik,Sumedh Anand Sontakke,Ruoshi Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DreamFAR 是一个完全基于机器人原生遥操作数据、无需互联网视频预训练的机器人操作世界模型，体积远小于高性能视频生成模型，但对接触与因果理解更好，商用 GPU 上可跑 10 FPS，并在长时程预测上显著优于现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人世界模型存在两大缺陷：一是只适配单一环境，泛化性差；二是缺乏对长时程、接触密集事件（contact-rich）的模拟能力。同时，高性能视频生成模型往往依赖大规模互联网视频预训练，与机器人数据分布不一致。

Method: 从零开始在大规模机器人原生遥操作数据集上训练动力学模型，不做互联网视频预训练；针对机器人原生数据设计了专用架构与学习配方（training recipe）。

Result: 模型参数量/规模显著小于高性能视频生成模型，但展现出更强的接触与因果理解能力；在商用 GPU 上达到 10 FPS 的推理速度；实验表明其在长时程未来预测上显著优于现有模型。

Conclusion: DreamFAR 验证了"机器人原生数据 + 专用架构与训练配方"可替代互联网视频预训练来构建高效世界模型，并展示其在策略评估（policy evaluation）与混合数据协同训练（mixed-data co-training）等下游应用中的价值。

Abstract: World models have shown great potential in serving as a simulator for robot manipulation. However, existing models are either fit to a single environment or lack ability to simulate long-horizon contact-rich events. We present DreamFAR, a world model whose dynamics model is trained from scratch on a large robot-native teleoperation dataset, with no internet-video pretraining. We present an architecture and learning recipe designed for training on robot-native data. DreamFAR is significantly smaller than the high-performance video generation models, yet shows better understanding of contact and causality, and runs 10 FPS on a commercial GPU. Experimentally, DreamFAR significantly outperforms existing models in predicting the long-horizon future. We further demonstrate various applications where DreamFAR can be used, including policy evaluation and mixed-data co-training. Project page: https://www.yimingdou.com/DreamFAR/

</details>


### [293] [SE(3)-LIVOM: Adaptive Multi-LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry and Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22047)
*Gunhee Shin,Seungjae Lee,Daebeom Kim,Seoyeon Jang,Hyun Myung*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SE(3)-LIVOM 是 IROS 2026 COMFORT Challenge 总冠军方案，在双 LiDAR、单相机与 IMU 上实时运行，六场景平均 ATE 1.40 cm。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: COMFORT 挑战要求在 GrandTour 数据集（含坍塌建筑、施工现场、雪地等退化场景）中估计腿足机器人轨迹，需在多传感器、多场景下保持实时性与精度，且避免逐场景调参。

Method: 前端将 SE(3)-LIO 扩展至多 LiDAR 与单相机，并采用自适应降采样使单帧耗时稳定在约 35 ms；后端在线运行，通过子图上的平面束调整（plane bundle adjustment）与增量位姿图联合校正漂移。

Result: 所有场景共用同一套配置，在 6 个测试场景上平均 ATE 为 1.40 cm，实时性满足约束。

Conclusion: 多 LiDAR-视觉-惯性紧耦合结合自适应降采样与在线平面 BA/位姿图优化，可在无需场景特化参数的前提下实现厘米级实时定位与建图；代码已开源。

Abstract: This paper presents SE(3)-LIVOM, the overall winner of the COMFORT Challenge at IROS 2026. The challenge asks for the trajectory of a legged robot in the GrandTour dataset, whose scenes include collapsed buildings, construction sites and snowfields. SE(3)-LIVOM runs in real time on two LiDARs, one camera and an IMU. Its frontend extends SE(3)-LIO to multiple LiDARs and a camera. Adaptive downsampling keeps the time per scan near 35 ms within and across scenes. An online backend corrects drift with a plane bundle adjustment over submaps and an incremental pose graph. With a single configuration for all scenes, the system reaches an average ATE of 1.40 cm on the six test scenes. The code is available at https://github.com/url-kaist/se3-livom-comfort.

</details>


### [294] [ReLAP: Latent Action Pretraining through Recurrent Video Prediction in JEPA Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22077)
*R. Gnana Praveen,Ali Rouzbayani,Zhiying Jiang,Bidhan Roy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ReLAP：在冻结JEPA表征空间中耦合局部逆动力学与循环多步预测的无动作标注隐动作预训练框架，可迁移至VLM实现直接动作输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频是无动作标注的物理交互数据源，但有效隐动作不仅要刻画相邻帧的局部转移，还需刻画转移随时间的演化；仅靠成对重建难以获得时间一致的动力学表征。

Method: 在冻结JEPA特征空间中进行隐动作预训练：共享逆动力学模型从相邻观测推断紧凑连续隐动作；隐世界模型循环预测未来JEPA特征，预测特征作为下一步上下文，使后期误差经rollout反向传播至早期隐动作。迁移至VLM时采用两个互补目标：对冻结逆动力学教师做隐动作蒸馏，以及通过冻结隐世界模型做循环未来特征预测；再用动作flow matching在机器人示教上适配。部署时移除隐动作与世界模型分支，由微调VLM直接预测动作。

Result: 仅用11M预训练样本、1.06B可训练参数，在标准LIBERO上达97.9%，在零样本LIBERO-Plus扰动上达70.0%；在LARY隐动作基准上，平均回归误差与平均分类准确率均列第二。

Conclusion: 循环式无动作隐动作预训练能学到紧凑、时间结构化且可迁移的表征，有效支撑下游机器人控制，且推理阶段不增加额外分支开销。

Abstract: Videos provide a rich source of physical interaction for learning robot behavior without action annotations, yet effective latent actions must capture not only local transitions but also how those transitions evolve over time. We introduce ReLAP, a latent-action pretraining framework that couples local transition learning with recurrent multi-step prediction in a frozen JEPA representation space. A shared inverse dynamics model infers compact continuous latent actions from adjacent observations, while a latent world model recurrently predicts the future JEPA features. Because each predicted feature becomes the context for the next transition, errors at later steps backpropagate through the rollout to earlier latent actions, encouraging temporally coherent dynamics beyond pairwise reconstruction. We transfer this representation to a vision-language model using two complementary objectives: latent distillation from the frozen inverse teacher and recurrent future-feature prediction through the frozen latent world model. The resulting policy is then adapted to robot demonstrations with action flow matching. At deployment, the explicit latent-action and world-model branches are removed, and the fine-tuned VLM predicts physical actions directly, reducing inference complexity. With only 11M pretraining samples and 1.06B trainable parameters, ReLAP achieves 97.9% on standard LIBERO and 70.0% over zero-shot LIBERO-Plus perturbations. On the LARY latent-action benchmark, ReLAP ranks second in both mean regression error and mean classification accuracy among the compared methods. These results demonstrate that recurrent action-free latent action pretraining can learn compact, temporally structured, and transferable representations for downstream robot control.

</details>


### [295] [CRA: Continuous Risk Assessment for Safety-critical Visual Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22080)
*Lihao Zheng,Ying Wu,Chen Jiang,Randy Freeman*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于视觉的连续风险评估框架，从RGB与LiDAR观测估计动能、势能、接触严重性与热风险四个因子并融合为连续风险分数，结合泊松安全函数与拉普拉斯引导场作为安全滤波器，实现开放世界机器人导航的在线监测与干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统安全关键控制依赖预定义约束，将状态二分为安全与不安全区域；虽已有工作将几何安全扩展到语义安全，但真实世界风险很少是纯二值的——物体或人的风险随运动等物理属性及交互上下文连续变化（如携带重物或高温高速运动的行人需不同于静态障碍的安全响应）。

Method: 使用RGB与LiDAR观测，对每个被评估对象或人估计四类风险因子（kinetic、potential、contact-severity、thermal），并组合成连续风险分数；将估计结果嵌入泊松安全函数，配合拉普拉斯引导场构造安全滤波器，用于在线监测与干预。

Result: 在仿真餐厅场景中演示了所提方法。

Conclusion: 以连续风险评分替代二元安全划分，可更细致刻画开放世界中的风险差异；该框架可与安全滤波器结合，实现导航过程中的在线风险监测与干预。

Abstract: Traditional safety-critical control methods often rely on predefined constraints that separate states into safe and unsafe regions. While recent studies have extended geometric safety toward semantic safety, real-world safety is rarely purely binary. The risk associated with an object or human can vary continuously with its physical properties, like motion, and interaction context; for example, a person carrying a heavy object or a hot object moving at high speed may require a different safety response from an ordinary static obstacle. In this paper, we propose a vision-based continuous risk assessment framework for safety-critical visual navigation. Our method uses RGB and LiDAR observations to estimate four risk factors (kinetic, potential, contact-severity, and thermal) and combines them into a continuous risk score for each assessed object or person. These estimates are integrated into a Poisson safety function with a Laplace guidance field as a safety filter, enabling online monitoring and intervention in open-world robot navigation. We demonstrate the proposed method in a simulated restaurant scene.

</details>


### [296] [Low-speed Limit Cycle Walking of Planar X-shaped Bipedal Robot with Special Properties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22122)
*Fumihiko Asano,Cong Yan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种各腿连杆质心与髋关节重合的平面半圆足X形双足机器人，并给出其在平地上生成稳定极限环步态的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对双足机器人步态生成与稳定控制问题，利用质心与髋关节重合的特殊连杆结构简化动力学，并结合半圆足的"反重力"效应探索一种易于分析与控制的平面双足模型。

Method: 建立四自由度机器人模型的假设，推导运动方程与碰撞方程；以相对髋关节角为控制输出，设计跟踪五阶时间函数期望轨迹的控制系统；理论上证明摆动腿角速度在碰撞前后不变、稳态步态中控制输入的时积分恒为零，并论证模型近似线性化的有效性及半圆足反重力特性的可利用性。

Result: 数值仿真验证了理论结论的正确性，并分析了收敛速度、机械能恢复等基本步态特性。

Conclusion: 质心与髋关节重合的X形半圆足双足机器人具有良好的可解析性与可控制性，所设计的轨迹跟踪控制可实现稳定极限环步态，且半圆足的反重力效应与近似线性化特性为步态分析与能量恢复提供了有利条件。

Abstract: This paper proposes a novel planar semicircular-footed X-shaped bipedal robot in which the center of mass of each leg link is at the same position as the hip joint, and discusses a method for generating a stable limit cycle gait on level ground. First, we outline the assumptions of the robot model with four degrees of freedom, and develop the mathematical equations of motion and collision. Second, we set the relative hip-joint angle as a control output and design a control system to follow it to the desired trajectory specified as a fifth-order function of time. Third, we mathematically show that there are special properties: the angular velocity of the swing leg does not change before and after the collision, and the time-integral of the control input becomes zero in a steady gait. We also mathematically show that the model has the feature that approximate linearization is effective and the antigravity effect of semicircular feet can be utilized. Through numerical simulations, we verify the validity of the theoretical results, and analyze some fundamental gait properties such as convergence speed and mechanical energy restoration.

</details>


### [297] [DailyBrick: Language-Guided Synthesis of Brick Assembly Instructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22132)
*Hang Zhang,Qijian Tian,Yuan Xie,Xuhong Wang,Xin Tan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DailyBrick：一个多阶段智能体系统，通过"写程序"的方式从用户请求生成具备物理支撑、可无阻塞拼装的LEGO模型及逐砖装配说明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从用户请求生成LEGO模型不只是生成看似合理的3D形状：每个积木需有物理支撑、放置过程无阻塞，且需给出可执行的逐步装配指令。现有方法依赖训练专家大语言模型，并把所有积木连接关系塞进超长上下文，代价高且难以保证可执行性。

Method: 将超长上下文的积木连接问题重构为"像人一样编写搭建程序"，每步中间操作均可执行。1) 多阶段智能体框架，为LLM分配角色以提升生成效果；2) 带版本的构造SDK，将语义子部件到单块积木的多级决策编译为标准规范操作；3) 外部Meta-Reviewer智能体回放并检查生成包，验证模型与建造过程，定位失败并追溯到责任阶段，路由至有界修复或可编辑候选，用于后续技能/工具更新。

Result: 大量实验表明，DailyBrick在简单用户请求下的LEGO模型生成效果优于近期智能体系统；并在指令驱动机器人装配等下游应用中展现可用性。

Conclusion: 把长上下文连接约束转化为可执行程序化构造，配合多阶段角色化智能体与回放式自审机制，能有效产出物理可行的LEGO模型与人工/机器人可用的装配指令。

Abstract: Generating a LEGO model from a user request is more than a plausible 3D shape generation. LEGO models require physical support per brick, and each brick should be placed unblocked. Current methods address this issue by training an expert large language model. We reduce the problem of generating extremely long context on all brick connections to that of writing a program that builds LEGO models like a human, considering each intermediate step could be executed. We introduce DailyBrick , a multi-stage agentic system that produces a LEGO model together with a brick-by-brick assembly instruction for human building and robot assembly. We design a multi-stage harness with roles to help LLMs generate more effectively. A versioned construction SDK compiles multi-level decisions, from semantic subparts to individual bricks, into canonical operations. An external Meta-Reviewer agent replays and inspects the generated package, verifies the model and its construction process, identifies failures, traces them to the responsible stage, and routes them to bounded repairs or to editable candidates for later skill or tool updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DailyBrick generates LEGO models based on simple user requests better than recent agentic systems, and show its utility in downstream applications such as robot manipulations on model assembly from instructions and brick sets (https://SpatialAgent.github.io/DailyBrick/).

</details>


### [298] [RoboTeam: Benchmarking Vision-Based Multi-Agent Control of Many Robot Arms in Real Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22138)
*Changxuan Fan,Zhongwei Xie,Boyi Zhang,Shaoli Hu,Chang Xu,Xiyu Ren,Yufei Li,Qiao Xiao,Huihao Jing,Kawai Chung,Wenbin Hu,Hongyu Luo,Lingyun Xie,Yisen Gao,Chunyang Li,Haoyu Huang,Wuganjing Song,Yuxuan Liu,Chiu Yeung Tang,Fangneng Zhan,Xi Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 RoboTeam——一个面向多机器人协作的实时仿真基准：智能体仅凭相机图像，实时控制 4–16 条机械臂完成 36 项长时程协同任务，并系统比较自适应、单智能体、分层、去中心化四种智能体系统在成功率、耗时与 token 成本上的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态智能体操控机械臂的基准存在三点不足：(1) 多数只测试 1–2 条机械臂、任务时程短；(2) 智能体"思考"时世界被暂停（非实时）；(3) 直接提供物体真值位置，削弱感知难度。因此缺少能刻画长时程、多臂协作、纯视觉、实时环境下智能体能力边界与成本的评测平台。

Method: 构建 RoboTeam 仿真基准：智能体通过调用工具与写代码控制 4–16 条机械臂，仅以相机图像为输入，世界持续运行不暂停。设计 36 项需多臂协同的长时程任务（如传木梁、用数百个方块拼图）。以最灵活的自适应系统（单智能体自行决定何时派生委派）为起点，与三种固定系统（单智能体、分层、去中心化）在成功任务数、耗时与输入 token 上进行对照实验。

Result: 自适应系统下 gpt-6.1-sol 与 opus-5.5 分别完成 28 与 27 项任务，其余四个模型最多完成 3 项；代价高昂，典型任务 gpt-6.1-sol 需 3.5 小时、2.18 亿输入 token，且约三分之一步骤至少失败一次需重试。四种系统完成的任务数相近，但成本结构不同：分层与去中心化更快却最多多用 1.9 倍 token；单智能体 token 更省但耗时达 1.6 倍；自适应系统居中。

Conclusion: 目前尚无任何模型或智能体系统能同时做到快速、低成本且可靠。RoboTeam 在前人基准无法覆盖的三方面——长时程多臂作业、仅依赖相机图像、世界永不暂停——量化了这些能力与成本上限。

Abstract: Multimodal agents can now control robot arms by calling tools and writing code. Existing benchmarks fall short in three ways: most test one or two arms on short tasks, many pause the world while the agent thinks, and many give it ground-truth object positions. We present RoboTeam, a simulated benchmark where agents control 4 to 16 robot arms in real time from camera images alone. Its 36 tasks are long jobs that the arms must do together, such as passing timbers or building a picture from hundreds of cubes. We start from the most flexible agent system, the adaptive system, where one agent decides when to fork delegates. With it, gpt-6.1-sol and opus-5.5 complete 28 and 27 tasks, and four other models at most 3. But at a high price: a typical task takes gpt-6.1-sol 3.5 hours and 218 million input tokens, and a third of its steps fail at least once and must be retried. We then compare it with three fixed systems: single-agent, hierarchical, and decentralized. All four complete a similar number of tasks but differ in time and tokens. The hierarchical and decentralized systems are faster but use up to 1.9 times the tokens, and the single agent uses fewer tokens but takes 1.6 times as long, so the adaptive system lies between them. Even so, no model or system is yet fast, cheap, and reliable at once. RoboTeam measures these limits where earlier benchmarks cannot: long multi-arm jobs, camera images only, and a world that never pauses.

</details>


### [299] [HandUMI: A Modular Hand-Worn Parallel-Jaw Interface for Robot-Free Bimanual Data Capture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22146)
*Brik Meza,Leonardo Perez,Alvaro Mendoza-Li,Aniela Ubillus,Mitshell Ramos,Raul Bastidas,Mauricio Olivera,Bryan Bastidas*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HandUMI 是一种可穿戴平行夹爪接口，用于无机器人采集双臂演示数据，并通过逆运动学将数据重定向到多种仿真双臂机器人，最终在真实 PiPER 双臂上完成毛巾折叠任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双臂机器人策略学习依赖高质量演示数据，但直接用真实双臂机器人采集成本高、效率低且与硬件绑定。已有手持式采集装置多为单臂或与特定夹爪强耦合，缺少通用、低成本、可重定向的双臂演示采集方案。

Method: 设计手戴式平行夹爪接口：可更换指尖以匹配目标机器人夹爪，Quest/PICO 控制器追踪手部位姿，编码器测量夹爪开合度；以机器人无关格式记录数据，再通过逆运动学重定向至七种仿真双臂机器人。

Result: 重定向中位位置误差 ≤1.2 mm，仅 ≤4.7% 的轨迹被剔除。在双臂毛巾折叠任务上，用 562 条无机器人演示在真实 PiPER 双臂上训练策略：ACT 成功率 12/20，微调 π0.5 为 7/20；仅用前 101 条演示的 ACT 与基座 π0.5 均为 0/20。硬件与软件以 Apache-2.0 开源，含 Quest 3S 的一对成本为 557 美元（不含可选 ZED Mini 与主机）。

Conclusion: 可穿戴平行夹爪接口能以低成本、机器人无关的方式高效采集双臂演示，并可靠重定向到多种双臂平台，在真实双臂操作任务上取得可用成功率，具备良好的可扩展性与可复现性。

Abstract: HandUMI captures robot-free bimanual demonstrations with a hand-worn parallel-jaw interface. Swappable fingertips match the robot's installed gripper; Quest/PICO controllers track hands and encoders measure aperture. Robot-agnostic recordings are retargeted by inverse kinematics to seven simulated bimanual arms (median position error $\leq 1.2$ mm; $\leq 4.7$% of episodes rejected). On bimanual towel folding, 562 robot-free demonstrations train policies on real PiPER arms: ACT succeeds in 12/20 attempts and fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ in 7/20; ACT on the first 101 and base $π_{0.5}$ each succeed in 0/20. Hardware and software are open source (Apache-2.0), and a pair costs USD 557 with Quest 3S, excluding the optional ZED Mini and host computer. Project website: https://murobotics.ai/research/handumi.

</details>


### [300] [Haptic Probing for Subsurface-Aware Force Distribution on Layered Soft Tissue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22195)
*Lei Shi,Xiaoyu Wang,Cheng Zhou,Yongjian Liu,Jing Wang,Dongsheng Zhang,Yonghui Zhu,Xiong Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出引入独立"触觉感知通道"：在轻预载下用短时低幅激励测量局部动态导纳，将肌肉与骨支撑软组织区分（相对个体基线），从而在施加任务力之前确定控制策略；再由力-触觉驱动的分配律在任务中维持该策略，实现面接触下力跟踪与压力均匀。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 力调节的接触任务在曲面/分层软组织上最易在"亚表层组成变化"处失败：现有控制器仅凭加载力信号推断基底，估计滞后于真实变化，且在软（肌肉）而非骨支撑组织上滞后更严重。作者希望消除这一估计滞后。

Method: 1）主动触觉探测：轻预载下施加短时、低幅激励，用局部动态导纳判别"肌肉 vs 骨支撑组织"，以每受试者基线为参照，用于"做出控制决策"而非组织表征本身，从而在任务力施加前完成判断。2）力-触觉驱动的分配律：瞬时分配使各接触指尖压力均衡；regime 决定允许压力上限，进而决定达到目标力所需招募的接触面积——把贴片面积作为受控变量而非副产物。3）分区被动性预算（partitioned passivity budget）：将探测、切换、招募分别计价，保证安全监控不会因能量约束而抑制探测；拒绝招募时放弃力跟踪而非突破压力上限。

Result: 在曲面、迁移接触（migrating contact）条件下，对三名人类受试者报告了力跟踪与压力均匀性结果；regime 标签由解剖学标志确定。

Conclusion: 将触觉探测作为独立通道、在任务力前"承诺"控制决策，可消除基于加载信号的基底估计滞后；配合以面积（招募）为受控变量的力-触觉分配律与分区被动性预算，可在分层软组织上实现力跟踪与压力均匀，并保证安全性不被探测/招募需求所牺牲。

Abstract: Force-regulated contact with layered soft tissue fails most often where the subsurface composition changes: controllers infer the substrate from the loading signal alone, so the estimate guiding them lags the change---more acutely, we argue, over compliant than over bone-backed tissue. We remove that lag with a separate haptic channel. Under a light preload, a brief low-amplitude excitation lets the local dynamic admittance discriminate muscle from bone-backed tissue relative to a per-subject baseline, before task force is applied---active haptic sensing used to commit a control decision rather than to characterise tissue. A force- and tactile-driven distribution law then consumes that regime throughout execution: an instantaneous allocation equalises pressure across the engaged fingertips, while the regime sets the admissible pressure and hence the area the hand must recruit to deliver the target force---making patch area a controlled variable rather than a by-product. Probing, switches and recruitment are priced in a partitioned passivity budget, so safety monitoring cannot suppress the probe and a refused recruitment forfeits force tracking rather than the pressure bound. We report force tracking and pressure uniformity over curved, migrating contact on three human subjects, with regime labels from anatomical landmarks.

</details>


### [301] [From Temperature-Limited to Battery-Limited Legged Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22231)
*Raphaël Ségas,Balázs Opra,Léo Ghafari,Thomas Stewart*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出热感知运动策略：用13节点集总RC热网络预测电机稳态温度，并以“最热预测渐近温度”为奖励嵌入强化学习，使机器人无需温度观测即可学会降低并分散热负荷；Go2实测中把持续运动从热受限（19 min/1.1 km）变为电量受限（174 min/10.0 km）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四足机器人持续运动常因少数关节电机过热触发热关停而终止，而非电池耗尽，形成“热受限”瓶颈；且热时间常数远大于强化学习的信用分配视界，直接优化温度难以学习。

Method: 1) 辨识耦合的13节点集总RC热网络，用单机两次运行拟合、以实测电功率校准，可在不同机器实例、步态、负载、速度下预测全部12个电机温度；2) 由步态平均的力矩平方与关节速度直接解析稳态（渐近）温度；3) 设计以最热预测渐近温度为惩罚的奖励，渐近量在单个步态周期内即可响应力矩与转速，规避热时间常数过长的问题，策略无需温度输入。

Result: 热模型平均RMSE<1 °C；5 kg负载、1 m/s下，基线19 min（1.1 km）热关停，本策略174 min（10.0 km）耗尽电池，最热电机低于阈值14 °C（26 °C室温）；空载含楼梯坡道的厂区环路，基线25圈（6.2 km）过热，本策略单次充电47圈（11.2 km），余量22 °C。

Conclusion: 将热约束以“可预测稳态温度”形式前馈进奖励，可在无温度传感条件下实现热感知全局限温调度，把持续运动由热受限转为电量受限，显著提升续航里程与热安全裕度。

Abstract: On legged robots, sustained locomotion often ends in thermal shutdown rather than battery depletion: the heat of walking concentrates in a few joint motors, which overheat long before the battery is empty. We train thermally aware locomotion policies by reinforcement learning without ever observing temperature, and demonstrate this on a Unitree Go2 quadruped. We first identify a coupled 13-node lumped RC thermal network, fitted on two runs of a single robot and calibrated against the measured electrical power, that predicts all twelve motor temperatures with a mean RMSE below 1 $^\circ$C across different robot instances, gaits, payloads, and speeds. Under a sustained gait, the temperatures the motors will settle at follow directly from the gait-averaged squared torques and joint speeds. Our core contribution is a reward that drives down the hottest predicted asymptotes: thermal time constants exceed the credit-assignment horizon of reinforcement learning by orders of magnitude, but predicted asymptotes respond to torque and joint speed within a single gait cycle, so the policy learns to lower and spread heat with no temperature input. On the robot, the policy turns sustained locomotion from temperature-limited to battery-limited: with a 5 kg payload at 1 m/s, a learned baseline reaches thermal shutdown after 19 minutes (1.1 km), whereas our policy runs the battery down after 174 minutes (10.0 km) with its hottest motor 14 $^\circ$C below the shutdown threshold in a 26 $^\circ$C room; on an unloaded factory circuit with stairs and ramps, the baseline overheats after 25 laps (6.2 km), while our policy completes 47 (11.2 km) on one battery with 22 $^\circ$C of margin.

</details>


### [302] [ALERT: Extending Humanoid Motion Trackers with a General and Lightweight Human Avoidance Pipeline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22258)
*Zhaoyang Li,Chiyu Zhang,Chengxin Xu,Peng Yang,Zhonghao Guo,Wanting Li,Ziyu Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 ALERT——一个通用轻量级管线，将人体感知与主动避障融入预训练全身运动跟踪策略，实现人机共享环境下的无碰撞执行而不牺牲参考动作完整性与跟踪连续性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全身运动跟踪已支撑人形舞蹈、竞技动作与遥操作，但现有跟踪策略缺乏对附近人类的感知与主动避让能力；而动作替换或局部约束修正又会损害参考动作完整性与跟踪连续性。

Method: 以预训练跟踪策略为骨干，通过轻量级适配（lightweight adaptation）把人类感知模块与主动避障能力整合进已有策略，在避障需求与参考动作跟踪之间取得平衡，同时保留原有运动能力，形成可插拔的通用管线。

Result: 在多类跟踪骨干上的仿真与真机实验显示：可实现可靠的局部人体避让与无碰撞执行，保持全身协调性，并能快速恢复对参考动作的跟踪；同时预训练策略跟踪未见动作的能力得以保留。

Conclusion: ALERT 以轻量适配方式将避障能力扩展到既有跟踪策略，兼顾安全性、动作保真与泛化性，为共享人机环境中的能力演示与操作数据采集提供可行方案。

Abstract: Whole-body motion tracking has enabled humanoid dancing, athletic motions, and teleoperation, providing a foundation for capability demonstrations and manipulation data collection. However, existing tracking policies lack awareness of nearby humans and proactive avoidance capabilities, while motion substitution and local constraint-based corrections may compromise reference motion integrity and tracking continuity. We propose ALERT, a general lightweight pipeline for extending motion tracking to shared human-robot environments. Through lightweight adaptation, it integrates human perception and proactive avoidance into pretrained tracking policies, balancing avoidance demands with reference motion tracking while preserving existing motion capabilities. Simulation and real-world experiments across tracking backbones demonstrate reliable collision-free execution through localized human avoidance, preserving whole-body coordination and enabling rapid recovery of reference tracking, while retaining the ability of pretrained policies to track unseen motions.

</details>


### [303] [Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22275)
*Ting-Hsuan Chen,Siheng Zhao,Han Jiang,Qi Pan,Louison Lu,Jiaheng Luo,Henghui Bao,Yiyu Chen,Quan Nguyen,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Heave-Ho，一个用于长时序多机人形机器人协同移动操作的去中心化框架：低层用多智能体后训练框架将人形基础跟踪模型适配到机器人间的物理耦合交互，实现仅凭局部观测的协同控制；高层训练视觉语言规划器并设计基于语音的领队-跟随协调机制，在无网络通信条件下同步去中心化执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协同可使多个人形机器人突破单体能力上限，但实现该潜力需要全身协调交互、长时序一致性规划以及机器人间的精确同步，现有方法难以同时满足。

Method: 低层：多智能体后训练框架，将人形基础 tracking 模型适配到物理耦合的机器人间交互，实现基于局部观测的去中心化协同控制。高层：训练视觉-语言规划器（vision-language planner），并设计基于语音的 leader-follower 协调机制，在无网络通信下同步去中心化执行。仅用两台相同人形机器人训练，系统可扩展至最多 10 台并泛化到异构队伍而无需重训练；同时提出 HH-Bench 基准，含 12 项任务（2–10 台机器人团队，含异构团队）。

Result: 系统性评测显示 Heave-Ho 一致优于基线方法；真实世界实验证明其在挑战性任务上具备鲁棒的 decentralized 协同能力，且可从 2 台训练规模扩展到 10 台并泛化到异构团队。

Conclusion: Heave-Ho 通过"低层多智能体后训练 + 高层 VLM 规划与语音协调"的分层去中心化设计，实现了可扩展、可泛化的长时序多人形机器人协同移动操作，并以 HH-Bench 提供了系统性评测手段。

Abstract: Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. We introduce Heave-Ho, a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation. At the low level, we develop a multi-agent post-training framework that adapts a humanoid foundation tracking model to physically coupled interactions between humanoids, enabling coordinated decentralized control from local observations alone. At the high level, we train a vision-language planner and design a speech-based leader-follower coordination mechanism to synchronize decentralized execution without network communication. Trained with two identical humanoids, our system scales to teams of up to ten robots and generalizes to heterogeneous teams without retraining. To benchmark these capabilities, we introduce HH-Bench, comprising 12 tasks involving teams of 2 to 10 humanoids, including heterogeneous teams. Systematic evaluations show that Heave-Ho consistently outperforms baseline methods, while real-world experiments demonstrate robust decentralized collaboration across challenging tasks.

</details>


### [304] [When the World Is the Test Suite: Agentic Intelligence for the Physical World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.22291)
*Kaixin Li,Meng Luo,Yanlin Li,Yuchen Tian,Xiang Liu,Xiangru Jian,Yan Yang,Zhiheng Xi,Yang Zhang,Ziyang Luo,Mingfei Cheng,Hongzhan Lin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 将物理世界视为程序的“测试套件”，从“如何写程序、如何测试程序、如何从结果中学习”三问系统梳理面向物理世界的智能体研究，并提出需要“物理版持续集成”这一廉价、可靠、可维护的验证机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体已从纯软件修复扩展到机器人、实验室与工业控制器的程序编写。与软件工程不同，此类代码没有现成测试套件，程序是否有效必须通过在真机、物理仿真器或由其辅助训练的策略上运行来判定；这类证据昂贵且可能出错。因此“如何评判程序”与“如何写程序”同等重要，需要对该交叉领域进行系统化梳理。

Method: 采用综述/立场论文式的组织框架：以“世界即测试套件”为视角，围绕三个问题展开——(1)写程序：追溯机器人语言模型与软件工程智能体的汇流，按程序相对执行器（actuator）的位置及其评判者（judge）进行分类，涵盖直接作为机器人策略的程序，以及产出奖励、任务与训练环境的支撑策略学习的程序；(2)测程序：梳理软件测试实践向物理测试的迁移，分析物理试验的成本，以及执行轨迹（traces）、学习型评判器、仿真器与形式化检查所能提供的替代性证据，并讨论任务成功之外的安全要求；(3)学经验：分析经测试的程序如何以技能库与模型权重形式沉淀为经验。最后讨论基准与评测实践及开放挑战。

Result: 论文并未给出实验数据，而是提出一个分析框架与核心论断：写程序的成本正在快速下降，而关于程序实际行为的可信证据依然昂贵；该领域的进展将取决于是否存在“持续集成的物理对应物”——足够廉价以高频运行、足够可靠以在搜索下可信、并能与所验证的经验同步维护的验证体系。同时给出了按执行器位置与评判方式划分程序类型的分类维度，以及轨迹、学习型评判器、仿真与形式化方法作为低成本证据来源的比较视角。

Conclusion: 面向物理世界的智能体智能，其瓶颈已从“生成代码”转向“获得可信验证”。未来研究应把验证本身作为一等公民：建设低成本、可复用、可持续维护的物理验证基础设施，并将其与技能库、模型权重等经验沉淀机制闭环结合，同时配套相应基准与评测规范。

Abstract: Coding agents built to repair software now write, test, and repair programs for robots, laboratories, and industrial controllers.
