Conditioned on the task instruction, robot state, and current action estimate, recurrent transition layers extract step-relevant predictive cues across depth and relay them directly into the action attention, without generating future frames at inference. Experiments show that RelayWAM substantially amplifies the benefit of future supervision, translating into stronger generalization under distribution shifts in both simulation and real-world robot tasks. On LIBERO-Plus, RelayWAM achieves 72.03% mean success, compared to 56.42% without future supervision and 51.50% for Fast-WAM.

</details>


### [339] [Magflow: Differentiable Simulation of Industrial-Grade 6D Magnetic Levitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23050)
*Philipp Hartmann,Jannick Stranghöner,Klaus Neumann*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出可微GPU并行6D磁悬浮物理仿真器Magflow，并据此纯仿真训练出首个工业级6D磁悬浮神经控制器，实现4 kHz硬实时下从仿真到硬件的零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6D磁悬浮动力学复杂且不稳定，低层控制困难。工业界依赖硬件-软件协同设计，将电磁力计算简化为手工近似以保证千赫兹级控制可算，但该做法对工作空间与动子拓扑施加了过度保守的限制。

Method: 不采用手工近似，而是直接计算物理：构建全可微、GPU并行的6D磁悬浮仿真器Magflow，并仅基于仿真物理训练神经控制器。

Result: 神经控制器从仿真零样本迁移到真实硬件，并在4 kHz下满足硬实时约束；实现定性上新的行为，甚至能悬浮无手工解支持的动子拓扑。

Conclusion: 协同设计并非6D磁悬浮控制的物理必然性；从仿真物理中学习控制可在苛刻工业领域找到超越传统控制工程的解。

Abstract: Magnetic levitation with six-degrees-of-freedom enables frictionless transport and micrometer-scale positioning in principle, but low-level control is inherently challenging due to its complex and unstable dynamics. Industrial systems typically rely on deep hardware-software co-design, where mover and stator geometries are jointly designed to enable a compact, hand-crafted approximation of the electromagnetic force computation, thereby keeping control computationally tractable at kilohertz rates. However, this approach imposes overly conservative constraints on the operating workspace and the range of supported mover topologies. Instead of reducing the underlying physics to a hand-crafted approximation, we compute the physics directly. We introduce Magflow, a fully differentiable, GPU-parallel simulator for 6D magnetic levitation. It is used to train the first neural controller for an industrial-grade 6D magnetic levitation system that is learned purely from simulated physics. We show that the learned neural controller transfers zero-shot from simulation to real hardware while satisfying hard real-time constraints at 4 kHz. The learned controller achieves qualitatively new behaviors and even levitates a mover topology for which no hand-crafted solution exists. These results demonstrate that co-design is not a physical necessity for 6D magnetic levitation control. More broadly, control learning from simulated physics can find solutions beyond the reach of control engineering in demanding industrial domains. Source code and demonstration videos are publicly available at https://sites.google.com/view/magflow.

</details>


### [340] [RFW-S: Everyday Deformable Objects with Independent Simulation Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23056)
*Jiarui Guo,Saining Zhang,Jiaying Wan,Jiawei Weng,Junhao Chen,Rui Zhang,Yuanbo Lyu,Zhiheng Lee,Peishuo Li,Jingrun Du,Weiqing Xiao,Weiyi Lin,Zenan Meng,Hu Wei,Lin Qu,Zongzheng Zhang,Hao Zhao,Chaojian Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RFW-S大规模可形变物体仿真资产数据集（83,365个资产、485类、五类结构家族），配套自动化物理建模与独立仿真验证流程，并验证其物理真实性与Sim-to-Real可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模机器人仿真需要具备可执行物理属性与真实交互行为的多样化可形变物体，但现有3D资产集偏重视觉多样性，缺乏可扩展的物理构建与验证手段。

Method: 构建自动化流水线：参考引导的3D生成、结构感知的物理建模、LLM辅助的物理参数估计与标定；并引入独立仿真验证框架，在与标定阶段不同的交互条件下评估物体行为。

Result: 大量实验表明独立验证有效，并刻画了不同物理配置下的形变响应；机器人抓取实验在任务成功率与物体完整性两方面进行评估；通过易碎物体操作的Sim-to-Real重放验证仿真物体的物理真实感。

Conclusion: RFW-S为物理落地的仿真与具身机器人学习提供了可扩展基础。

Abstract: Large-scale robotic simulation requires diverse deformable objects with executable physical properties and realistic interaction behaviors. However, existing 3D asset collections primarily emphasize visual diversity, while scalable physical construction and verification remain challenging. We introduce RFW-S, a large-scale dataset of 83,365 simulation-verified assets spanning 485 everyday categories across five structural families: soft solids, cloth sheets, shells, garments, and bags. We develop an automated pipeline integrating reference-guided 3D generation, structure-aware physical modeling, and LLM-assisted parameter estimation and calibration. To ensure physical reliability, we introduce an independent simulation verification framework that evaluates object behaviors under interactions distinct from those used for parameter calibration. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of independent verification and characterize deformable responses under different physical configurations. We further evaluate robotic grasping in terms of both task success and object integrity, and demonstrate the physical realism of our simulated objects through sim-to-real replay of fragile-object manipulation. RFW-S provides a scalable foundation for physically grounded simulation and embodied robotic learning.

</details>


### [341] [PAIR: Bringing Household Robots into the Smart Home](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23070)
*Junseong Pyo,Hyeongjin Kim,Jongwook Han,Seungwon Kook,Sungjib Lim,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 PAIR——一个基于 Matter 协议的智能家居仿真环境，包含 84 个具有实体控制面板与设备 API 的智能设备资产，并构建了 40 个任务基准（340 条人类示范）。实验表明，即便是微调后的 VLA 策略在所有 120 个评测回合中均未完成任何任务，且规划器在选择"按按钮"还是"调用 API"时主要取决于自身能否读懂面板，而非 API 延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 家用机器人需要操作家电，而现实中的智能家电既有物理控制面板又有设备 API。然而现有具身 AI 仿真环境仅将家电建模为纯物理对象，忽略了 API 这一可用的替代操作通道，导致机器人"实体操作 vs. 数字接口"的混合交互能力无法被研究。

Method: 1) 构建 PAIR 环境：以 Matter 智能家居标准为语义基础，提供 84 个智能设备资产，其功能控制面板与 API 共同作用于同一份共享设备状态，环境条件随二者变化而演化。2) 通过 1,443 条请求的调研，筛选出 40 个必须依赖物体操作、但即使无 API 也可完成的任务，并采集 340 条人类示范用于策略训练。3) 在三种设定下评测：策略单独运行、策略+高层规划器、策略+支持 API 的规划器；并设置"完美 oracle 替代机器人本体"的消融，以分离身体执行与高层决策的影响。4) 分析规划器在按钮与 API 之间的选择依据。

Result: 两个微调 VLA 策略在 120 个评测回合中完成数为 0。机器人极少能走到调用 API 的环节：即使给定 oracle 计划并开放 API，超过 90% 的失败 rollout 停滞在导航、抓取或开门操作上。以完美 oracle 替代机器人本体后，最佳规划器仍只能完成其计划的 57.3%。此外，多个规划器在按钮与 API 之间选择时依据的是能否读取面板，而非 API 延迟。

Conclusion: PAIR 首次将"物理操作 + 设备 API"双通道引入具身智能仿真，揭示了当前瓶颈不在高层决策或 API 可及性，而在低层具身执行（导航、抓取、开门）。结论强调：在智能家居场景中，提升机器人基础操作可靠性比增加数字接口更为紧迫，同时规划器需具备对物理界面可读性的显式建模能力。

Abstract: Household robots often need to operate appliances, and smart appliances offer both control panels and device APIs. Existing embodied AI simulation environments, however, model appliances solely as physical objects. We introduce PAIR, a smart-home simulation environment grounded in the Matter protocol~\footnote{https://csa-iot.org/all-solutions/matter/}, the industry standard for smart-home devices. PAIR provides 84 smart-device assets whose functional control panels and APIs act on a shared device state, with ambient conditions that evolve in response to both. From a survey of 1,443 requests, we construct a benchmark of 40 tasks that all require object manipulation yet remain solvable without API access, with 340 human demonstrations for policy training. Whether run alone, with a high-level planner, or with an API-enabled planner, two fine-tuned VLA policies complete none of the 120 evaluation episodes. Robots rarely get far enough to use the API: even with oracle plans and API access, over 90\% of failed rollouts stall at navigating, grasping, or operating a door. With a perfect oracle in place of the robot's body, the best planner still gets through only 57.3\% of its plan. When choosing between pressing a button and calling an API, several planners go by whether they can read the panel, not by API latency.\footnote{We will release our code and data upon publication.}

</details>


### [342] [CADENCE: Learning Acyclic Gaits for Model-Based Quadruped Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23102)
*Owen Sullivan,Sourav Selvaraj,Mahdi Agheli*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CADENCE：学习式落足点规划器，以极小的动作空间在无步态调度、无步态奖励项下自主学习出非周期步态，并在稀疏地形上显著优于传统周期步态控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于模型的四足控制器通常采用固定周期、固定抬腿顺序的循环步态，与实际安全落足点无关，在存在空隙/稀疏地形上表现不佳。

Method: CADENCE每40 ms做一次离散决策（最多65种选择：不迈步，或某条腿迈向某个安全落足点），并预测摆动时间；以凸模型预测控制器（MPC）为基础，用强化学习训练，奖励中仅有单步代价、无步态项，唯一结构约束是至多两腿同时摆动。另用逆落足点模型（IFM）将从控制器日志拟合的落足点映射为指令，仅重拟合IFM（少于20,000步）即可让CADENCE冻结地运行于OCS2非线性MPC之上。

Result: 分析得到的策略形成非周期步态，无固定周期与迈步顺序，但仍成对使用对角腿。仿真中在多种地形（空隙率26%–49%）与速度（0.1、0.2 m/s）下成功率为85.1%（五种子均值），对比OCS2-Trot 67.8%、OCS2-Single 65.5%、CADENCE静态行走消融39.6%；在49%空隙率下为72.9%，对比OCS2-Trot 43.0%。

Conclusion: 无需显式步态设计，学习式离散落足规划即可涌现出有效的非周期步态，并与经典MPC管线兼容，在稀疏地形上明显优于周期步态基线。

Abstract: Model-based quadruped controllers usually step on a cyclic gait, which lifts the legs in a fixed order on a fixed period, wherever the safe footholds are. We present CADENCE, a learned step planner with a small action space. Every 40 ms, it picks one of at most 65 discrete choices: no step, or one leg's step to a safe foothold. It also predicts a swing time. We train CADENCE by reinforcement learning on top of a convex model predictive controller (MPC). Nothing prescribes a gait: there is no gait schedule, and the reward has no gait term, only a cost per step. The one structural constraint is that at most two legs may swing at once. The policy we analyzed developed an acyclic gait, with no fixed period or stepping order, yet it still paired diagonal legs. An inverse footstep model (IFM), fitted on a controller's logged steps, turns each foothold into a command. With only the IFM refitted, on fewer than 20,000 steps, CADENCE ran frozen on OCS2's nonlinear MPC. In simulated trials on a range of terrains (26% to 49% voids) and speeds (0.1 m/s and 0.2 m/s), it succeeded in 85.1% (mean of five seeds), against 67.8% for OCS2-Trot, 65.5% for OCS2-Single, and 39.6% in a static walk ablation of CADENCE. At 49% voids, it succeeded in 72.9%, against 43.0% for OCS2-Trot.

</details>


### [343] [Auditing a Learned Simulator for Legged Robots: The Robotic World Model on ANYmal D](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23118)
*Joyjeet Singh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 对已发表系统RWM（ANYmal D四足机器人动力学模型）及RWM-U（不确定性估计）做端到端复现审计，无GPU。核心发现：单步检验会误判设计选择；系综差异性对rollout误差排序好（Spearman +0.90）但覆盖率仅4.6%（校准应为68%）；模型精度不能预测策略行走表现——18个微调副本全部单步/八步预测优于原模型，却有13个策略失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腿部机器人在"已学习模拟器"（自回归前向的神经网络动力学模型）中训练策略，但模型通常仅做单步训练与校验，而策略需前推上百步使用。作者希望检验这种"单步评估"范式是否可靠，并系统审计已公开的RWM/RWM-U系统在长程rollout、不确定性校准与下游策略质量上的实际表现。

Method: 精确复现：重建模型使其输出、损失与梯度与发布代码完全一致；测量101个训练好的模拟器、200个压缩副本、38个其他三种架构的模拟器；测量环境中用MuJoCo手工搭建ANYmal D模型测试策略。设计注册检验：比较"模型自身rollout训练"与"单步训练"在368步上的表现；权重剪枝实验；系综差异性-rollout误差Spearman相关与1σ覆盖率；无需未来数据的两类检查；在机器人层面比较预测精度与策略行走成功率；次级测试中用作者策略在各模拟器内运行以对模拟器排序。另报告9个作者主动撤回的自有主张。

Result: 模型自身rollout训练在全部10个留出episode上于368步优于单步训练（已注册），但单步领先处单步训练更好。剪枝30%权重单步保留90%能力、2秒仅保留39%。系综差异性排序rollout误差良好（100步Spearman +0.90），但1σ仅覆盖4.6%结果（校准应为68%），原因是实现损失下各网络自身方差坍缩。两类无需记录未来的检查能对部分模拟器池排序较好，但在主检验中均未优于8步误差。机器人层面：18个微调副本在1步与8步预测均优于发布模型，其中13个产生失败策略；关于"某项检查能否按策略排序模拟器"的注册检验未定论。次级测试中，在各模拟器内运行作者策略可良好排序。

Conclusion: 单步校验不足以判断长程rollout设计；不确定性估计严重欠覆盖（过度自信），系综差异性可作误差排序代理但不可作概率保证；动力学模型精度与最终行走能力脱节，模拟器质量评估宜以下游策略表现为准。结论适用范围限于单一机器人、单一步态、仿真数据，未涉及硬件。

Abstract: A legged robot can learn to walk inside a learned simulator: a neural network that predicts the robot's next state and is run forward on its own predictions. They are usually trained and checked one step ahead, although a policy uses them for a hundred steps or more. We audit one published system end to end, without a GPU: the dynamics model of the Robotic World Model (RWM) for the ANYmal D quadruped, and the uncertainty estimate of its follow-up, RWM-U. We rebuilt the model to match the released code's outputs, losses and gradients exactly, measured 101 trained simulators, 200 compressed copies and 38 simulators of three other architectures, and trained policies inside simulators that we tested in a hand-built MuJoCo model of the robot. Training on the model's own rollouts beat one-step training at 368 steps on all ten held-out episodes (registered), although one-step training was better one step ahead. One-step checks therefore misjudge design choices: pruning 30% of the weights kept 90% of the model's skill one step ahead and 39% at 2 s. Ensemble disagreement ranked rollout error well (Spearman +0.90 at 100 steps), yet covered 4.6% of outcomes at one sigma, against 68% for a calibrated estimate, as each network's own variance collapses under the implemented loss. Two checks that need no recorded future ranked some pools of simulators well, but neither was shown better than 8-step error in a primary test. At the robot level, accuracy has not predicted walking: all 18 fine-tuned copies we tested predicted better than the released model one and eight steps ahead, yet 13 gave failing policies, and registered tests of whether any check ranks simulators by their policies were not settled. In a secondary test, running the authors' policy inside each simulator ranked them well. We also report nine of our own claims that we withdrew. Scope: one robot, one gait, simulated data, no hardware.

</details>


### [344] [Pressure Drop: Gravity Vector Estimation from a Distributed Barometric Pressure Sensor Array](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23120)
*William Dubois,Nicolas Lauzon,Johann Laconte,François Pomerleau*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出利用高度计测量直接观测重力向量方向，用于移动机器人SLAM中的重力约束估计，并给出理论噪声分析与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SLAM方法多依赖IMU等对重力向量的间接观测，缺少直接观测重力方向的手段，本文希望借助高度计实现直接观测并评估其可行性。

Method: 利用高度计测量直接观测重力向量方向，给出估计噪声的理论评估，并通过大量实验数据验证；同时分析传感器间距对重力向量估计的影响。

Result: 半静态场景下倾斜估计中位误差达0.87°；与基于IMU的先进方法对比，在高动态场景性能相当，在加速度计测量饱和的特定情况下甚至更优；另通过集成到ICP算法中验证了在机器人系统中的潜力。

Conclusion: 高度计可直接观测重力方向，性能可与IMU方法相当甚至更优，具备集成到机器人系统（如ICP）的应用潜力。

Abstract: While gravity is often used in mobile robotics as a global constraint for Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) algorithms, most estimation methods rely on indirect observation of the gravity vector. In this paper, we propose the use of altimeter measurements to directly observe the direction of the gravity vector. We provide a theoretical evaluation of the estimation noise and validate it through extensive experimental data, along with an evaluation of the impact of intersensor distance on our gravity vector estimates. Experimental results demonstrate that a median error of $0.87^\circ$ on the tilt estimation can be achieved with our system in semi-static scenarios. Furthermore, we demonstrate the potential of this approach by comparing it with state-of-the-art methods based on Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs). We highlight that we achieve similar performance to that of IMU-based systems in highly dynamic scenarios and even outperform in specific cases of accelerometer measurement saturation. Finally, an additional experiment shows the potential use within a robotic system through the integration into an Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm.

</details>


### [345] [TCP4D: A Unified Tool-Center-Point Tracking and Generation Model for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23143)
*Haosong Peng,Xiangyang Liu,Zhengshen Zhang,Yunfeng Fan,Tianyu Qi,Xin Xia,Yufeng Zhan,Wenchao Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出TCP4D：以共享4D场景表示统一"TCP运动跟踪"与"未来TCP轨迹生成"，并结合跨本体增强流水线，从纯RGB视频中恢复动作标注并实现跨本体示教复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作视频蕴含丰富视觉经验，但从RGB观测中恢复机器人动作与夹爪状态标注仍然困难；同时数据受限于特定本体，难以迁移到新机器人。

Method: 以与本无关的TCP位姿作为动作空间，构建共享4D场景表示：跟踪器从单目视频与初始2D TCP查询中恢复SE(3)度量TCP位姿、夹爪状态、场景几何与相机参数；生成器在恢复的TCP轨迹上从同一4D表示采样局部特征，融合机器人观测与语言指令预测未来TCP状态；另设跨本体增强流水线，通过重定向恢复的运动并合成对应观测，将现有RGB视频转为其他本体的示教数据（无需源机器人状态）。

Result: 跟踪器在DROID和RoboLab上绝对轨迹误差分别为7.60 mm和16.07 mm，仅需10条示教即可适应新本体；生成器在RoboTwin上平均成功率69.19%，在两个真实任务上优于成熟策略模型；源数据与增强示教联合训练相比仅用增强数据，目标机器人成功率提升41.5%。

Conclusion: 共享4D表示可同时支撑精确的TCP跟踪与轨迹生成，为无本体标注的视频数据提供可扩展的动作恢复与跨本体示教方案。

Abstract: Robot manipulation videos provide a rich visual experience, yet recovering robot action and gripper-state annotations from RGB observations still remains challenging. Using the embodiment-agnostic tool-center-point (TCP) pose as the action space, we present TCP4D, a unified model in which a shared 4D scene representation both tracks observed TCP motion and generates future TCP trajectories. Given a monocular video and initial 2D TCP queries, the tracker directly recovers metric TCP poses in SE(3) and gripper states alongside scene geometry and camera parameters. The generator samples local features from the same 4D representation along the recovered TCP tracks, then combines them with robot observations and language instructions to predict future TCP states. Our new cross-embodiment augmentation pipeline converts existing RGB videos into demonstrations for alternative embodiments by retargeting the recovered motion and synthesizing the corresponding observations, without recorded source-robot states. Experiments show that the tracker achieves absolute trajectory errors of 7.60 and 16.07 mm on DROID and RoboLab and adapts to a new embodiment with only ten demonstrations. The generator achieves 69.19% mean success on RoboTwin and outperforms well-established policy models on two real-world tasks, while joint training on source and augmented demonstrations improves target-robot success by 41.5% over augmented-only training.

</details>


### [346] [Capability Composition in Heterogeneous Teams via Barrier-Guided Diffusion Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23149)
*Diana Laura Morales,Ruoyu Lin,Magnus Egerstedt,Fabio Pasqualetti*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种在仅有单智能体演示的情况下，通过对生成模型采样过程施加物理约束来生成异构团队协作轨迹的方法，理论上可覆盖所有满足约束的团队轨迹，并在两个协作任务及多机器人平台上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构团队的协作演示数据获取成本高，且对团队从未执行过的任务可能根本不存在。但智能体能否协作完成任务的条件本质上是团队的物理属性，在收集任何演示之前就已已知，因此无需依赖协作演示即可利用这一先验。

Method: 将这些物理条件编码为团队轨迹上的约束；分别在各单智能体自身的演示上训练生成模型；在从这些生成模型采样时强制执行团队层面的约束（约束引导采样），从而无需任何协作演示即可生成联合的团队轨迹。

Result: 理论证明：该方法能生成所有满足约束的团队轨迹，尽管训练数据中不含任何协作演示。两个协作任务的数值实验表明该方法有效，可生成满足约束的协作团队轨迹；且当智能体加入或离开团队时无需重新训练模型。最后在多机器人测试平台上实现了该方法。

Conclusion: 约束决定"哪些"团队轨迹可以被生成，演示决定每条轨迹"有多可能"，二者解耦。该框架在减少协作演示依赖、支持团队动态变化方面具有优势，并在真实多机器人系统中得到验证。

Abstract: The agents in a heterogeneous team can cooperate to accomplish tasks that exceed their individual capabilities. The team trajectories for a cooperative task can be generated by a generative model, provided that the model has been trained on demonstrations of the agents cooperating. Yet, demonstrations of cooperation are costly and may not exist for tasks that the team has never performed. The conditions under which the agents can combine their capabilities, however, are physical properties of the team and are known before any demonstration is collected. We encode the conditions as constraints on the team trajectories, and we enforce the constraints while sampling from generative models trained on demonstrations of each agent alone. We prove that the proposed method can generate every team trajectory that satisfies the constraints, although the demonstrations contain no cooperation. Hence the constraints determine which team trajectories can be generated, and the demonstrations determine how likely each team trajectory is. Numerical results on two cooperative tasks show the effectiveness of the method, which generates cooperative team trajectories that satisfy the constraints and requires no retraining when agents join or leave the team. Finally, we implement the method on a multi-robot testbed.

</details>


### [347] [Feedback-Linearised Trajectory Tracking via Model-Informed Robust Geometric DDPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.23215)
*Pranav Gupta,Deepan Muthirayan,Ravi Banavar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文研究基于反馈线性化的几何鲁棒数据驱动预测控制（DDPC），用于全驱动机械臂轨迹跟踪：以机械模型将虚拟加速度映射为关节力矩，用离线数据刻画残余动态，并在以拟合轨迹子空间为中心的开放Grassmannian球上最小化最坏情况预测误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定线性预测器难以准确刻画非线性动态，而纯数据驱动方法又受模型参数不精确导致的残余动态影响，故需在模型与数据之间建立兼顾精度的鲁棒预测控制框架。

Method: 采用基于模型的反馈线性化：机械模型把虚拟加速度指令转换为关节力矩；离线记录数据用于捕捉模型参数不精确引起的残余动态。控制器在以拟合轨迹子空间为中心的开放Grassmannian球上最小化最坏情况预测误差，实现几何鲁棒DDPC。

Result: 在重力作用下的平面2R机械臂仿真中，与双积分器MPC及直接正则化DeePC对比：所提方法相较双积分器MPC跟踪精度提升（但力矩消耗增加）；相较DeePC的优劣取决于参考轨迹。

Conclusion: 将反馈线性化与几何鲁棒数据驱动预测相结合可改善全驱动机械臂的轨迹跟踪，但其相对纯数据驱动方法的优势并非普遍成立，且以更高的控制努力为代价。

Abstract: Data-driven predictive control (DDPC) predicts system responses from recorded trajectories, but nonlinear dynamics can limit the accuracy of fixed linear predictors. This paper studies geometric robust DDPC for trajectory tracking of a fully actuated manipulator using model-based feedback linearisation. A mechanical model maps virtual acceleration commands into joint torques, while recorded data capture residual dynamics arising from imperfect model parameters. The controller minimises worst-case prediction error over an open Grassmannian ball centred at the fitted trajectory subspace. Simulations on a planar 2R manipulator under gravity compare the proposed method with double-integrator model predictive control (MPC) and direct regularised data-enabled predictive control (DeePC). Results show improved tracking over double-integrator MPC despite increased torque effort, while performance relative to DeePC depends on the reference trajectory.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [348] [DeltaHarness: Self-Evolving Harnesses for Resource-Adaptive Tool Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21688)
*Lecheng Yan,Jianze Lin,Xicheng Han,Xiantao Xu,Wenxi Li,Chenyang Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DeltaHarness：一种执行引导的策略搜索方法，通过冷启动测量自适应调整智能体执行框架，用QHI循环更新运行时调度与物理计划，并由独立确认面板控制策略替换，在视频编辑等任务上显著降低端到端延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用型智能体依赖执行框架来组织与调度工具操作，但相同的任务与资源描述可能隐藏着会反转有效执行计划延迟排序的运行时条件，这种不确定性只能通过目标环境中的第一手执行来消解。

Method: DeltaHarness采用执行引导的策略搜索：从冷启动测量中自适应地调整智能体执行框架（harness）。其QHI循环依据观测到的响应更新运行时调度（dispatch）、修订物理执行计划，并为后续提案选择实验；策略替换由独立确认面板（confirmation panel）把关，以保证稳健性。

Result: 在固定调度下，修订后的物化（materialization）策略在一个视频编辑任务的三组全新配对上将完整交付延迟降低30.0%；在留出任务上，演化策略相比最佳固定计划在一个随机种子下降低延迟8.2%，相比初始提案在另一随机种子下降低4.6%。

Conclusion: 运行时延迟排序的不确定性可通过在目标环境中执行测量并由执行反馈闭环优化框架策略来解决；DeltaHarness以冷启动测量+QHI循环+独立确认机制实现了可迁移、可验证的延迟改进，说明执行引导的框架自适应是提升工具使用智能体性能的有效途径。

Abstract: Tool-using agents rely on execution harnesses to organize and schedule tool operations. The same task and resource description can conceal runtime conditions that reverse the latency ordering of valid execution plans. Resolving this uncertainty requires firsthand execution in the target setting. We introduce DeltaHarness, an execution-guided policy-search method that adapts agent harnesses from cold-start measurements. Its QHI loop uses the observed response to update runtime dispatch, revise physical plans, and select experiments for later proposals. An independent confirmation panel controls policy replacement. With fixed dispatch, a revised materialization policy reduces complete-delivery latency by 30.0% on one video-editing task across three fresh pairs. On held-out tasks, the evolved policies reduce latency by 8.2% relative to the best fixed plan in one seed and by 4.6% relative to the initial proposal in another.

</details>


### [349] [AdaFlowLite: Scalable and Non-blocking Inference on Asynchronous Mobile Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21691)
*Sicong Liu,Fengmin Wu,Yuan Gao,Bin Guo,Zimu Zhou,Hongkai Wen,Zhiwen Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"机会式推理"（opportunistic inference）框架，通过分层分析构建结构化跨模态亲和度的归一化矩阵，并采用轻量级多模态Swin Transformer（MMLST）实现异步多模态数据的实时插补，从而在部分数据到达时即可推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动设备（LiDAR、摄像头等）多传感器分布式任务中，各模态数据到达时间不一，等待慢数据造成延迟，不等待则精度下降；现有方法虽关注模态一致性与互补性（modal affinity），但缺乏在开放、动态移动环境中对该亲和度进行"计算性"控制的手段。

Method: 以分层分析（hierarchical analysis）为基础构建归一化矩阵，形式化移动场景下的结构化跨模态亲和度，可泛化到不同模态类型与数量；结合多模态轻量级Swin Transformer（MMLST）进行实时、灵活的数据插补，无需重训练即可适配不同模态与下游任务。

Result: 推理延迟最高降低80.4%，精度最高提升62.1%，能耗降低近50%，优于现有方法；此外可提升LLM对异步数据预处理的性能。

Conclusion: 结构化跨模态亲和度的可计算化建模是应对异步多模态移动推理的有效途径，兼顾实时性、精度与能效，并可扩展至LLM预处理场景。

Abstract: The rise of mobile devices equipped with numerous sensors, such as LiDAR and cameras, has driven the adoption of multi-modal deep intelligence for distributed sensing tasks, such as smart cabins and driving assistance. However, the arrival time of mobile sensory data vary due to modality size and network dynamics, which can lead to delays (if waiting for slow data) or accuracy decline (if inference proceeds without waiting). Moreover, the diversity and dynamic nature of mobile systems exacerbate this challenge. In response, we present a shift to \textit{opportunistic} inference for asynchronous distributed multi-modal data, enabling inference as soon as partial data arrives. While existing methods focus on optimizing modality consistency and complementarity, known as modal affinity, they lack a \textit{computational} approach to control this affinity in open-world mobile environments. %
\sysname pioneers the formulation of structured cross-modality affinity in mobile contexts using a hierarchical analysis-based normalized matrix. This approach accommodates the diversity and dynamics of modalities, generalizing across different types and numbers of inputs. Employing an multi-modal lightweight Swin Transformer (MMLST), \sysname facilitates real-time and flexible data imputation, adapting to various modalities and downstream tasks without retraining. Experiments show that \sysname significantly reduces inference latency by up to 80.4\% and enhances accuracy by up to 62.1\%, while achieving nearly a 50\% reduction in energy consumption, outperforming status quo approaches. Also, this method can enhance LLM performance to preprocess asynchronous data.

</details>


### [350] [TIBECG: Temporal Information Bottleneck for Lead-Specific Demographic Privacy in ECG Waveform Release](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21694)
*Tsai-Min Chen,Jun Seita*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估架构型时间信息瓶颈 TIBECG 在十二导联 ECG 单导联上的隐私-效用权衡：它能在近乎保留诊断性能的同时显著削弱年龄/性别推断，但效果随导联而异，且不能替代临床部署验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传输 ECG 波形会在完成既定诊断任务之外泄露人口统计学信息（年龄、性别），需要一种在保护诊断效用的同时抑制此类推断的波形处理架构，并检验其在不同导联上的可推广性。

Method: 提出 TIBECG——一种带时间维度结构的信息瓶颈处理器（约 230 万参数），通过改变潜在表示长度、固定九项评分一致性目标来训练，保护器拟合时不使用年龄/性别标签。在 6,386 条十二导联记录、10 折交叉、12 个导联、21 种潜在长度上做回顾性评估，并以最佳合规传统变换（含直接降采样）为对照，同时考察选择稳定性与潜在 KL 散度与残余性别泄漏的关系。

Result: 各导联的回顾性选择均保留至少 95% 的干净 macro-F1；在年龄/性别区间增益（越弱越好）上优于所有导联的最佳合规传统变换，中位数领先 22.08 个百分点。直接降采样通常更能抑制人口统计推断，但诊断效用损失更大。选择稳定性因导联而异；固定长度下较低潜在 KL 散度不能可靠排序残余性别泄漏。

Conclusion: 结果支持对波形处理进行"逐导联"评估；尚不构成已验证的消费级部署或专家可读重建。当波形输入诊断分类器托管于专有云服务而非端侧部署时，波形传输不可避免，因此该隐私风险具有现实意义。

Abstract: Transmitting an electrocardiogram (ECG) waveform can expose demographic information beyond an intended diagnostic task. We evaluate TIBECG, an architectural temporal information bottleneck, on individual leads extracted from hospital twelve-lead recordings. A 2,302,337-parameter processor varies its latent length while retaining the same nine-score consistency objective, without age or sex labels in protector fitting. Across 6,386 recordings, ten folds, 12 leads and 21 lengths, retrospective selections retained at least 95% of each lead's clean macro-F1. Their weaker age/sex interval gain exceeded the best eligible conventional transformation on all leads, by a median 22.08 percentage points. The implemented sampling-rate comparison shows that direct downsampling usually suppresses demographic inference more strongly but at a larger loss of diagnostic utility, whereas TIBECG favors utility preservation. Selection stability also varies by lead. Lower latent Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence does not reliably rank residual sex leakage at a fixed length. These findings support lead-specific evaluation of waveform processing, not validated consumer deployment or expert-readable reconstruction. When the waveform-input diagnostic classifier is hosted as part of a proprietary cloud service rather than deployed on the device, waveform transmission is required to obtain its scores.

</details>


### [351] [Layerwise Learning-Rate Scaling in Vision Networks: Effective-Rate Identification, Power-Mean Aggregation, and Budget Dependence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21696)
*Chandini Vysyaraju,Raghuvir Duvvuri,Radu Timofte,Dmitry Ignatov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 逐层学习率策略的速率相关效应可由其乘子剖面直接计算的有效学习率刻画；该效应主要是优化进度效应，且仅在短训练预算下显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逐层学习率缩放（layerwise LR scaling）在预训练微调中已被确立，但在从头训练的视觉网络中，评估每种候选配方通常需逐一训练，成本高；作者希望找到一个无需训练即可预测层间学习率策略效果的标量指标，并厘清该效应是优化进度效应还是泛化效应。

Method: 提出"有效学习率"（effective learning rate）：由乘子剖面（multiplier profile）经参数加权幂平均直接计算，指数0.35（95% CI [0.20, 0.50]），并与算术平均比较。采用匹配对照实验（matched-control），跨6种架构考察测试精度变化与训练损失变化的相关性；将未调基学习率放大十倍进行检验；用该标量对候选策略排序而不训练；在长训练预算下评估与调优基线的实用性等价。

Result: 匹配对照下测试精度变化与训练损失变化高度相关（r = -0.996）；基学习率放大十倍使速率匹配对比在全部6种架构上上移（p = 0.016），并使某已发表的判别式调度（未参与模型拟合）优于均匀基线的架构数由2/6增至5/6（p = 0.031）。幂平均（α=0.35）解释架构内方差42.6%，优于算术平均的36.4%；仅用该标量排序可将候选平均百分位由第26提升至第10，与最优候选的平均精度差距由3.70降至1.12个百分点。速率效应随训练预算增大而衰减，2/3架构中整体策略效应落入预设实用性等价边界；分组相关对比在长预算下可能持续存在，但方向与幅度依架构而异。

Conclusion: 层间学习率策略的速率相关部分可压缩为单一有效学习率，其作用主要是短预算下的优化进度效应而非泛化收益；因此可用该标量零成本筛选候选策略，但长预算下其增益趋于消失，且分组相关成分需单独分析。

Abstract: Layerwise learning-rate scaling assigns different learning rates to different parts of a network. Although established in fine-tuning pretrained models, its effects in vision networks trained from scratch are commonly assessed by training each candidate recipe. We show that, in this setting, the rate-related component of a layerwise strategy is well summarized by an effective learning rate computable directly from its multiplier profile. Across matched-control comparisons, changes in test accuracy closely track changes in training loss (r = -0.996), which supports an optimization-progress explanation of the short-budget rate effect. Increasing the untuned base learning rate tenfold shifts the rate-matched contrast upward in all six tested architectures (p = 0.016) and increases the number of architectures in which a published discriminative schedule, excluded from model fitting, outperforms the uniform control from two to five of six (p = 0.031). Within the evaluated strategy space, a parameter-weighted power mean with exponent 0.35 (95% confidence interval [0.20, 0.50]) accounts for 42.6% of within-architecture variance, compared with 36.4% for the arithmetic mean. Ranking candidates by this scalar without training improves the selected candidate's mean percentile rank from the 26th to the 10th and reduces its mean accuracy shortfall relative to the best candidate from 3.70 to 1.12 points. The rate-related effect decays as the training budget increases; relative to tuned baselines, the overall strategy effect falls within the prespecified practical-equivalence margin in two of three architectures. A separate grouping-related contrast can persist at long budgets, although its direction and magnitude depend on the architecture.

</details>


### [352] [FACE: Flow-Guided Angular Channel Estimation Framework for mmWave MIMO Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21698)
*Samitha Gunarathne,Eslam Eldeeb,Nurul Huda Mahmood,Matti Latva-aho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出基于流匹配（flow matching）的流引导角度域信道估计框架FACE，利用毫米波MIMO信道的角域稀疏性并学习流匹配模型作为生成式信道先验，在多种配置下取得优于传统估计器与扩散模型估计器的精度，且导频更少、采样步数与推理开销更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 毫米波大规模MIMO的CSI获取受高维信道、导频观测受限与测量噪声制约，传统估计器与扩散式生成估计器在精度、导频效率或采样步数/计算开销上存在不足，需要更高效的信道先验建模方法。

Method: 提出FACE框架：挖掘毫米波信道的角域稀疏性，将基于流匹配的生成模型（学习概率分布间连续传输动力学）作为信道估计的生成式先验，用于角度域信道估计。

Result: 在多种信道与系统配置下，FACE的信道估计精度持续高于传统估计器及基于扩散模型的生成式估计器；在更少导频观测下仍保持高精度，平均可达速率接近完美CSI基准；相较扩散式估计，所需采样步数显著减少，精度相当或更优，降低推理时间与计算成本。

Conclusion: 流匹配在毫米波MIMO信道估计中具备实现高精度、高导频效率与高计算效率的潜力。

Abstract: Acquiring accurate channel state information (CSI) is essential for millimeter-wave (mmWave) multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems. However, it remains challenging due to high-dimensional channels, limited pilot observations, and measurement noise. To address these challenges, we propose flow-guided angular channel estimation (FACE), a novel channel estimation framework based on flow matching, an emerging generative modeling paradigm that learns continuous transport dynamics between probability distributions. FACE exploits the inherent angular-domain sparsity of mmWave channels and incorporates the learned flow matching model as a generative channel prior. Numerical results show that FACE consistently achieves higher channel estimation accuracy than both conventional estimators and diffusion-based generative estimator across diverse channel and system configurations. Moreover, FACE maintains high estimation accuracy with fewer pilot observations and achieves an average achievable rate close to the perfect-CSI benchmark. Compared with diffusion-based estimation, FACE requires substantially fewer sampling steps while achieving superior or comparable estimation accuracy, reducing inference time and computational cost. Overall, the proposed framework demonstrates the potential of flow matching for accurate, pilot-efficient, and computationally efficient mmWave MIMO channel estimation.

</details>


### [353] [Hybrid Quantum Selection of Learning Rates in Language-Model Training: Termination Criteria and an Interaction-Guided Schedule Oracle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21701)
*Wei-Che Hung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文在混合经典-量子训练框架下，用Durr-Hoyer最小查找与BBHT搜索进行分层组学习率选择，并提出交互引导调度预言机（IGSO）在叠加态中评分；在1.5B参数语言模型闭环微调中，所选调度与5个统一学习率种子的基准精度范围相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习率选择显著影响语言模型微调效果，但各层组之间的最佳联合学习率配置通常未知；作者希望探索量子搜索/最小查找能否在训练过程中支持自适应学习率选择。

Method: 将Durr-Hoyer最小查找与BBHT搜索结合，采用基于固定checkpoint上实测得分构建的查找预言机，比较固定预算与置信度停止策略；进一步提出交互引导调度预言机（IGSO）：用经典单步损失测量获得层组间主效应、成对及三元交互效应，电路对每个调度累加效应并与当前基线分数比较，将更优调度标记以供振幅放大，候选调度在经典侧复核后再接受。闭环中每个选中调度驱动后续200个经典训练步，初始基线为统一学习率训练。

Result: 在1.5B参数语言模型的闭环微调中，所选调度带来的基准准确率落在五个统一学习率随机种子所观测到的范围内。

Conclusion: 结果给出了量子叠加支持训练期间自适应学习率选择的一个可行示例，并讨论了仍存在的量子方面局限；以经典自适应方法产生的调度作为联合精炼基线留待未来工作。

Abstract: Learning-rate choices strongly affect language-model fine-tuning, but the best joint profile across layer groups is generally unknown. This paper studies quantum minimum finding for layer-group learning-rate selection within a hybrid classical-quantum training framework. It combines Durr-Hoyer minimum finding with BBHT search and compares fixed-budget and confidence-based stopping policies using a lookup oracle built from measured profile scores at fixed training checkpoints. The paper then introduces an Interaction-Guided Schedule Oracle that scores and marks joint schedules in superposition without a precomputed score table. Classical one-step loss measurements supply the main, pairwise and three-way interaction effects between layer groups. The circuit adds the effects for each schedule, compares the resulting score with the current baseline score, and marks improving schedules for amplitude amplification. Measured candidates are checked classically before acceptance. Uniform-rate training supplies the initial baseline; using schedules from classical adaptive methods as baselines for joint refinement is left for future work. In closed-loop fine-tuning of a 1.5-billion-parameter language model, each selected schedule drives the next 200 classical training steps. Benchmark accuracies lie within the range observed across five uniform-rate seeds. The results give a working example of how quantum superposition can support adaptive learning-rate selection during training; the remaining quantum limitations are discussed in the paper.

</details>


### [354] [Margin Dynamics for Large Language Model Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21766)
*Xingzi Xu,Mehmet Saygin Seyfioglu,Karim Bouyarmane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文为LLM对齐方法建立理论框架：每种成对方法在概率单纯形上定义向量场，投影到单一偏好对上得到一维margin ODE闭式解，据此预测DPO/IP0/SimPO的margin行为与噪声鲁棒性，并在5个模型族、4个基准上验证，进而设计出TPO-S。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践中选择LLM对齐方法主要靠试错，缺乏理论指导，无法预判不同损失（DPO、IPO、SimPO等）的margin动态、标签噪声敏感性与可训练性差异。

Method: 将每种成对对齐方法刻画为概率单纯形上的向量场，描述模型在偏好/非偏好补全间重新分配概率质量；投影到单个偏好对得到一维margin常微分方程并求闭式解；基于闭式解分析渐近margin、标签噪声下的相变及非对称加权下梯度集中对可训练性的影响；再由理论导出加入label smoothing的SimPO变体（TPO-S）。

Result: 理论预测：DPO的margin无界增长（梯度流极限下为O(log t)），IPO收敛到有限值1/(2τ)；标签噪声使DPO发生从无界到有界的定性相变，而仅对IPO产生定量影响；非对称加权下梯度集中决定大规模可训练性。三项预测在5个模型族、4个基准上均得到验证。进一步证明对SimPO加入任意ε>0的label smoothing可形成有限margin吸引子 Δ*=β⁻¹log((1-ε)/ε)，ε=0时无吸引子；在3个8B–9B模型上验证，TPO-S（ε=0.05）与最强基线具竞争力，在三个模型上均取得最高平均IFEval分数。

Conclusion: 闭式解框架能统一解释并预测成对对齐方法的margin动力学与噪声行为，并支持有原则的方法设计；所预测的有限吸引子是可用的工作点，而非追求新的SOTA损失。

Abstract: Practitioners choose among LLM alignment methods largely by trial and error. We provide a theoretical foundation: each pairwise method defines a vector field on the probability simplex that governs how the model redistributes mass between preferred and dispreferred completions. Projecting onto a single preferred/dispreferred pair reduces this to a one-dimensional margin ODE with a closed-form solution. These solutions reveal that DPO margins grow without bound (logarithmically as $O(\log t)$ in the gradient-flow limit) while IPO margins converge to a finite $1/(2τ)$; that label noise induces a qualitative phase transition in DPO (unbounded $\to$ bounded) but affects IPO only quantitatively; and that gradient concentration under asymmetric weighting governs trainability at scale. We confirm all three predictions across five model families spanning four benchmarks. The closed-form solutions also enable principled method design: we prove that adding any label smoothing $\varepsilon > 0$ to SimPO creates a finite margin attractor at $Δ^* = β^{-1}\log((1-\varepsilon)/\varepsilon)$, while $\varepsilon = 0$ (standard SimPO) has no attractor. We test this across three models (8B-9B) and confirm the prediction: the theory-derived configuration (TPO-S, $\varepsilon = 0.05$) is competitive with the strongest baselines, attaining the highest mean IFEval score among the compared methods on all three, validating that the predicted finite attractor is a usable operating point rather than proposing a new state-of-the-art loss.

</details>


### [355] [Learning Calibrated and Samplable Predictive Distributions of Surface-Ocean $Δp$CO$_2$ Using Tabular Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21769)
*Gabriele Accarino,Mohammad M. Amirian,Thea H. Heimdal,Amanda R. Fay,Galen A. McKinley,Viviana Acquaviva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用条件扩散模型 Treeffuser（以梯度提升树作为得分函数）学习海洋表面 ΔpCO₂ 的条件预测分布，在 SOCAT 留出测试集上获得最优 CRPS（8.229 μatm）与最接近名义水平的区间覆盖率（0.686/0.930），点预测精度与 XGBoost 基线接近（RMSE 18.4 vs. 17.7）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海洋吸收约 30% 的人为 CO₂ 排放，量化该碳汇需估计海表 CO₂，但观测在时空上稀疏。现有机器学习估计多为确定性方法，每格点只给单一值，不确定性通过残差、集成或预设分布事后近似，缺乏良好校准的观测级不确定性。

Method: 采用 Treeffuser——以梯度提升树作为得分函数（score function）的条件扩散模型——基于 13 个环境、空间与时间预测变量，为每个观测学习 ΔpCO₂（海气 pCO₂ 差）的完整条件预测分布（生成式建模）。在 SOCAT 留出测试集上，与多种不确定性量化方法及确定性 XGBoost 基线进行对比评估。

Result: Treeffuser 在所评估的不确定性量化方法中获得最低 CRPS（8.229 μatm），覆盖率最接近名义 68%/95% 水平（0.686/0.930）；点预测能力与确定性 XGBoost 基线相当（RMSE 18.4 vs. 17.7 μatm，R² 0.77 vs. 0.79）。

Conclusion: 条件扩散模型可在基本保持点预测能力的同时提供校准良好的观测级不确定性，其生成样本支持 ΔpCO₂ 的概率分析；但实现空间连贯的场重建仍需建模格点间依赖性，并在空间留出数据上评估。

Abstract: The ocean absorbs almost 30% of anthropogenic CO$_2$ emissions, but quantifying this sink requires estimating surface-ocean CO$_2$ from observations that are sparse in space and time. Most existing machine-learning estimates of this field are deterministic, giving a single value per grid point, with uncertainty approximated post hoc via residuals, ensembles, or prescribed distributions. We instead learn a conditional predictive distribution for each observation: using Treeffuser, a conditional diffusion model with gradient-boosted-tree score functions, we estimate the full predictive distribution of $Δp$CO$_2$ (the sea-air $p$CO$_2$ difference) from 13 environmental, spatial, and temporal predictors. On a held-out SOCAT test set, Treeffuser attains the lowest continuous ranked probability score among the uncertainty-quantification methods evaluated (8.229 $μ$atm) and the coverage closest to the nominal 68% / 95% levels (0.686 / 0.930), while retaining point-prediction skill comparable to a deterministic XGBoost baseline (RMSE 18.4 vs. 17.7 $μ$atm; $R^2$ 0.77 vs. 0.79). These results show that conditional diffusion can provide well-calibrated, observation-level uncertainties while largely preserving point-prediction skill. Because Treeffuser is generative, its samples can support probabilistic analyses of $Δp$CO$_2$; extending this to spatially coherent field reconstruction will require modeling dependence across grid cells and evaluation on spatially held-out data.

</details>


### [356] [Regularized Score Centering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21791)
*Hao Bai,Chenlu Ye,Xuanchang Zhang,Aviral Kumar,Tong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Regularized Score Centering (RSC)，在score centering基础上加入反向KL惩罚约束学习策略与行为策略的next-token分布距离，理论证明其改善收敛性，并在六个agentic任务上取得最优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步强化学习提升训练吞吐，但过时策略产生的数据与训练/推理间的数值不匹配会导致学习不稳定。Score centering (SC)通过去除奖励基线对期望更新的影响来稳定off-policy学习，梯度诊断显示其比importance sampling (IS)梯度更温和；但当学习器远离生成数据的行为策略时，SC仍会失效。因此需要限制策略不匹配。

Method: 在SC中引入反向Kullback-Leibler (KL)惩罚，鼓励学习器的next-token分布贴近行为策略的next-token分布，构成RSC；该方法可与truncated importance sampling (TIS，对token重要性权重设上限) 组合使用或单独使用。同时给出理论分析，证明KL正则化可改善收敛性保证。

Result: 在dense模型与mixture-of-experts模型上，针对数学推理及agentic任务（在线购物、工具使用、游戏、全异步软件工程）进行评估：RSC+TIS在全部agentic基准上显著提升样本效率，在相同采样响应数下获得更高训练奖励；最终评估在全部六个agentic任务上取得最佳性能，AppWorld提升14.3%，BabyAI达到最强基线的9.9倍。

Conclusion: 反向KL正则化的得分中心化（RSC）能有效缓解异步/off-policy RL中的策略不匹配问题，兼具理论收敛性保证与实证上的样本效率与最终性能优势，且与TIS兼容，适用于大规模agentic训练场景。

Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, including online shopping, tool use, games, and fully asynchronous software engineering. RSC with TIS substantially improves sample efficiency across all agentic benchmarks, attaining higher training rewards with the same number of sampled responses. In final evaluations, it achieves top performance across all six agentic tasks, improving by 14.3% on AppWorld and reaching 9.9 times the strongest baseline's score on BabyAI.

</details>


### [357] [Urban Representation Learning for Identifying Potential Disparities in Crime Reporting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21825)
*Jorge Valverde-Rebaza,Carlos Paez De La Cruz,Pedro Pérez-Collado,Daniel Sánchez-Cataño,Eashley Martínez-Vergara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于自监督城市表征学习的“邻域画像差异”(NPD)指标，仅用地理编码犯罪记录识别异常上报模式，用于内部审计与优先级排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公开犯罪数据只反映已报告事件而非犯罪活动全貌，可能在下游空间分析中引入空间失真，需要一种无需外部真值即可识别上报模式异常区域的方法。

Method: 构建小时、周、静态三类互补上报画像；在地理自监督下学习尺度特定表征并融合为统一隐空间；检索表征相似的对等区域，用NPD量化各区域上报画像与其对等区域的差异。

Result: 墨西哥城180万+条犯罪记录聚合为1058个H3区域：平均轮廓系数0.4052（Hex2Vec为0.2863）；NPD排序在不同邻域规模下Spearman相关0.9720–0.9951，高差异候选大多稳定；检索到的对等区域显著超出邻近地理范围；高差异区域呈空间组织化模式，部分区域相对对等期望存在案件量差异。

Conclusion: NPD可作为识别需进一步调查区域的内部审计与优先级排序机制，但不能作为漏报的直接证据。

Abstract: Open crime data support urban safety analysis but reflect reported incidents rather than the complete distribution of criminal activity, potentially introducing spatial distortions in downstream analysis. We propose a self-supervised urban representation learning framework for identifying unusual reporting patterns relative to representation-similar peers using only georeferenced crime records. The method constructs complementary hourly, weekly, and static reporting profiles, learns scale-specific representations under geographic self-supervision, and integrates them into a unified latent space. Neighbor Profile Divergence (NPD) is then used to quantify disagreement between each region's reporting profile and those of its retrieved peers. Experiments on more than 1.8 million crime records from Mexico City, aggregated into 1,058 H3 regions, show that the proposed representation achieves a mean Silhouette score of 0.4052, compared with 0.2863 for Hex2Vec. NPD rankings remain highly stable across neighborhood sizes, with Spearman correlations from 0.9720 to 0.9951, while most high-divergence candidates persist across configurations. The retrieved peers also extend substantially beyond immediate geographic neighborhoods, indicating that the learned representation captures structure beyond local spatial proximity. High-divergence regions exhibit spatially organized patterns and, in several cases, differences in incident volume relative to peer expectations. These results support NPD as an internal auditing and prioritization mechanism for identifying regions that warrant further investigation, rather than as direct evidence of underreporting.

</details>


### [358] [VisHead-Spec: Head-Routed Visual Attention for Multimodal Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21839)
*Xin Guo,Arushi Rai,Xiang Zhou,Qiang Zhang,Siyu Lin,Xiangjun Fan,Lizhu Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出VisHead-Spec：仅让草稿模型中少量固定KV头关注目标模型顶层视觉特征，其余头仅处理文本，从而在保持接受长度几乎不变的前提下提升高并发下VLM投机解码吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码虽能保持目标模型输出不变地加速VLM，但在高并发服务下随batch size增大系统趋于算力受限，加速比明显衰减；多模态场景中图像token序列很长，进一步抬高草稿预测开销。块扩散草稿器（DFlash、DSpark）虽一次前向预测多token，但在高并发下对VLM的加速仍不足9%。作者旨在解释这一差距。

Method: 通过分析目标模型到草稿模型跨模态的信息流，发现视觉注意力稀疏性：草稿模型中仅少量KV头需直接关注上下文中的视觉特征；且仅需关注目标模型顶层（top level layers）的视觉特征。据此设计VisHead-Spec：选取一小撮固定KV头关注目标模型顶层的全部图像特征，其余头限制为仅处理文本特征。在Qwen3-VL-8B与MMSpec上实现VisHead-Spec-8，使草稿器40个KV头中的8个读取图像。

Result: VisHead-Spec-8的接受长度与块扩散草稿基线（DSpark）相差在0.3%以内；batch size为64时相对自回归解码的吞吐增益达16.0%，而DSpark为9.5%；batch size为1时加速比与DSpark相当。

Conclusion: 利用跨模态注意力稀疏性有选择地路由视觉信息，可在几乎不损失草稿接受率的情况下显著改善高并发多模态投机解码的吞吐，且不牺牲单请求低并发场景的加速效果。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models(VLMs) while preserving the target model's outputs, but its speedup diminishes under high concurrency serving as the system becomes more compute bounded as the batch size increases. This problem is pronounced for multimodal speculative decoding as the long range of the image tokens in the prompt can significantly increase the computational cost during draft token prediction. The block-diffusion drafters (e.g. DFlash, DSpark) can effectively speed up the draft model efficiency by predicting multiple draft tokens in one forward pass, but their speedup for VLMs under high concurrency is still modest (<9%). In order to understand this gap, we examine the information flow between different modalities from target model to draft model and identify the sparsity pattern of visual attention between the target and draft models: only small set of key-value heads in the draft model need direct visual feature attention in the context and only visual features from top level layers in the target model need to be attended in the context. We therefore propose VisHead-Spec, which selects a small, fixed set of key-value (KV) heads to attend to all image features from top level layers in the target model and restricts the remaining heads to text features. On Qwen3-VL-8B and MMSpec, VisHead-Spec-8 lets 8 of the drafter's 40 KV heads read the image while keeping accepted length within 0.3% of the block-diffusion draft model baseline (i.e. DSpark). At batch size 64, its throughput gain over autoregressive decoding increases to 16.0%, compared with 9.5% for DSpark; at batch size 1, its speedup remains comparable to DSpark.

</details>


### [359] [Inventa: Decentralized Self-Improving Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21847)
*Prithwish Jana,Nikos Kanakaris,Purak Jain,Anoop Deoras,Sahika Genc*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Inventa 提出以"自治研究单元 + 经核验的共享知识"为核心的自动科学发现框架，通过局部编排器的自适应调度与验证器过滤，抑制多智能体系统的同质化收敛与错误传播，在五个覆盖科研全周期的基准上均取得最优，且模型调用显著减少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体 LLM 科研系统存在"规模不增效"问题：增加智能体数量或迭代次数并不必然带来更多样、更可行的想法。具体表现为（1）候选想法同质化收敛；（2）经由共享记忆组件传播缺乏支撑的断言；（3）反复使用已无增益的搜索策略。因此需要从机制上约束知识流动与搜索策略的自适应性。

Method: Inventa 由三部分组成：（1）自治研究单元（autonomous research unit）：以 mutator agent 维护一条候选想法的演化谱系（lineage）；（2）局部编排器（local orchestrator）：周期性调整 mutator 的 harness（执行/提示框架），当进展停滞时替换其所用模型或重启想法演化过程；（3）验证器（verifiers）：对每个候选想法进行评估，将经验证的改进、可用组件与约束违反记录至共享知识库——该知识库是单元之间唯一的通信通道，从而阻断未核验信息的扩散。

Result: 在覆盖科研全周期的五个基准（检索 ScholarCatalyst、构思 IdeaBench、提案撰写 IdeaScientist、科学定律发现 EurekaBench 与 SciLaws-Bench）上全部领先。EurekaBench 上达 73.6%，CORAL 为 56.2%；IdeaBench 上每篇论文发现 26.0 个新颖想法，ResearchAgent 为 18.6 个，同时模型调用减少 82%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，科学发现智能体的效能提升关键不在于扩大规模，而在于架构层面的设计：以验证器把关的共享知识作为受限通信通道、以编排器实现搜索策略的动态自适应，可在提升想法新颖性与可行性的同时大幅降低推理成本。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can generate research ideas and improve scientific discovery through iterative experimentation. However, increasing the number of agents or iterations does not automatically translate to producing more diverse or feasible ideas. Agents may converge on similar candidates, propagate unsupported claims through shared memory components and repeatedly apply search strategies that no longer yield any improvements.
  We introduce Inventa, a framework for automated scientific discovery that employs autonomous research units and verified shared knowledge. Each unit creates a lineage of candidate ideas using a mutator agent. A local orchestrator agent periodically adapts the mutator's harness. When progress stalls, the orchestrator agent replaces its model or restarts the idea evolution process. Verifiers evaluate each candidate idea and record verified improvements, useful components and constraint violations in a shared knowledge, the only channel between units. We evaluate Inventa on five benchmarks spanning the research cycle, covering retrieval (ScholarCatalyst), ideation (IdeaBench), proposal writing (IdeaScientist), and scientific law discovery (EurekaBench, SciLaws-Bench). It leads all five, achieving 73.6% on EurekaBench versus 56.2% for CORAL. On IdeaBench, it discovers 26.0 novel ideas per paper, compared with 18.6 for ResearchAgent, with 82% fewer model calls.

</details>


### [360] [When Does Discrete Ricci Curvature Help? An Edge-Level Analysis of Curvature-Enhanced GCNs for PPI Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21849)
*Clara Joswig,Elham Gholamzadeh,Ghazal Mostofi,Nico Scherf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过边级别分析质疑CGCN缓解"过挤压"的主流解释，提出曲率加权实为"簇间锐化"机制，并给出选用建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CGCN将基于最优传输的Ollivier-Ricci曲率嵌入消息传递，声称曲率加权边可缓解结构瓶颈处的过挤压，但该因果解释缺乏边级证据检验。作者要验证CGCN的性能提升是否真的来自过挤压缓解。

Method: 在四个真实PPI数据集上比较CGCN与标准GCN：不做聚合指标比较，而是逐边分析性能；直接考察学习到的边权函数；结合聚类有效性指标、边距离比及四种层深消融；并用拓扑定义的社区（而非分类标签）检验替代解释。

Result: CGCN在四个数据集上均提升聚合AUC、AUPR与F1，但增益几乎集中于低度边；而低曲率（瓶颈）边上的性能在四个数据集中的三个系统性下降，与过挤压动机的预测相反。证据支持替代解释：曲率加权锐化了簇间分离度，提升簇内预测但牺牲簇间（瓶颈）预测。

Conclusion: CGCN的收益并非源于缓解过挤压，而是簇分离锐化导致的簇内偏好。作者据此提供实践指导：当任务更看重簇内预测时优先选CGCN，若瓶颈/跨簇预测更重要则选用标准GCN。

Abstract: Curvature-enhanced graph convolutional networks (CGCN) incorporate Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC), grounded in optimal transport theory, into message passing, motivated by the claim that curvature-weighted edges alleviate "over-squashing" at structural bottlenecks. But does CGCN's improvement actually come from mitigating over-squashing? We investigate this on four real-world protein-protein interaction (PPI) datasets, comparing CGCN against a standard GCN at the level of individual edges rather than aggregate metrics alone. While CGCN improves aggregate AUC, AUPR, and F1 across all four datasets, this gain is concentrated almost entirely on low-degree edges, while performance on low-curvature (bottleneck) edges systematically degrades in three of four datasets, the opposite of what the over-squashing motivation predicts. Examining the learned edge-weight function directly, together with clustering-validity metrics, edge-distance ratios, and a layer-depth ablation across four depths, we find evidence for an alternative account: curvature-weighting sharpens the separation between clusters, which improves intra-cluster predictions at the cost of inter-cluster (bottleneck) ones. We test this account against topologically defined communities rather than the classification labels used elsewhere. Additionally, we offer practical guidance on when to prefer CGCN over standard GCN, depending on whether intra- or inter-cluster predictions matter most.

</details>


### [361] [The Hidden Cost of MoE Diffusion Decoding: Profiling and Fixing the Sampler](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21852)
*Harshit Samrat,Ramakrishna Paramahamsa Kompella*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在带宽受限的边缘加速器上，掩码扩散语言模型（dLLM）解码的最主要耗时并非专家 GEMM，而是覆盖整个画布×词表 logits 张量的采样与停止流水线；该流水线可无损去除/融合，配合 W4A16 专家核实现 2.4–2.7× 端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: dLLM 每次前向都要对完整 token 画布逐位置做采样与停止判断，处理量与位置数×词表规模成正比；相比自回归解码（每个提交 token 只访问一个位置的 logits），扩散解码需处理 S 倍（S 为去噪步数）的 logit 条目。作者在量化后发现该 logits 流水线成为解码最大瓶颈，而这一现象容易被忽视。

Method: 在 NVIDIA GB10（273 GB/s，带宽受限）上对 26B 参数扩散 MoE 单用户解码进行性能剖析；证明该流水线高度冗余且可融合，并按两级无损方式移除：①比特精确层，输出与参考解码器逐字节一致；②精度对齐层，采用融合单遍熵核与 Gumbel-max 采样。再与 W4A16 专家核组合成完整栈。

Result: 完整方案在 GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH 上保持基准精度不变，端到端相对 bf16 提速 2.4–2.7×。在独立构建的第二个扩散 MoE（LLaDA2.0-mini）上复现：流水线占解码 28.8%，融合 W4A16 精度对齐下提速 3.3×；该现象在稠密扩散模型中消失（仅占 3.6%）。代码与量化权重已开源。

Conclusion: 该开销是 MoE 扩散模型特有的：量化使骨干网络变廉价后，logits 采样/停止流水线才凸显为主导瓶颈；对稠密扩散模型不成立。因此针对 dLLM-MoE 的推理优化应把该流水线作为首要优化目标。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) decode by iteratively denoising a full canvas of tokens, so every forward pass runs a per-token sampling and stopping pipeline over the entire canvas-by-vocabulary logits tensor. We profile single-user decoding of a 26B-parameter diffusion Mixture-of-Experts model on a bandwidth-bound edge accelerator (NVIDIA GB10) and report a result that is easy to miss: after weight quantisation, this logits pipeline, not the expert GEMMs, is the single largest consumer of decode time. Unlike autoregressive decoding, where sampling touches one position's logits per committed token, diffusion decoding processes S times as many logit entries per output token, where S is the number of denoising steps. We show this pipeline is largely redundant or fusable and remove it in two lossless tiers: a bit-exact tier whose output is byte-identical to the reference decoder, and an accuracy-parity tier using a fused single-pass entropy kernel and Gumbel-max sampling. Combined with a W4A16 expert kernel, the full stack reaches 2.4-2.7 times end-to-end speedup over bf16 at unchanged benchmark accuracy on GSM8K, HumanEval, and MATH, on a single 273 GB/s device. We confirm the finding on a second, independently built diffusion MoE (LLaDA2.0-mini: pipeline 28.8% of decode, fused W4A16 3.3 times at accuracy parity) and show it disappears on a dense diffusion model (3.6%). The cost is specific to MoE diffusion, where quantisation makes the backbone cheap. Code and quantised weights are released.

</details>


### [362] [tmol: a GPU-accelerated implementation of the Rosetta energy function for machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21857)
*Andrew Leaver-Fay,Kieran Didi,Jeff Flatten,Alex Ford,Guangfeng Zhou,Nathaniel Corley,Hahnbeom Park,Maxwell W. Kazman,Rafael I. Brent,Joseph Kleinhenz,Henry Solberg,Andrew M. Watkins,Brian Kuhlman,David Baker,Frank DiMaio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: tmol：GPU原生的PyTorch库，实现RosettaGenFF力场，支持高效批量可微打分与整体结构精修，批量吞吐最高提升362倍，可作为生成式蛋白设计的奖励函数提升界面氢键与水桥。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理启发的力场相比生成式机器学习模型在训练分布外泛化性更好，但其计算慢、导数难以集成进机器学习框架，限制了其在生成式设计中的使用。

Method: 提出tmol，一个GPU原生的PyTorch库，完整实现最先进的RosettaGenFF力场，提供高效的批量（batched）可微打分，并支持全结构精修（whole-structure refinement）。

Result: 批量模式下吞吐量最高提升362倍；将其作为生成式蛋白设计的奖励函数后，设计界面处的氢键与水桥数量增加。

Conclusion: tmol弥合了物理力场与深度学习框架之间的鸿沟，使快速、可微、可批量的能量评估成为可能，并能有效改善生成式蛋白设计的界面质量。

Abstract: Physics-inspired forcefields complement generative machine learning models, showing better generalization beyond the training distribution. However, these forcefields are typically slow to evaluate, and their derivatives are difficult to integrate into ML frameworks. We introduce tmol, a GPU-native PyTorch library implementing the state-of-the-art RosettaGenFF forcefield. tmol supports efficient batched differentiable scoring and whole-structure refinement with up to 362-fold throughput increase (batched). Used as a reward in generative protein design, tmol increases hydrogen bonds and water bridges at designed interfaces.

</details>


### [363] [PromptPack: Training-Free Augmentation of Diffusion Editors for Intent-Aligned Spatial and Semantic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21865)
*Sophia Zalewski,Mustafa Munir,Enting Liu,Anjul Patney,David Dynerman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PromptPack 提出一种免训练的图像编辑接口，通过"编辑角色分区"与"区域-提示词分配"两类显式 Edit Guides，对扩散编辑器施加注意力掩码、流更新门控与源像素回填，在 FlowEdit FLUX、FlowEdit SD3 与 FLUX Kontext 上提升编辑概念落位准确性与受保护内容保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有两类编辑范式存在缺陷：指令驱动编辑（如 Kontext 类）对"编辑施加在何处、哪个概念作用于哪个区域"的用户意图表述不足；inpainting 类编辑器虽显式给定编辑支撑区域，却缺少对多个编辑概念的空间指派。二者都难以同时实现"改动限定在目标区域"与"精确保留指定源内容"。

Method: 引入两种显式编辑引导：(1) 编辑角色分区（Edit-Role Partition），将每个像素标注为 Keep / Permit / Modify，规定编辑可发生的空间范围；(2) 区域提示词分配（Regional-Prompt Assignment），将空间区域映射到文本提示词，规定概念作用范围。引导可人工指定，也可对源物体编辑由文本落地的 SAM 3 掩码自动导出。方法不改动模型权重，将各区域独立嵌入的提示词注入编辑器固定长度的文本序列，并利用 Edit Guides 进行注意力空间掩码、流（flow）更新门控以及受保护源像素的恢复。

Result: 在 PIE-Bench++ 上，于 FlowEdit FLUX、FlowEdit SD3、FLUX Kontext 三种集成配置中均观察到所请求概念的放置更准确、受保护内容保持更好；成对用户研究中相对 FlowEdit FLUX 获得 87% 的偏好率。

Conclusion: PromptPack 是一种免训练、即插即用的扩散编辑界面，可将模糊的用户编辑意图显式化为可控制的空间-语义约束，在多种主流编辑器上通用有效，具备实用价值。

Abstract: Many image-editing tasks require confining changes to intended spatial regions while exactly preserving user-designated source content. Instruction-driven editing pipelines often leave such user-intent underspecified, while inpainting editors condition generation on explicitly defined edit support but not on the spatial assignment of individual edit concepts. PromptPack addresses both limitations by equipping diffusion editors with two explicit 'Edit Guides': an edit-role partition that labels each pixel as 'Keep,' 'Permit,' or 'Modify' to specify where edits may occur, and a regional-prompt assignment that maps spatial regions to text prompts to specify which concepts apply where. These guides may be manually specified or, for source-object edits, automatically derived from a text-grounded SAM 3 mask. Without retraining, PromptPack injects independently embedded regional prompts into the editor's fixed-length text sequence and uses the Edit Guides to spatially mask attention, gate flow updates, and restore protected source pixels. We integrate PromptPack into FlowEdit FLUX, FlowEdit SD3, and FLUX Kontext and demonstrate improved requested-concept placement and protected-content preservation across all three integrations on PIE-Bench++. In a pairwise user study, PromptPack achieves an 87% preference rate over FlowEdit FLUX, establishing PromptPack as a practical, training-free interface for intent-aligned diffusion editing.

</details>


### [364] [Adaptive Memory for Online Reinforcement Learning under Sparse Model Changes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21879)
*Sreejeet Maity,Sukanya Modak,Leonardo F. Toso*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究部署间环境（奖励与转移核最多ε比例条目变化）变化的折扣强化学习，提出按状态-动作对自适应选择历史复用长度的估计算法，仅需最近O(1/ε)次部署观测即达长期平均次优间隙Õ(√(ε/H))。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多部署场景下环境在部署间发生稀疏（ε比例条目）变化：从零学习会丢弃有用历史数据，而池化全部历史又会污染已变化条目的估计，需要一种在偏差与方差间权衡的历史复用策略。

Method: 对每个状态-动作对，从当前部署观测开始、按由近及远顺序逐个加入历史部署观测；每次加入后用"单一平均奖励是否与迄今所有历史估计一致"的一致性检验判断奖励，并对下一状态分布做同样检验；取通过检验的最后一段历史长度作为该条目估计所用的数据量，在拟合的MDP上求解最优控制策略。

Result: 刻画了有限次部署上最优回报与学习策略回报的平均间隙；证明当0<|S|ε≤2时，算法只需最近O(1/ε)次部署的观测，长期平均间隙不超过Õ(√(ε/H))。

Conclusion: 基于逐条目一致性检验的自适应历史窗口可在稀疏变化的非平稳环境中实现近最优的长期平均性能，且所需历史窗口长度与变化比例成反比、与总历史长度无关，说明该方法有效平衡了历史数据复用与偏差控制。

Abstract: We study the discounted reinforcement learning (RL) problem in a setting where the underlying environment changes between deployments. Each deployment provides $H$ observations from a fixed MDP. The reward function and transition kernel are fixed within each deployment. Across deployments, at most an $ε>0$ fraction of the reward and transition kernel entries may change. In this setting, learning each model to deploy from scratch may discard useful observations from past deployments, whereas pooling all past observations can bias the estimates of entries that have already changed. We then propose an algorithm that for each state and action pair, selects how much history to reuse to estimate the reward and probabilities of the next state. We start with observations from the current deployment and add earlier deployment observations one at a time, the most recent first. After each addition, we check whether a single average reward agrees with the estimates from all histories considered until that point. We apply the same check to the distribution of next states. For each estimate, we leverage the last history that passes these aforementioned checks. The optimal control policy is then computed on top of the fitted MDP. We characterize the average gap between the optimal return and the return of the learner's policies over a finite number of deployments. We demonstrate that when $0< |S|ε\leq 2$, with $|S|$ being the cardinality of the state space, our algorithm needs only the observations from the most recent $O(1/ε)$ deployments, and achieves a long-run average gap of at most $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{ε/H})$.

</details>


### [365] [Cancellation-Free Constrained SquareCB for Safe Controller Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21880)
*Kartik Pandit,Sourav Ganguly,Arnob Ghosh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出对成本施加"整流权重"的SquareCB算法，实现无对消（cancellation-free）的约束违反上界，并在四旋翼与建筑控制任务中将违反量降低6–9倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将约束上下文赌博机归结为在线回归的方法，用从历史约束残差中学得的拉格朗日乘子对成本加权，导致某些轮的松弛会抵消另一些轮的违反，逐轮违反量无法得到独立控制；且需处理逐上下文（可能对抗选择）满足预算的更严格设定。

Method: 直接运行SquareCB（Foster & Rakhlin 2020），对成本使用整流权重：当估计成本在预算内时权重为0，否则取恰好足以使成本回到预算的最小值；在可实现性假设与间隙为δ的Slater条件下给出遗憾与逐轮违反的分析；理论框架同样覆盖每个上下文都必须满足预算（可能对抗选取上下文）的设定。

Result: 遗憾界为 O(√(KT·Reg_Sq(T))/δ)，无对消违反上界为 Σ_t (V_c^{p_t} − b)^+ = O(√(KT·Reg_Sq(T)))，其中 Reg_Sq 为回归oracle的误差；在 safe-control-gym 四旋翼与 BOPTEST 建筑的控制器选择实验中，违反量比原始-对偶和虚拟队列基线低6至9倍，遗憾更低或相当。

Conclusion: 整流权重避免了残差跨轮抵消，使约束违反获得与遗憾同阶的保证，并可直接扩展到逐上下文的硬约束场景；实验验证了该思路实用且优于主流基线。

Abstract: We study constrained contextual bandits, in which a learner chooses one of $K$ actions in each round to minimize loss while keeping the expected cost of its play below a budget. Existing reductions to online regression weight the cost by a Lagrange multiplier learned from past constraint residuals, so slack in some rounds can offset violations in others. We instead run SquareCB proposed in \citep{foster2020beyond} with a rectified weight on the cost: it is zero when the estimated cost is within the budget, and otherwise just large enough to bring it back to the budget. Under realizability and Slater's condition with margin $δ$, the algorithm attains regret $O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)}/δ)$ and cancellation-free violation $\sum_t(V_c^{p_t}-b)^+=O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)})$, where $\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}$ is the error of the regression oracle. The same bounds hold when the budget must be met in every context, potentially adversarially chosen contexts. In controller selection for a safe-control-gym quadrotor and a BOPTEST building, the violation is 6 to 9 times lower than that of primal-dual and virtual-queue baselines, with a lower or comparable regret.

</details>


### [366] [WM-Quant: Rollout-Aware Post-Training Quantization for JEPA-Style World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21882)
*William Hammer,Andrew Heuer,Nikhil Krishna,Matthew Grenier,Ramtin Zand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 WM-Quant，首个面向 JEPA 风格世界模型的训练后量化（PTQ）框架，通过早编码器精度、控制通路保持与 rollout 感知缩放三大组件，抑制自回归 MPC 滚动中的量化误差累积，在 W4A4 低比特下接近全精度规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型参数量虽少，但动作规划算法往往需要上千次推理，计算开销大，PTQ 是自然的降本手段。然而在基于自回归模型预测控制（MPC）rollout 的世界模型中，量化误差会随预测步逐步累积，导致量化模型给出的动作排序近似随机，直接失效。

Method: 在既有 PTQ 方法基础上叠加三个组件：(1) 早编码器精度（early-encoder precision）：保护潜状态与目标信息的精度，缓解长期误差传播；(2) 控制通路保持（control-path preservation）：使世界模型预测器能区分细粒度动作，改善动作排序；(3) rollout 感知缩放（rollout-aware scaling）：以整段 rollout 而非单步预测为目标，联合校准编码器与逐步预测器的激活范围。

Result: 在多个世界模型、环境与 PTQ 方法上，WM-Quant 在低比特宽度下显著提升规划成功率，W4A4 时性能接近全精度。

Conclusion: 针对世界模型规划场景的量化不能沿用单步预测的常规 PTQ 准则，需围绕 rollout 的误差传播与动作区分度进行专门设计；WM-Quant 验证了该思路的有效性，使低比特世界模型具备可用的规划能力。

Abstract: We present WM-Quant, to our knowledge, the first post-training quantization (PTQ) framework designed specifically for JEPA-style world models. Although world models typically feature relatively few parameters, action planning algorithms often require thousands of inferences, which can quickly become computationally expensive. PTQ is a natural way to reduce this cost. However, we show that in world models using autoregressive model predictive control (MPC) rollouts, quantization error can compound with each predictor step, resulting in action rankings from the quantized model becoming near-random. WM-Quant addresses this with three components that build on existing PTQ methods: early-encoder precision, control-path preservation, and rollout-aware scaling. Early-encoder precision protects accurate latent state and goal information to mitigate long-term error propagation. Control-path preservation allows the world model predictor to distinguish between fine-grained actions, significantly improving action rankings and execution. Rollout-aware scaling jointly calibrates encoder and per-step predictor activation ranges with respect to an entire rollout rather than a single prediction, reducing the cumulative rollout error. Across multiple world models, environments, and PTQ methods, WM-Quant substantially improves planning success at low bit-widths, approaching full-precision performance at W4A4.

</details>


### [367] [World-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Pollution-Aware Bird Movement Modeling Using a Multi-Instance DQN Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21895)
*Shivin Mangal,Divyansh Chawla,Anshu Garg,Isshaan Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文构建“以世界反馈为奖励”的多实例强化学习仿真：在印度2D网格上，用预计算AQI矩阵作为环境反馈信号，智能体（鸟类）在污染约束下学习自适应导航策略，并与蒙特卡洛、Q-Learning、值迭代对比，DQN表现最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习多依赖人工偏好或合成奖励，缺乏与真实生态后果的耦合。作者希望以可测量的环境指标（AQI）替代人工奖励，使策略学习直接建立在生态影响之上，从而为生态决策建模提供可扩展基础。

Method: 将鸟建模为环境敏感智能体，在印度2D网格（含地理州界）上导航；融合Xeno-canto鸟类鸣声元数据、空间离散化与真实环境数据构建仿真环境。用预计算AQI矩阵替代实时API查询以提升训练与执行效率。设计多实例RL框架，以环境结果（AQI）作为主要训练信号，并与Monte Carlo、Q-Learning、Value Iteration等基线和DQN进行对比评估。

Result: 在多种环境条件下，DQN相比MC、Q-Learning与Value Iteration表现出更强的稳定性、自适应性与累计性能优势。

Conclusion: 以世界反馈（真实环境指标）驱动的强化学习可有效支撑生态决策建模，预计算AQI映射兼顾真实性与可扩展性，DQN为其中较优的策略学习方法，可推广至更广泛的“环境反馈驱动”决策场景。

Abstract: Birds are modeled as environmentally sensitive agents whose movement reflects real-world air quality conditions, where AQI serves as a measurable world feedback signal representing pollution-driven consequences. Instead of relying on human preference or synthetic rewards, the system uses environmental outcomes as the primary training signal, enabling policy learning grounded in ecological impact. We propose a multi-instance reinforcement learning simulation in which agents navigate a 2D grid representation of India integrated with a precomputed AQI matrix and geographic state boundaries. The framework combines bird call metadata from the Xeno-canto dataset, spatial discretization, and real environmental data to learn adaptive navigation strategies under pollution constraints. To ensure scalability and efficiency, repeated real-time API queries are replaced by a structured AQI mapping that enables fast lookup during training and execution. Multiple baselines, including Monte Carlo, Q-Learning, and Value Iteration, are evaluated for comparison. Deep Q-Network demonstrates stronger stability, adaptability, and cumulative performance across varying environmental conditions, establishing a scalable foundation for world-feedback driven ecological decision modeling.

</details>


### [368] [A Temporal Algebraic Framework for Data Stream Evaluation Under Delayed Labels and Distribution Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21914)
*Ronaldo C. Prati,Elaine Ribeiro de Faria*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向数据流的增量混淆矩阵评估框架：以指数衰减/滑动窗口加权计数，O(m²)每步更新，将延迟与选择性反馈建模为观测掩码，用免先验坐标（召回率、特异度）分离先验漂移与概念漂移，并以一阶雅可比分解归因，25条结论经Lean 4形式化验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据流中标签延迟或仅部分可见、类先验漂移、稀有类在短窗口内消失，导致标准评估将决策边界退化与先验变化混淆，且标签延迟或由模型选择性给出时评估有偏。

Method: 将单一混淆矩阵导出池化（micro）与逐类（macro）指标的代数框架扩展到流式场景：按时间以指数衰减或滑动窗口加权计数，每步更新代价O(m²)且与流长无关，池化指标保持为逐类指标的加权组合；延迟/选择性反馈以观测掩码表示，标签到达前用模型校准概率计入，偏差由校准误差驱动；无验证实例的类按审计约定不报告数值；通过监控免先验坐标（召回率、特异度）并做一阶雅可比分解，将指标变化归因于先验漂移与概念漂移。

Result: 在合成流与四个真实数据集上，基于免先验坐标并逐类保留记忆的检测器在先验漂移下未产生额外误报，优于雅可比告警与错误率检测器；延迟标签校正在部分真实场景可恢复召回率，但对精确率、特异度与F1仅部分恢复。25条陈述在Lean 4中检验通过，代码发布于aggmetrics包。

Conclusion: 加权增量混淆矩阵结合免先验坐标与雅可比分解，可在延迟、选择性反馈与先验漂移共存时给出低误报、可归因且计算高效的数据流评估；延迟标签校正对召回类指标有效而对其他指标仍不充分，是后续改进方向。

Abstract: In data streams, labels often arrive late or only for some instances, class prevalence drifts, and rare classes vanish from short windows. Standard evaluation then confuses a degraded decision boundary with a change in prevalence, and is biased when labels are delayed or selected by the model. We extend an algebraic framework that obtains pooled (micro) and per-class (macro) measures from one confusion matrix to streams, weighting the counts in time by exponential fading or a sliding window; the update costs O(m^2) per step, whatever the stream length, and each pooled measure stays a weighted combination of the per-class ones. Delayed and selective feedback enter as an observation mask: until its label arrives, an instance is counted with the model's calibrated class probabilities, and the bias of this interim estimate is driven by their calibration error. Audited conventions report no value for a class without verified instances. We separate prior shift from concept drift by monitoring prior-free coordinates (recall and specificity) and attribute a change in a measure to the two sources with a first-order Jacobian decomposition. On synthetic streams and four real datasets, a detector on these coordinates with a memory per class raises no excess false alarms under label shift, unlike the Jacobian alarm and error-rate detectors. The correction for delayed labels recovers recall in some real settings and is only partial for precision, specificity and F1. Twenty-five statements are checked in Lean 4, and the code is in the aggmetrics package.

</details>


### [369] [Lost in a Few Heads: Diagnosing and Repairing Block Selection in Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21917)
*Wenhe Zhang,Boxing Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 稀疏注意力在固定预算下检索精度损失主要源于少数"盲头"：其选择器因均值池化键摘要稀释了决定性 token 而低估 needle，而非预算不足。对这些头恢复全注意力或在原预算下用 4-bit 打分器即可在无训练条件下挽回大部分损失，且保留 84–89% 的 TTFT 收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏注意力模型每查询只读取少量键块，在固定预算下常损失大量长上下文检索精度。作者追问损失究竟产生于何处——是预算不够，还是选择器排序失误。

Method: 以"按出货预算做精确注意力质量选择"为 oracle，判断损失归因；设计校准探针：teacher-forcing 答案，逐头读取两个量——(1) 选择器放弃的 needle 注意力质量；(2) 修正该头选择后沿"出货选择器→全注意力"路径积分恢复的答案对数概率份额。据此定位"盲头"，并比较两种免训练修复（这些头用全注意力；或保留原预算的 4-bit 打分器）。进一步提出统一阈值规则（逐 checkpoint 扫描，直至校准提示上逼近全注意力），推广到 SeerAttention-R 门控、NSA、DashAttention、MoBA。

Result: InfLLM-V2 四个 checkpoint 与 NOSA-8B 的多键检索损失集中在同样的三个盲头，这些头实际关注 needle，但均值池化的键摘要稀释了单一决定性 token。MiniCPM4.1-8B 在 64K 下多键检索由 54.1% 提升至 97.5%，达到逐头全注意力水平。生产推理引擎中，这些头全注意力在 32K–128K 上下文仍保留稀疏注意力所节省 TTFT 的 84–89%。SeerAttention-R 门控、NSA、DashAttention 的损失同样由少数盲头承载，MoBA 则有大量此类头。Qwen3-8B + SeerAttention-R 门控下，288 个 KV 头中仅 18 个头用全注意力即将多键检索从 29.8% 提升至 97.7%。

Conclusion: 稀疏注意力的长上下文检索损失是可定位、可修复的结构性缺陷：瓶颈在选择器对关键 token 的低估而非预算规模，聚焦极少数盲头即可近乎无损地恢复精度并保留绝大部分效率收益，且该诊断规则具备跨选择器家族的普适性。

Abstract: Sparse attention models read a few blocks of keys for every query at a fixed budget and can lose much of their long-context retrieval accuracy at that budget. We ask where this loss is made. Using exact attention mass selection at the shipped budget as an oracle, we show that the selector under-ranks the needle rather than running out of budget. We find attention heads that miss the needle by running a calibration probe that teacher-forces the answer and reads two quantities in every head. The first is the needle attention that the selector forfeits, and the second is the share of the answer's log-probability that fixing the head's selection restores, integrated along the path from the shipped selector to full attention. Four checkpoints of the InfLLM-V2 family and NOSA-8B lose multi-key retrieval in the same three blind heads, which attend to the needle while a mean-pooled key summary dilutes its single decisive token. Full attention in those heads or a 4-bit scorer that keeps the shipped budget recovers most of the loss without training. On MiniCPM4.1-8B at 64K, either fix lifts multi-key retrieval accuracy from 54.1 to 97.5%, level with full attention in every head. In production serving engines, full attention in those heads keeps 84 to 89% of the time to first token (TTFT) that sparse attention saves at 32K to 128K context length. Beyond the InfLLM-V2 selector lineage, one unified rule flags attention heads above a threshold swept on each checkpoint until they close most of the gap to full attention on calibration prompts. A similar small set of blind attention heads carry the loss for the SeerAttention-R gates, NSA, and DashAttention, whereas many such heads exist in MoBA. On Qwen3-8B with the SeerAttention-R gates, full attention in 18 of 288 key-value heads lifts multi-key retrieval accuracy from 29.8 to 97.7%.

</details>


### [370] [KVUse: Reusable-KV User Memory for Efficient LLM Recommenders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21920)
*Xin Guo,Qiang Zhang,Xiang Zhou,Arushi Rai,Siyu Lin,Yifan Wu,Xiang Shen,Lei Huang,Qunshu Zhang,Xiangjun Fan,Lizhu Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KVUse将LLM推荐系统中的用户画像从文本形式改为可复用的KV缓存存储，通过自蒸馏训练LoRA写入器在解码时直接产出可复用KV，并配合定制KV调度器隐藏传输开销，在保持排序质量的同时显著提升吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的记忆增强推荐系统为每个用户维护自然语言画像，但每次排序调用都需将画像拼入prompt并在prefill阶段重复计算其KV缓存。由于排序调用属于prefill重负载（长prompt、短输出）且被反复调用，用户画像的重复prefill成为服务瓶颈；而前缀缓存无法消除该开销，因为不同调用中用户画像前接的文本不同。

Method: 核心思路是把用户画像存储为可复用的KV缓存而非文本。具体包括：(1) 通过自蒸馏训练轻量LoRA写入器，使画像更新调用在解码画像的同时产出该画像的可复用KV；(2) 使LLM能在新位置、新上下文之后直接读取这些可复用KV而无需重算；(3) 设计定制KV调度器，在当前批次计算期间预取下一批次的已存KV，将主机内存到GPU的KV传输隐藏在计算之后。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct与四个InstructRec数据集上，经过连续多轮记忆更新，KVUse的排序质量与全量prefill相比无统计显著差异。在饱和负载下，KVUse将下游打分路径吞吐提升4.0x–4.5x，画像更新路径吞吐提升1.4x–1.9x。

Conclusion: 将用户画像以可复用KV缓存形式存储，可在不损失排序质量的前提下消除重复prefill瓶颈，配合KV调度隐藏传输开销，显著提升记忆增强LLM推荐系统的服务吞吐。

Abstract: Memory-augmented recommenders built on large language models (LLMs) maintain a natural-language profile of each user. These profiles are updated by a user profile update path that revises the profile as new interactions arrive and are consumed by downstream task paths like ranking. Because these user profiles are stored as text in the user memory, every ranking LLM call that consumes them must splice them in the prompt and calculate the KV cache of them during the prefill phase. Given these ranking LLM calls are prefill heavy (long prompt but short decoded output) and repeatedly called, these repeated prefill of user profile text dominates the serving. Prefix caching cannot remove it, because these user profiles are preceded by different text in different calls. We present KVUse, which stores the user profiles as reusable key-value (KV) caches instead of text. KVUse trains lightweight LoRA writers by self-distillation, so that the user profile update call produces the reusable KV of the user profile while decoding it, and the LLM can read these reusable KV at new positions and behind new context without recomputation. KVUse also has a customized KV scheduler that uploads the stored reusable KV of the next batch while the current batch is computed, hiding the KV transfer from host memory behind GPU computation. On four InstructRec datasets with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, KVUse shows no statistically significant difference in ranking quality from full prefill over continuous memory update rounds. Under saturated load, KVUse raises the throughput of the downstream scoring path by 4.0x-4.5x and of the profile update path by 1.4x-1.9x.

</details>


### [371] [Physics-informed neural networks for spacecraft trajectory optimization with exact boundary conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21933)
*Samuel Schönherr,Günther Waxenegger-Wilfing,Sascha Ranftl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出一种基于解空间重参数化的无监督神经网络轨迹优化方法，利用轨迹优化问题边界条件维度低的特点构造简单变换，将边界条件精确嵌入函数中，从而把带约束的多目标问题转化为单目标无约束问题，显著改善收敛性与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准物理信息神经网络（PINN）式轨迹优化需通过额外加权损失项施加初末状态约束，形成多目标优化，对损失权重高度敏感，易导致收敛差、精度低。作者希望消除此类权重调节问题。

Method: 将位置建模为时间的函数，以网络参数最小化推力（无监督训练，物理规律直接写入目标）。构造一个简单变换，把边界条件先验地、精确地嵌入解空间（可视为解空间的重参数化），将原约束优化问题转为在容许轨迹上的无约束优化，从而去掉边界惩罚项并将问题化为单目标优化。关键在于轨迹优化的边界是低维的，使得距离函数构造比一般 PDE 域更简单稳定。

Result: 数值实验表明，该方法在收敛行为与解精度上均有实质性提升。

Conclusion: 通过结构感知的重参数化精确满足边界条件，可避免PINN多目标损失加权带来的敏感性与不稳定，为轨迹优化提供更简洁、稳定且高精度的无监督神经网络求解框架。

Abstract: We use neural networks to optimize trajectories by modeling the position as a function of time and minimizing the thrust with respect to the network parameters. This corresponds to an unsupervised training procedure in which physical laws are incorporated directly into the optimization objective. In standard physics-informed neural networks, initial and terminal states are enforced through additional weighted loss terms, resulting in a multi-objective optimization problem that is highly sensitive to the choice of loss weights and can lead to poor convergence and reduced accuracy. To address this challenge, we construct a simple transformation, exploiting the mathematical structure of trajectory optimization problems, to enforce boundary conditions exactly a-priori. This transformation can be interpreted as a reparameterization of the solution space that embeds the boundary conditions directly into the function. This converts the original constrained optimization problem into an unconstrained one over admissible trajectories. I.e. the transformation eliminates the boundary condition penalty terms and reduces the problem to a single-objective optimization. Crucially, trajectory optimization comes with a low-dimensional boundary, which allows particularly simple and stable constructions of distance functions compared to general domains in partial differential equations. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach meaningfully improves convergence behavior and solution accuracy.

</details>


### [372] [Higher-Order Interaction Reconstruction via Integral Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21935)
*Xin Mao,Zhen Xu,Shiyi Yang,Sukwon Yun,Yunmei Liu,Ren Wang,Tianlong Chen,Can Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 积分型物理信息神经网络（IntegralPINN）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高阶交互重构是复杂网络反问题，因组合复杂性、强非线性及噪声稀疏观测而困难；传统基于导数残差的PINN对噪声敏感、易不稳定。

Method: 改用时间区间上的积分形式替代导数残差惩罚，以抑制高频噪声与导数放大；并对交互张量引入连续参数化，使高阶结构可通过梯度优化求解；理论上给出与导数放大无关的噪声鲁棒误差界（需积分窗口满足激励条件）。

Result: 在生态动力学、社会传染、神经元同步系统上，噪声与稀疏观测条件下重构准确鲁棒，优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 积分表述是提升高阶交互反演噪声鲁棒性的有效途径。

Abstract: Reconstructing higher-order interactions is a fundamental challenge in complex networked systems, with applications in ecological, social, and biological networks.
